headline: No food handler training for employees
summary: Inspection passed, but inspector observed no food handler training for employees. All employees handling food or equipment must receive food handler training.

headline: Combo hand sink, grease buildup, leaks found
summary: Hand-washing sink at barista station is combined with a dump sink; must be replaced with a single sink. Grease and food debris on cooking equipment and walls, milk crates used as shelving, and a leaking dish-area sprayer also noted. No citation issued.

headline: Containers not inverted; no allergen training
summary: Food containers on shelving units were not stored inverted and must be. The city sanitation manager had no allergen training and must provide proof.

headline: Rodent droppings and flies; unapproved glue traps
summary: Failed. About 65 rodent droppings and about 15 live small flies were found in prep and storage areas. Staff-set glue traps must be removed. Front doors have gaps. Raw shrimp dish had no consumer advisory.

headline: Soda nozzle residue; ice machine drain needs fix
summary: Re-inspection found a brownish substance inside the soda gun nozzle, which must be cleaned and sanitized. Pipes going into the floor drain under the ice machine need a 6-inch air gap or a backflow prevention device on the fresh water line.

headline: Unlabeled containers, damaged board, burnt bulbs
summary: Re-inspection found unlabeled food containers, a grooved and stained cutting board, a self-closing washroom door not working, soiled mop heads, and two burnt-out bulbs in the main prep area.

headline: No allergen training for certified managers
summary: No allergen training was available for City of Chicago food managers. Managers must complete training and keep the certificate on site.

headline: Missing handsink sign; stained cutting boards; leak
summary: No handwashing sign was posted at the front prep handsink. Cutting boards near hot holding units had open seams and dark stains and must be refinished or replaced. A drainpipe under the three-compartment sink is leaking and must be repaired.

headline: Missing handwashing signs; wiping cloths on prep tables
summary: Re-inspection found no handwashing signs near bar-area sinks and wiping cloths stored on prep tables instead of in sanitizing solution. Both must be corrected.

headline: No certified manager while handling rice, fish
summary: No certified food service manager was on site while foods that must be kept hot or cold, such as rice and fish, were handled and served. Utensils were drying on cloth towels; staff must air dry them instead.

headline: Unlabeled bulk bread and chip containers
summary: Bulk storage containers for bread and tortilla chips had no labels. The person in charge must label all bulk and working ingredient containers with their contents' names.

headline: Dish machine not sanitizing; tagged out
summary: Low-temperature dish machine did not sanitize at final rinse, reading 0 ppm. The machine was tagged and may not be used until the health department reinspects it after repair.

headline: No original sanitation certificate on site
summary: No person on site had an original City of Chicago food sanitation certificate posted. A citation was issued; a certified person must be on site at all times.

headline: Oven door broken; toilet ventilation not working
summary: Oven door is not attached and is held closed with a bucket; it must be fixed. Restroom ventilation fan doesn't work and window won't open. Also: grooved cutting boards, oversized pots, dirty floors, and missing food handler and allergen proof.

headline: Inadequate lighting inside walk-in cooler
summary: Lighting inside the walk-in cooler was inadequate. Staff were instructed to provide adequate lighting.

headline: 40+ rat and mouse droppings; no pest logbook
summary: Failed. About 40 or more rat and mouse droppings were found on floors, ledges, and behind coolers; a citation was issued and pest control was recommended. No pest logbook, signed health policy, vomit cleanup procedure, or freezer for frozen food.

headline: Previous allergen training violation not corrected
summary: No allergen training was on site, a previous core violation not corrected from 2023. Citation issued. Notes show the correction dated 5/10/24.

headline: Unnecessary items in gelato service area
summary: Unnecessary items were found in the gelato service area. They must be removed and remaining items organized.

headline: Undated foods; repeat floor and grease violations
summary: Failed. Ready-to-eat and cooked foods lacked date marks; citation issued. Food on prep area floors and grease and debris on equipment from a prior report were not corrected. Hair restraints were missing; washroom lacked a handwashing sign.

headline: No certified manager; food stored on floor
summary: Failed. No certified manager was on site while rice (181.3°F) was prepared and served; citation issued. Food was stored on the prep floor. The three-compartment sink drained slowly and leaked; citation issued.

headline: Food on freezer floor; missing ceiling panels
summary: Food stored on the walk-in freezer floor must be raised six inches. Grease and debris under deep fryers need cleaning, missing ceiling panels in the warewashing area need replacing, and employee belongings were on a prep table.

headline: No certified manager while tuna and pasta prepared
summary: No certified food service manager with a valid certificate was on site while foods that must be kept hot or cold, like tuna and pasta, were prepared; citation issued. Dish machine had no sanitizer at final rinse, since repaired. Staff lacked hair restraints.

headline: Soiled freezer interiors and floor drains
summary: Nonfood-contact interior surfaces of 2-door reach-in freezers at the main grill line were heavily soiled with dried food debris. Floor drains beneath plumbing fixtures were also heavily soiled and must be cleaned.

headline: Leaking pipe; no food handler or allergen certificates
summary: No food handler or allergen certificates were on site; records must be kept there. Also: a leaking pipe under the three-compartment sink, dirty floors, a missing floor tile with standing water, and tongs stored on a pipe.

headline: Unlabeled food; plastic bags in freezers
summary: Unlabeled foods, including M&Ms, sprinkles, peanuts and oatmeal, were in unmarked containers. Food stored in plastic grocery bags in freezers must move to food-grade containers. Unused equipment must be removed to prevent pest harborage.

headline: Rodent droppings found; cold foods too warm
summary: Failed. About 70 rodent droppings and about 15 live small flies were found across prep and storage areas; pest control service recommended. Prep cooler beef, pork, cheese, and chicken at 48-52°F were discarded and citation issued.

headline: Only one certified manager has allergen training
summary: Only one certified food manager (CFM) showed allergen training proof; all CFMs must show proof.

headline: Sewage backs up onto prep area floor
summary: Sewage backed up from a floor drain near cooking equipment and pooled on the prep floor when the three-compartment and handwashing sinks were used. The person in charge must repair it; citation issued. Also: unlabeled containers, uninverted tableware, greasy floors.

headline: Ice and drink machines dirty; no training proof
summary: Failed. Only blank employee health policy copies were on site. Black, brown, and pink residue was found inside the drink dispenser and rear ice machine. Menus lacked a consumer advisory for undercooked items. No food handler or allergen training proof.

headline: No covered garbage can in women's restroom
summary: The women's restroom had no covered garbage can. One must be provided.

headline: Leaking drain line; basement clutter; stained wall board
summary: Water leaks from the drain line under the three-compartment sink must be repaired. Unnecessary items and clutter on the basement floor must be removed; items should be 6 inches off the floor. The stained wall board by the sink must be cleaned.

headline: Missing vomit cleanup kit and food handler certificates
summary: No vomit and diarrhea cleanup kit was on site, and no food handler certificates were observed. Employees must have them within 90 days of hire. Unused garage equipment must be removed to prevent pests; exposed wood must be sealed.

headline: Cold foods held at 47-51°F; discarded
summary: Failed. Cooked ground beef at 47.9°F and deli meat at 47-51°F were held above the 41°F limit inside a display cooler; they were discarded. Coolers and hot holding unit lacked thermometers, and sanitizer test strips were missing.

headline: Restroom coving detached; hole in wall
summary: Coving in the toilet room is detached from the wall, and a hole in the wall must be repaired. One new male food employee has no food handler certificate and must obtain one within 30 days of hire.

headline: No employee health policy; dirty walk-in shelves
summary: No employee health policy was on site; a signed policy for each employee must be kept on site. Rusty, dirty walk-in cooler shelves need cleaning, repainting, or replacing, and floor drains and a closet need cleaning.

headline: Food and linens stored outdoors; oversized pots
summary: Failed. Beans, onions, to-go containers, and soiled linens were stored outdoors on the ground, exposed to contamination. Oversized pots from a prior report still can't be sanitized in the sink; citation issued. Also: dirty wiping cloths.

headline: No certified manager until 2:40 PM
summary: No certified manager was on duty while cold and hot foods were prepared; the manager arrived about 2:40 PM and a citation was issued. Also: improperly stored wiping cloths and utensils, and no food handler training proof.

headline: Chicken and carnitas held too cool; no towels
summary: Chicken at 124°F and carnitas at 129°F were below the 135°F hot-holding minimum; about 10 pounds were discarded and a citation issued. Several handsinks lacked paper towels; an employee supplied them during inspection. No food handler certificates were on site.

headline: Only blank employee health policy forms
summary: Blank copies of the employee health policy were on site. Staff must keep signed copies for each food employee on hire, acknowledging the reporting agreement.

headline: Single-service items on floor; bulbs out in hood
summary: Single-service items and boxes were stored on the basement floor and must be raised at least 6 inches. Two light bulbs in the exhaust hood above the main cooking area were not working and must be replaced.

headline: Over 100 mouse droppings; pest service required
summary: Failed. Over 100 mouse droppings were found in coolers, under display units, and around sinks and walls. A citation was issued, and the manager was told to call an exterminator. Doors have a 1/4-inch gap. Food handlers lacked hair restraints.

headline: Torn gasket on walk-in cooler door
summary: A torn rubber gasket on the rear storage walk-in cooler door must be repaired or replaced and maintained.

headline: Beverage machine waste line drains onto floor
summary: A beverage machine waste line discharged through a hose directly onto the floor beside a floor drain. It must be rerouted to the sewer system or another proper liquid waste point.

headline: Rodent droppings and live flies; no thermometer
summary: Failed. About 70 rodent droppings were found in the rear area, dry storage, and near the water heater, plus about 3 live flies in front prep. Pest control was recommended. No metal-stem thermometer was on site.

headline: Greasy equipment; no receptacles; damaged restroom walls
summary: Grease and food particles on fryers, cooking equipment, and walk-in shelves need cleaning. Women's washrooms lacked covered receptacles. Men's washrooms had loose tile and a hole to repair; kitchen floors under cooking equipment need cleaning.

headline: 10 pounds of chicken cooled too slowly; discarded
summary: About 10 pounds of chicken at 80°F was cooling in a deep pan with no time or temperature log. Manager discarded it; citation issued. Cooling rule: 135°F to 70°F within 2 hours, then to 41°F within 6 hours.

headline: Non-service dogs inside; rear door gap
summary: Dogs that were not service dogs were brought inside; only service dogs are allowed, and a citation was issued. The rear door has a 1/4-inch gap at the bottom to seal. Floors inside the dairy display cooler need cleaning.

headline: No food handler certificates for current staff
summary: Re-inspection found the facility could not show food handler training certificates for all current food handlers. All employees who handle or prepare food must complete training and certificates must be provided.

headline: Handsinks lacked soap; dish machine not sanitizing
summary: Handsinks lacked soap and towels (citation issued). Low-temperature dish machine read 0 ppm sanitizer and was not to be used. Staff drank at prep areas, food sat on freezer floors, and ice scoops were stored in the ice machine.

headline: No health policy; sink wastewater backs up
summary: Failed. No employee health policy was on site. Wastewater backed up from one compartment into another in the rear three-compartment sink. Pest logbook must be current under the new business name. One manager lacked allergen training.

headline: No handwashing signs; no food handler certificates
summary: No handwashing signs were posted at restroom and food prep handsinks, and no food handler certificates were on hand. Staff were told to provide both.

headline: No pest logbook; handsinks lacked soap, towels
summary: Failed. No pest control logbook or agreement was on site, and no signed employee health policy. Handsinks lacked cleanser and drying supplies. No outside garbage receptacle or contract. Also dirty grease receptacle and missing allergen certificate.

headline: No certified manager; food smoked in outdoor smoker
summary: Failed. No certified manager was present while chicken was prepared and served. Food was smoked in an outdoor smoker, which must be removed. Ready-to-eat chicken and salmon lacked discard dates. Food handler certificates and sanitizer test strips were missing.

headline: Leaking backflow devices; dirty dumpster area
summary: Failed. Deli preparation handsinks lacked handwashing signs. Backflow prevention devices in deli and bakery areas are leaking and must be repaired. Outside dumpster area had grease and garbage spillage; citation issued.

headline: Over 50 mouse droppings; food debris throughout
summary: Failed. Over 50 mouse droppings lined the rear wall base; citation issued and pest control is needed. Shelves, mixers, coolers, and fryers had heavy food debris. Ceilings and floors are water-damaged, and clutter fills the premises.

headline: Unlabeled food containers; washroom fan not working
summary: Food stored in containers in coolers, the walk-in cooler, and dry storage lacked name labels. The washroom's exhaust ventilation fan was not working and must be provided.

headline: Buildup in ice machine, cooler doors, and drains
summary: Buildup was found inside the ice machine door, on the interior doors of a cold-hold unit near the grill, and in all drains. The certified manager had no allergen training on site.

headline: High-temperature dish machine tagged out; no health policy
summary: The high-temperature dish machine is not operating and is tagged; do not use until repaired. No written employee health policy was on site. Dry food was stored under waste water pipes, and a leak under the three-compartment sink must be repaired.

headline: No certified manager; dish machine not sanitizing
summary: Failed. No certified manager was on duty while chicken, pork and lamb were prepared, and dish machine sanitizer read 0 ppm; the machine was tagged out. Chicken held at 47.2°F was discarded. Prep sink hot water was only 63°F.

headline: No certified manager on site while open
summary: No certified food manager was on site while open; citation issued. Also noted: a leaking pipe under the three-compartment sink creating a puddle, ice machine panel buildup, no lidded receptacle in the all-gender restroom, and no food handler certificates.

headline: Exposed brick walls need smooth, cleanable surfaces
summary: Exposed brick walls in the first-floor meat room, around the glasswashers and ice machine, and near a second-floor cold holding unit must be made smooth and easily cleanable.

headline: No certified manager; dirty floors; no training
summary: No certified manager was on site while sausage pizza was prepared and served; citation issued. Floors, walls, and equipment areas were dirty and need upgrading. No food handler training certificates were provided.

headline: Missing splash guards; freezers iced; no backflow device
summary: Splash guards are needed between handsinks and sinks near the rice cooker, sauce storage, and stove. Reach-in freezers have excessive ice and debris. A backflow preventer must be installed on the main prep utility sink.

headline: Fried chicken and raw shrimp held too warm
summary: Cooked fried chicken at 64.5°F and raw shrimp at 56.4°F were held above the 41°F limit. About 20 pounds ($200) were discarded, and a citation was issued. Equipment, walls, and floors had grease and food debris buildup that needs cleaning.

headline: No food handler training proof; hair restraints missing
summary: No food handler training proof was provided for required employees. Employees lacked hair restraints, scoops were stored inside rice and sugar containers, and wiping cloths sat on prep tables. Also: missing handwashing signs and unlabeled containers.

headline: Washroom doors not self-closing; no allergen proof
summary: Employee washroom doors, including men's, women's, and all-gender, lack self-closing devices. The all-gender washroom has no covered receptacle for sanitary products. No allergen training proof was shown for the certified food manager (CFM).

headline: Live roaches and flies; no three-compartment sink
summary: Failed. A live cockroach was in a bodily fluid spill kit in the rear prep area. About 7 small and 5 large live flies were found in several rooms. No three-compartment sink or sanitizer test strips were on site.

headline: Sandwich cooler too warm; 17 pounds discarded
summary: Turkey and cheese croissant sandwiches at 50.7°F were above the 41°F limit, and the sandwich fridge air was 49°F. About 17 pounds ($420.50) were discarded and a citation issued. Also: unlabeled seasonings, cutting boards with deep cuts, missing training proof.

headline: Raw wood shelving; missing baseboard coving
summary: Raw wooden shelving inside the front prep area must be sealed to be smooth and cleanable. Baseboard coving is missing along the exterior wall of the walk-in cooler next to the rear three-compartment sink.

headline: Undated ready-to-eat foods; boxes on floor
summary: Ready-to-eat foods such as rice, al pastor, and menudo lacked date marks; about 20 pounds were discarded and a citation issued. Also: boxes stored on the basement floor and torn pieces inside a chest freezer.

headline: No certified manager; live roaches and mouse droppings
summary: Failed. No certified manager was on site while food was served, and no vomit cleanup kit was present. Live roaches on a kitchen outlet, and mouse droppings were on west storage shelves. Food handler certificates and health policy were also missing.

headline: Live roaches, rodent droppings; repeat violation
summary: Failed. Roach carcasses were in kitchen and basement. About 20 rodent droppings were under basement shelving and near the grease trap, and 2 live roaches were on the rear prep floor. A prior pest violation was not corrected; citation issued.

headline: Improper storage, dirty equipment, missing handwashing signs
summary: Re-inspection found missing handwashing signs, wiping cloths on prep tables, and items stored on floors. Cooking equipment interior was dirty. Also: rusty walk-in shelving, a slow handsink drain, peeling floor paint, and a large wall opening.

headline: Failed: no certified manager, undated food, no handsink
summary: Failed. No valid city food sanitation certificate was posted, and no employee health policy was on site. Foods that must be kept hot or cold lacked date labels and were discarded. No handwashing sink was on the cook line.

headline: Live roaches found; greasy hood and leaking drain
summary: Failed. Two live roaches were on a mop sink room wall; all pest activity must be removed by re-inspection and pest control is advised. Also: food buildup in a reach-in cooler, a leaking dishroom handsink drain, and a greasy hood.

headline: Missing handwash sign; no food handler training
summary: A handwash sign was missing at the front prep sink. Interior freezer doors and exterior ice machine were dirty. A male food handler had no training; he must obtain it and keep verification on site.

headline: About 100 rat droppings; 15 live cockroaches
summary: Failed. About 100 rat droppings were in the basement under the dishwashing area, and 15 live cockroaches were in dry storage. Additional pest control service is needed. Also: a missing backflow cap that leaks, and a missing splashguard.

headline: Moldy shelving, dirty walls, burnt-out hood lights
summary: Mold-like buildup on rear prep and dish shelving must be cleaned and sanitized before storing kitchenware. Floors, walls, and ceilings need cleaning; vents and hoods are dirty; bulbs under all hoods are burned out.

headline: Wall opening near deli cooking; dirty floors
summary: Lower wall near cooking equipment in the deli prep area has an opening that must be sealed. Slight debris under a hot-holding unit with ready-to-eat food, and produce storage floors need cleaning.

headline: Rice too cool to hold; mouse droppings found
summary: Failed. No certified manager was on site while chicken, burgers and pizza were prepared; citation issued. Cooked rice at 106.4°F, below the 135°F minimum, was discarded. About 50 mouse droppings were found; pest control was suggested. Handsinks lacked hand drying.

headline: No certified manager during food prep; grease buildup
summary: Staff prepared and handled foods that must be kept hot or cold without a certified manager or original certificate on site; citation issued. Also: grease on equipment and walls, milk crates as shelving, and damaged floor tiles.

headline: Sanitation manager lacks allergen training certificate
summary: The food service sanitation manager has no allergen training certificate. Staff were told to meet this requirement.

headline: Unlabeled dessert; door gaps; splash guard needed
summary: Repackaged dessert on display needs proper labels. Gaps at the bottom of the front and rear doors must be sealed. Needed: a splash guard between hand sink and three-compartment sink, sealed walk-in shelves, and less rear yard clutter.

headline: Live flies in basement prep; undisclosed undercooked meats
summary: Failed. About 15 live small flying insects and 5 house flies were on walls, ceiling, and prep tables in the basement food prep area; pest control service needed. Steaks and lamb lacked consumer advisory on menu. A dumpster lacked a lid.

headline: Repeat pest violation; flies still present
summary: Previous pest violation was not corrected: about 10 flies in the coffee area, 20-30 in the dish area, and 15-20 in both bars. The pest control company did not service the site. No certified manager was on site; citation issued.

headline: No certified manager; cooked gyros at 106°F
summary: Failed. No certified manager was on site; citation issued. About 4 pounds of cooked gyro meat at 106°F was discarded. About 10 live small flies were on rooftop prep walls. Open pesticide insect traps hung in food prep areas.

headline: Handsinks lacked soap and towels; citation issued
summary: Main prep and bar handsinks lacked soap and hand drying (citation issued). Scissors were in the sushi handsink, and the warewashing machine leaks. Also: a rinser in front of the bar handsink and a dirty three-compartment drain.

headline: Sanitation manager lacks allergen training
summary: The sanitation manager had no allergen training and must provide proof.

headline: Eating near food; no gloves; no hood
summary: An employee was eating while preparing ready-to-eat food; staff must eat in designated areas. Staff were handling food without gloves. A second-floor pastry kitchen lacks a ventilation hood; the person in charge must contact the city ventilation department.

headline: No certified manager while eggs, sausage prepared
summary: No person in charge had a valid certificate, and no certified manager was on duty while foods that must be kept hot or cold, like eggs and sausage, were prepared and served. Citation issued.

headline: Floors need detail cleaning
summary: Floors throughout need detail cleaning, especially behind and around equipment in the front prep area.

headline: Mold-like residue; leaking front handsink
summary: Black mold-like residue was on caulking around the three-compartment sink and must be cleaned or repaired. Food debris was in the pizza reach-in cooler. The front prep handsink is in disrepair with a leaking pipe and must be fixed.

headline: No vomit and diarrhea procedure or supplies
summary: No written procedure or adequate supplies were on site for vomit or diarrhea cleanup; they must be provided. Holes in toilet-room walls must be repaired, and wooden dry-storage shelving must be sealed to be smooth and cleanable.

headline: Crates used for shelving; mold-like buildup in cooler
summary: Inspector asked staff to stop using milk and soda crates to raise items, and to use proper shelves 6 inches off the floor. Also noted: cardboard shelf liners, mold-like buildup on walk-in cooler racks, dumpster-area debris, and dirty floors.

headline: No certified manager during food preparation
summary: No certified manager with valid certificate was on site while foods that must be kept hot or cold were prepared; citation issued. Also: a fly strip hanging near the cooler, no splash guard between sinks, and no covered washroom receptacle.

headline: Dish machine drain problem; missing handler certificate
summary: Dish machine drains into the three-compartment sink's middle compartment; it must be rerouted to a floor drain. A food handler prepared food without a training certificate. Also: a torn cooler door gasket, broken floor tiles, and damaged ceilings.

headline: Rear door gap; milk crates used as shelving
summary: A 1/4-inch gap at the bottom left corner of the rear door must be sealed. A dispensing utensil handle rested on top of salsa in the prep cooler and must be stored above food. Milk crates are used as basement shelving and need replacing.

headline: Torn cooler gaskets; no washroom ventilation
summary: Pass. A four-door prep cooler had ripped door gaskets that must be repaired. The employee washroom had no mechanical ventilation, and the manager was told to provide a working fan.

headline: No certified manager; mouse droppings found
summary: Failed. No certified manager was on premises. About 10 mouse droppings were found, including on a shelf by the basement entrance; pest control was recommended. Also: no service sink, and no food handler or allergen proof.

headline: Bare-hand food handling; cold foods too warm
summary: Person in charge handled rodent bait, then sliced cheese bare-handed without washing; citation issued. About 108 pounds of cold foods at 45.5-61.7°F were discarded. Dish machine read 0 ppm sanitizer, and ice machine slime dripped onto ice; both cited.

headline: 40-50 rat droppings; prior pest violation uncorrected
summary: Failed. The prior rat violation was not corrected: 40-50 rat droppings were found in basement prep, dining, and bar areas, and pest control must be consulted. Two pigeon carcasses were in the outdoor garbage area; chewed holes must be sealed.

headline: No valid certificate; ice machine has black buildup
summary: Failed. No valid certified manager certificate was on site. Ice machine interior had black substance dripping onto ice for human consumption; citation issued. Food handler and allergen certificates were also missing.

headline: Oven propped with wood; grease-filled vents
summary: A wood plank and plastic wrap held a loose oven door shut; repair it. Encrusted grease in fryer exhaust vents needs deep cleaning. Basement has a wall hole, a broken baseboard, clutter, boxes on the floor, and dusty hood filters.

headline: Uninverted plates; dirty floors at bar
summary: Serving plates on kitchen prep shelves were not inverted and need to be, to prevent dust. Floors along wall bases and under equipment, especially at the bar, need cleaning.

headline: 60+ mouse droppings and live flies found
summary: Failed. About 60 or more mouse droppings were on shelves, display units, and behind a juice cooler. 15 or more live small flies were in basement and washroom areas; citation issued. No vomit cleanup procedure or supplies were on site.

headline: Cardboard used as cutting surface on dough
summary: Inspector saw cardboard being used to cut dough on top. Staff were told to use proper utensils and surfaces for cutting food, and not cardboard, in food preparation.

headline: No certified manager; handsink lacked soap
summary: No certified manager was on duty while chicken and fish were prepared and served; citation issued. The prep handsink had no soap. A leaking three-compartment faucet and dirty walk-in and reach-in shelves need repair and cleaning.

headline: Torn gasket; greasy, dirty floors throughout
summary: A torn rubber door gasket on a small prep cooler must be repaired. Excessive grease, food spills, old fries, and dirt were found on floors throughout the premises, including along walls and under equipment, and must be cleaned.

headline: Unlabeled popcorn; milk crates; moldy caulking
summary: Bulk popcorn container lacks a common-name label. Milk crates may not be used for shelving in B2 dry storage. A utility sink floor drain cover is missing and dish machine caulking is blackened and moldy; both must be fixed.

headline: No food handler proof; wiping cloths improperly stored
summary: No proof of food handler training for required employees. Wiping cloths were not kept in sanitizing solution, boxed items were on the floor, and a cooler lid was broken and taped. Also: dirty floors and drains, and unlabeled bulk foods.

headline: No certified manager while chicken, fish prepared
summary: No certified food manager was on premises while foods that must be kept hot or cold, like chicken and fish, were prepared. A certified manager with an original certificate must be present during those times.

headline: Washroom vent not working; no covered receptacle
summary: The front unisex washroom lacks a covered waste receptacle. Mechanical ventilation inside washrooms is not working and must be repaired. The first-floor mop sink room needs decluttering, with mops and brooms raised 6 inches off the floor.

headline: Unlabeled containers; mold-like fan cover buildup
summary: Some food containers need common-name labels. Food must be stored 6 inches off the floor in the rear kitchen. Clean mold-like buildup on condenser fan cover in rear walk-in cooler, and regrout floor tiles with deep seams by 3-compartment sink.

headline: Door gap, sink leak, loose coving, broken tile
summary: Inspector saw a 1/4-inch gap at the exit door that could let pests in; it must be corrected. Also noted: a leaking three-compartment sink faucet, dusty walk-in cooler fan covers, loose wall coving, and a broken restroom floor tile.

headline: Clutter blocks rear closets next to restroom
summary: Both rear closets next to the restroom were cluttered with boxes and equipment, blocking full access. Staff must remove unnecessary items and keep the area maintained.

headline: Old raw meat, moldy racks in refrigerators
summary: Old raw meat was hanging from refrigerator racks where kabobs are stored, and all refrigerator racks had mold or food debris. Food in an aluminum can sat in water from a cooling unit. Bulk sugar and spices were unlabeled.

headline: Ice buildup in freezer; leaking faucet
summary: Ice buildup in the basement ice cream deep freezer must be defrosted and cleaned. The three-compartment sink faucet leaks and must be repaired. The basement food prep washroom door is not self-closing.

headline: Undercooked food advisory added; leaks and residue
summary: Menu lacked a raw or undercooked food advisory; corrected on site. Also: a rear door gap, a leaking three-compartment faucet, residue in a soap hose and soda holder, and no covered women's washroom receptacle.

headline: No vomit and diarrhea cleanup procedure or kit
summary: No written procedure or supplies were available for vomit and diarrhea cleanup; gloves, masks, disposable mops, and norovirus-killing sanitizer are needed. Also: missing washroom handwashing signs, an uncovered receptacle, and basement clutter.

headline: Truck lacks name and license; no trash bin
summary: Handsink lacked handwashing signage. The truck's sides are missing the business name and license number. No indoor trash receptacle was present. Each must be provided and maintained.

headline: Expired food handler certificates; greasy fryers
summary: Food handlers had no valid food handler certificates; those on site were expired. A food handler was not wearing a hair restraint. Fryers, hood, and a 3-compartment sink's cold water knob also need attention.

headline: Shrimp thawed at room temperature; scored cutting board
summary: Shrimp and frozen fruit were thawing at room temperature and must use approved methods, such as running water at 70°F or less. A pizza counter cutting board with deep scoring must be resurfaced or replaced.

headline: Food on freezer floor; basement clutter
summary: Food was found on the floor of the basement walk-in freezer and must be raised at least 6 inches. Basement clutter with overstock and crates must be organized.

headline: Rear door gap, taped freezer handle, no certificates
summary: A 1/2-inch gap at the rear exit door could allow pests in and must be repaired. Also: taped freezer door handle, peeling paint near the three-compartment sink, no food handler certificates, and no allergen training for the person in charge.

headline: Ice machine debris; black caulking at sink
summary: Slight debris was inside the ice machine and must be cleaned and maintained. Caulking at top base of the three-compartment sink has excessive black buildup and must be removed or replaced.

headline: Turkey and steak held too warm; discarded
summary: Turkey at 49.5°F and steak at 52.5°F were above the 41°F limit and discarded (about $50). Toilet tissue was missing; citation issued. Also: no covered toilet receptacle, mop not drying properly, and no allergen training for new managers.

headline: Scoops touching food; expired handler certificates
summary: Failed. Scoops were stored with handles in food inside bins and containers. Expired food handler certificates were on site. Prior core violations were not corrected, including a leaking three-compartment faucet, greasy floors, and missing light shield.

headline: 75 rat droppings; chorizo held without variance
summary: Failed. About 75 rat droppings were found in basement storage. Chorizo cured at room temperature lacked an approved variance and food safety plan; it is held and may not be sold. Deli foods lacked discard date labels.

headline: Burned-out hood light and dark restroom
summary: Re-inspection found a non-working light in a middle prep hood on the first floor, and a dark second-floor women's washroom near the front door. Staff were told to replace the light and brighten the washroom.

headline: No certified manager; dish machine not sanitizing
summary: Failed. No certified manager was on site; dish machine sanitizer read 0 ppm (tag removed before repair). More than 15 small flies were found in bar and kitchen. Staff dumped wastewater into the dish machine; citation issued.

headline: Blocked handsink; dirty ice machine; cardboard cutting board
summary: Failed. A prep handsink was blocked by a bucket, removed during inspection. Ice machine had excessive pink and brown residue; ice was to be discarded. Also noted: improperly stored wiping cloths, stained cutting boards, and cardboard used for cutting.

headline: Over 20 mouse droppings; live fly found
summary: Failed. Over 20 mouse droppings were in the rear liquor storage closet, and more were near to-go containers on shelves. One live house fly was on a prep-area cutting board. Staff must eliminate all pest evidence; citation issued.

headline: No valid certificate; sinks lacked soap and towels
summary: Failed. No valid food sanitation certificate, employee health policy, or vomit cleanup kit was on site. Handsinks lacked soap, towels, and signs. Walk-in cooler air reached 66.6°F, and dish machine showed no sanitizer.

headline: Undated ready-to-eat foods held over 24 hours
summary: Ready-to-eat foods held over 24 hours (chicken with mole, tamales, salsas) lacked date marks; citation issued. Also: unlabeled bulk containers, torn cooler gasket, frozen meat in plastic grocery bags, missing food handler certificates, and an expired allergen certificate.

headline: Milk and soda crates used inside walk-in cooler
summary: Plastic soda crates or milk crates were used for elevation inside the walk-in cooler. Staff were told not to use them, for easy cleaning access.

headline: Food handler ate in prep area; faucet leak
summary: A food handler was preparing to eat in the front food prep area and was told not to; the food item was discarded. A leaking faucet on the first-floor three-compartment sink must be repaired.

headline: Peeling plastic on sink; washroom needs lidded bin
summary: Peeling protective plastic on the exterior of the three-compartment sink must be removed. The co-ed washroom must have a waste receptacle with a lid.

headline: No backflow device at mop sink
summary: The mop sink faucet has no backflow prevention device. One must be installed where it can be located, serviced, and maintained.

headline: No certified manager; 10-15 rodent droppings found
summary: Failed. No certified manager was present 8:15-8:40 AM while chicken was prepared. About 10-15 rodent droppings were near the water tank; more pest control was required. Also: milk crates for shelving, duct tape on a cooler, and expired food handler certificates.

headline: Live roaches found; sanitizer initially at 0 ppm
summary: Failed. Live roaches were on top of the dish machine; pest control service is required. Sanitizer read 0 ppm until staff reconnected its tubes; now 100 ppm, corrected on site. Floors under the dish machine need cleaning.

headline: Restroom handsink lacked hot water; soap missing
summary: Restroom handsink had no hot water; temperatures were 57-72°F, below the required 100°F. Corrected on 3/27/24, now at 100°F. Soap was missing and must be provided; missing paper towels were corrected on site.

headline: Rat droppings and no advisory on undercooked food
summary: Failed. Over 20 rat droppings were found in basement food prep and dry storage; pest control advised. Steak and eggs served undercooked lacked a consumer advisory on the menu. Basement handsink lacked soap. Food stored on floors needs raising.

headline: Missing freezer thermometers; heavily soiled floors
summary: Freezer equipment lacked interior ambient air thermometers. Floors under cold-holding equipment and ice machine, and floors, walls, and gas lines behind the main cook line were heavily soiled. A certified food manager lacked allergen training.

headline: Rear door gap; stained boards; leaking sink pipes
summary: The rear prep door has a 1/4-inch gap at the bottom that must be repaired. Knives were stored between prep coolers. Cutting boards are heavily stained, the upright freezer has excessive ice, and small leaks are under the bar's three-compartment sink.

headline: No health policy; no allergen certificate for manager
summary: No written employee health policy was on the premises; each employee must sign one. The basement employee washroom lacked a covered waste receptacle. The certified food manager has no allergen training certificate.

headline: Washroom door closer broken; no covered receptacle
summary: The inmate washroom's self-closing door device is broken and must be provided and maintained. The washroom also lacks a covered waste receptacle.

headline: Bulk dry food containers lacked labels
summary: Several bulk dry food containers in the basement lacked labels with the common food name. Staff must label all bulk dry containers and keep labels in place.

headline: No health policy; unsealed wood; door not self-closing
summary: No written employee health policy was on premises; each employee must have a signed one. Raw wood surfaces in the dish area must be sealed or painted. The unisex washroom door lacks a self-closing device, and wet mops need a hanging system.

headline: Food handlers without hair restraints; sticky floors
summary: Employees preparing food in the prep area wore no hair restraints or protection and must wear them at all times. Serving plates on kitchen shelves must be inverted. Floors along walls and under equipment were sticky and need cleaning.

headline: No handsink in rear prep; missing consumer advisory
summary: Failed. Rear prep and dishwashing area has no handwashing sink; one must be installed with hot and cold water, soap, towels, and signs. Menu lacked a raw-food advisory. Also: torn cooler gasket, broken floor tiles, missing light shields.

headline: Boxed food on floor; handlers lack hair restraints
summary: Boxed food was stored on the rear prep floor and must be raised 6 inches. Several food handlers were preparing food without hair restraints. Also noted: rusty racks, debris under cooking equipment, and a manager without allergen training.

headline: Three-compartment sink backs up; wall hole
summary: Failed. The three-compartment sink backs up: when the first compartment drains, dirty water flows into the other compartments. A citation was issued. Person in charge must repair it. Hole in wall near slicer storage must be repaired.

headline: Live flies and droppings; cold foods too warm
summary: Failed. About 15 live fruit flies and about 50 droppings were found in the basement; pest control service is recommended. Cold foods at 65-68°F were discarded, and the upstairs prep cooler was tagged. The basement handsink had no paper towels.

headline: Only one sink stopper; one employee untrained
summary: Only one working sink stopper was available for the three-compartment sink; all compartments need stoppers. A utility sink faucet leaks. One of three employees lacked food handler training, and no allergen training certificates were on site.

headline: Rat droppings and rodent activity in kitchen
summary: Failed. Rodent activity was found in the main kitchen and behind the water heater; about 20 rat droppings were behind chest freezers. Pest control service recommended; citation issued. Three-compartment sink drains very slowly and grease trap leaks.

headline: Grease buildup on cook line hood
summary: Grease has built up on the hood over the cook line. Staff must clean it and keep it in good condition.

headline: No food handler training; chest freezer needs defrosting
summary: Food handler training must be provided for all employees. A splash guard is needed at the hand sink beside the three-compartment sink. The chest freezer needs defrosting and cleaning, and greasy floors need cleaning.

headline: Soiled wiping cloths on prep tables
summary: Soiled wiping cloths were stored on prep tables. Manager was told to keep them in sanitizing solution between uses.

headline: Leaking pipe and faucet under three-compartment sink
summary: Inspector found a leaky pipe under the three-compartment sink and a leaking faucet, which must be repaired. Manager was also told to provide sink stoppers for that sink.

headline: Food on freezer floor; timed faucet fails
summary: Food was stored on the walk-in freezer floor and must be raised 6 inches. Single-service items were not inverted and containers were on the rear storage floor. The women's washroom timed faucet must run 15 seconds per use; its drain pipe leaks.

headline: No outside dumpster; greasy ground; utensils in food
summary: Failed. A prior violation remains: no outside dumpster, and grease covers the ground by the grease container; citation issued. Ladles were stored in food in a cooler; a bowl sat in dry beans. Also: cardboard shelving and stained cutting boards.

headline: Live roaches, rodent droppings, and flies found
summary: Failed. About 22 live cockroaches, 50 rodent droppings, and 10 live flies were found in production and prep areas; citation issued. Also: ingredients stored on the floor, sticky residue on floors, and a garage door not rodent-proof.

headline: Missing handsink sign, sink stoppers, light shields
summary: Re-inspection found no handwashing sign at the rear handsink, missing stoppers for the three-compartment sink, and damaged light shields in the prep area. Manager was told to provide and replace each item.

headline: Spatula in handsink, corrected; ice bins uncovered
summary: A spatula in the bar handsink was removed during inspection (corrected). Ice bins lacked covers, and a beverage handsink lacked splash guards. Also: a leaking valve, low restroom water pressure, clutter, and no allergen training for two certified managers.

headline: No current pest control records; no test strips
summary: Failed. No current pest control report was available; the last was dated 8-30-23. No test strips were on site to check sanitizer strength. Raw wood shelving must be sealed. A prior floor-cleaning violation was not corrected.

headline: Dirty prep cooler, dusty hood, damaged handsink knob
summary: The top shelf of the prep cooler and cooking equipment exteriors need cleaning, and floors around cooking equipment need cleaning. Hood and filters are dusty. The front handsink knob is in poor repair.

headline: Previous allergen training violation not corrected
summary: A previous violation was not corrected: a food service manager still has no allergen training certificate. The manager was instructed to obtain it; citation issued.

headline: Dirty walk-in coolers; leaking faucet; no lidded bin
summary: Dry storage shelving and walk-in cooler interiors must be cleaned to remove spills and debris, and floors cleaned. A loose faucet base at the front two-compartment sink leaks and must be repaired. Women's washroom needs a small lidded trash can.

headline: Soap missing at handsink; food stored on floor
summary: Failed. Kitchen handsink lacked soap; the manager provided it on site and a citation was issued. Food containers were on the kitchen floor and must be raised 6 inches. Large pots don't fit the three-compartment sink; stoppers are missing.

headline: No food handler proof for one male employee
summary: No proof of food handler training was on site for the male food handler. Staff must meet the requirement for all food handlers.

headline: No covered trash cans in restrooms
summary: Women's and all-gender restrooms lacked covered trash receptacles. Staff must provide and keep them covered at all times.

headline: No physical manager certificate; food handler training missing
summary: Failed. No certified manager with a physical certificate was on site; only an image was shown. No employee health policy was found. Several prior core violations were not corrected, including food handler training proof.

headline: Food stored on floors; large pots not sanitized
summary: Food containers stored on floors must be raised 6 inches. Dirty wiping cloths sat on prep tables. Large pots don't fit the three-compartment sink. Also: unlabeled food, a leaking faucet, holes sealed with sponges, and employee belongings beside food.

headline: No backflow preventer on dish-area utility sink
summary: Utility sink in the dish area lacks a backflow preventer. Inspector instructed installation so the device can be located, serviced, and maintained.

headline: No vendor records for frozen salmon
summary: No written agreement from the salmon vendor was on site showing the fish was frozen to -4°F for at least 7 days, as required. Manager was told to obtain the documentation.

headline: No backflow device on ice machine waterline
summary: The ice machine waterline has no backflow prevention device. One must be installed where it can be located, serviced, and maintained.

headline: Trash lacks lid; missing hood light
summary: Women's restroom trash can had no lid. A light in the hood system was missing. Certified manager on duty had no allergen training certificate on site.

headline: Rear door knob missing; rusty walk-in shelving
summary: Rear door is missing its knob (a towel is stuffed in the hole), and an outside gate gap is covered with plastic; both must be repaired to keep pests out. Walk-in shelving is rusty, and a drain elbow leaks.

headline: Unfinished wood, unused items, broken bathroom ventilation
summary: Inspector found unfinished wood shelving in basement storage, unused items near the electrical room that could hide pests, and inoperable ventilation in both toilet rooms. Manager was instructed to fix each.

headline: Rear door not rodent-proof; bar surface damaged
summary: Rear exit door has a 1/2-inch gap underneath and is not rodent or insect proofed; it must be sealed. The lower surface of the front bar is in poor repair and must be fixed and maintained.

headline: Cold ground beef and hamburgers held at 50°F
summary: Cooked ground beef at 50.8°F and hamburgers at 50.9°F were held above the 41°F limit; about 9 pounds ($100) were discarded and a citation issued. Also: no thermometer in cheesecake fridge, a torn gasket, and raw wood shelves.

headline: About 32 live cockroaches; repeat pest violation
summary: Failed. About 32 live cockroaches were found in the oven, walls, storage racks, and a cooler motor area; the previous pest violation was not corrected. Additional pest control service is needed. Also: food debris on floors and equipment, and greasy exhaust hood.

headline: Chlorine test kit missing; summary not posted
summary: Failed. Prior violations not corrected: no chlorine test kit for the three-compartment sink, and the latest inspection summary was not posted. Ice machine has brown buildup; cutting boards have deep cuts and stains.

headline: No public summary posted; standing water
summary: No inspection summary was posted for public view; citation issued. Also: standing water in the men's employee toilet, two broken unused coolers, and grease inside the fryer cabinet.

headline: Uninverted containers; soiled cardboard; greasy filters
summary: Single-service containers and utensils were not inverted, and soiled cardboard was on floors and shelves. Food spills and debris were in cooking equipment and coolers. Openings in walls and ceilings must be sealed, and filters need cleaning.

headline: Food boxes on floor; grease and debris buildup
summary: Boxed food was stored on the floor and must be raised 6 inches. Cardboard shelf liners must be removed. Food debris and grease built up on equipment and coolers; ceiling panels over the three-compartment sink are damaged; floors need cleaning.

headline: No certified manager; no food handler training
summary: No person in charge had a valid certificate, and no certified manager was present while foods that must be kept hot or cold were prepared. No paper towels at handsinks; turkeys stored on freezer floor.

headline: Dead roaches and water bugs; leaking faucet
summary: Dead water bugs throughout the basement and dead roaches under the dish machine must be removed. Also: missing handwashing sign, leaking three-compartment faucet, rusty shelving, debris on floors, and a dusty vent cover.

headline: No food handler certificate; missing handwash sign
summary: A food handler had no certificate, and the certified manager lacked an allergen training certificate. Front prep handsink lacks signage. Ice machine has debris, the espresso machine lacks an accessible backflow device, and floor drains are dirty.

headline: Mold-like buildup dripped onto ice
summary: Mold-like buildup inside the ice machine dripped onto ice used for drinks. Ice was discarded and the machine cleaned on site; citation issued. Also: debris on basement coolers, peeling baseboards, and splatters in rear prep.

headline: Cold foods held at 45-51°F; cooler tagged
summary: Several cold foods held at 45-51°F, above the 41°F limit, were discarded (about 37 pounds). The display cooler ran at 45-48°F and was tagged. Citation issued.

headline: No handwashing signs; no food handler training proof
summary: Employee restrooms lacked handwashing signs. Standing water under the three-compartment sink must be removed. The facility could not show food handler training proof for handlers on site.

headline: Dirty floor drains and hood filters
summary: Black dirt has built up inside floor drains and food debris is on ventilation hood filters. Both must be cleaned and maintained.

headline: Blocked handsink; shellstock tags; utensils in still water
summary: Bar handsink was blocked by personal items and empty containers, cleared during inspection. Soap was missing and supplied on site. Also: missing handwashing signs, shellstock tags missing sale dates, utensils in room-temperature water, a leaking faucet, and worn cooler gaskets.

headline: Beef stew held at 57.4°F; discarded
summary: About 40 pounds of beef stew held in the walk-in cooler at 57.4°F was above the 41°F limit and was discarded (valued at $200); citation issued. Rear alley door was propped open, and cloth towels were used to dry plates.

headline: Milk crates used for elevation; damaged ceiling tiles
summary: Soiled milk crates were used to raise cased beverages and must be replaced with dunnage racks or equipment keeping items at least 6 inches up. Several ceiling tiles front and rear were soiled, missing, or in poor repair.

headline: No certified manager while beef and chicken served
summary: No certified food service manager was on site while foods that must be kept hot or cold, such as beef and chicken, were handled and served. Manager was instructed to obtain one; priority violation noted.

headline: Greasy fryers and floors; expired allergen certificate
summary: Clean fryer and prep cooler exteriors, floors under cooking equipment (grease and standing water), and dusty washroom vent cover. Food handlers must obtain training, and one manager's allergen certificate was expired.

headline: Leaks at sink and ceiling; dirty hood filters
summary: The three-compartment sink faucet base leaks and must be repaired. A damaged, leaking ceiling tile near the hot water tank must be fixed. Filters and hood above cooking equipment are dirty and must be cleaned.

headline: Wiping cloths not in sanitizer; no training proof
summary: Wiping cloths in the prep area must be kept in sanitizing solution between uses. No proof of food handler training or certificates was provided for all required employees; this must be provided.

headline: Eyewash stations attached to handwashing sinks
summary: Failed. Several handwashing sinks in the deli, bakery, and meat areas had eyewash stations attached. Manager must remove them and use sinks only for handwashing. This is a priority violation with a citation.

headline: Cardboard in drink cooler; wall openings; light shields
summary: Cardboard lined shelves in a cold-hold unit holding drinks and must be removed. Wall openings around pipes and vents above the furnace closet need sealing. A mop was improperly stored, and employee washroom and furnace area bulbs lacked shields.

headline: Hot water flow and missing thermometer
summary: Hand sink faucet must run for at least 15 seconds without reactivation. A cold holding unit in the front area lacked an air thermometer. Minor items; no pests or food temperature problems were noted.

headline: Reach-in coolers in poor repair; no thermometers
summary: Reach-in coolers not in good repair; manager told to correct them so proper temperatures are maintained. All reach-in coolers need thermometers. All food handlers need food handler certificates.

headline: Peeling plastic on oven; soiled slicer and dispenser
summary: Sandwich oven exterior has peeling plastic wrap; must be removed and surfaces kept smooth. Deli meat slicer and coffee dispenser have dried food debris and must be cleaned. Hand soap removed from a non-hand-washing sink.

headline: No health policy; no food handler certificates
summary: No employee health policy or vomit and diarrhea cleanup kit and procedure on site. Raw wood shelving must be sealed. Women's restroom trash has no lid. Broken urinal floor, water-stained ceiling tiles. Food handlers lack certificates.

headline: Over 100 mouse droppings; no certified manager
summary: No valid food sanitation manager or certificate when TCS food was prepared and served. Over 100 mouse droppings on floors, equipment and in cooler bottoms. Numerous flying insects in prep area. Citations issued; report summary not posted for customers.

headline: No certified manager on site
summary: No certified manager on site at inspection. No food was being prepared, served or sold at the time, so no citation was issued. A certified manager must be on site whenever food is prepared and served.

headline: Uncovered food on floor; damaged gasket
summary: Uncovered food stored on the floor in walk-in cooler and freezer; manager told to cover and raise it six inches. Damaged freezer gasket and ice build-up. Pots too large for sink. Leaking sink faucet and drain line need repair.

headline: Dish machine not sanitizing; tagged out of use
summary: Low-temperature dish machine had 0 ppm sanitizer and was not sanitizing equipment. Machine is tagged and must not be used until the Chicago Department of Public Health reinspects it. Citation issued.

headline: No three-compartment sink on premises
summary: No three-compartment sink on the premises to wash, rinse and sanitize utensils. Management was told to install one. Priority violation cited.

headline: Unapproved sausage source; citation issued
summary: Found 20 lbs of unlabeled, vacuum-packed dry sausage from an unapproved source; manager said it was made at home. Food must come only from licensed facilities. Citation issued. Meat slicer unclean; restroom door not self-closing.

headline: 60+ rat droppings; no certified manager on duty
summary: No City-certified food manager on duty while TCS food was cooked and served. Over 60 rat droppings by the stove and in rear storage. Pest control service required before reinspection. Clogged mop sink; one washroom broken; unsigned health policies.

headline: Cardboard liners; rust; leaking sink faucet
summary: Cardboard used as shelf liners near locked liquor cabinets; remove. Rust on storage racks in several areas. Broken three-compartment sink stopper and leaking hot water faucet. Heavy grease behind meat fryers. Broken walk-in light shield.

headline: General upkeep issues in second-floor storage
summary: Second-floor storage area has debris on window sills, peeling paint, cracks and openings in walls and ceilings, and water damage. Missing light shields and end caps. These are building upkeep items only.

headline: Insect control devices too close to food
summary: Insect control devices in the walk-in cooler were close to packaged milk and lunch meat; must be moved to avoid contamination. Hand soap and paper towels were at a sink used for warewashing; they must be kept only at hand-washing sinks.

headline: Unshielded light fixtures; dusty exhaust filters
summary: Three of four exhaust lights lacked protective shielding. One light missing or not working in prep area. Overhead exhaust filters heavily soiled with dust. Manager lacks complete allergen training.

headline: Chips stored in unused restroom; minor leaks
summary: Boxes of chips stored inside an unused washroom; manager told to remove them. Minor leak under rear hand sink and a leaking faucet on the three-compartment sink; manager told to repair.

headline: No backflow device on ice machine; dirty floors
summary: No backflow prevention device on the ice machine water line; one must be installed and made visible. Excessive dirt under ice machine, reach-in coolers and bulk soda shelving. Missing floor tiles at utility sink and damaged wall cover.

headline: No certified manager when opened; no allergen certificate
summary: No certified food manager on site when the business was open. A manager arrived later, but the original certificate was not posted. Certified manager must be on site with the certificate posted at all times. No allergen training certificate on site.

headline: No hot water at three-compartment sink; citation
summary: No hot running water initially. Sink measured 105.1°F, below the 110°F required. Hot water restored on site before inspection ended. Priority citation issued. Employee washroom lacks a covered receptacle and has a rough ceiling.

headline: Fly traps above ice maker
summary: Fly traps installed above the basement ice maker. Instructed to remove them. No other items were noted.

headline: Clutter at prep table near sushi bar
summary: Clutter on a prep table near the sushi bar. Unnecessary items must be removed from the premises and the area organized. This was the only item noted.

headline: No hand-wash sign; broken sink handle
summary: No hand-washing sign at a prep-area sink. Broken hand sink handle in employee restroom. Dust on walk-in cooler fan, light shields, and wall and ceiling vents must be cleaned. Manager lacks allergen training certificate.

headline: No certified manager; no vomit cleanup supplies
summary: Person in charge lacks proof of food safety manager training. No valid certified manager on site while seafood and cooked vegetables were prepared. No vomit or diarrhea cleanup supplies or procedure. Leaking sanitizing basin. Citation issued.

headline: Slow drain; missing ceiling tiles and light shield
summary: Very slow drainage at basement three-compartment sink; priority item, must be repaired. Missing ceiling tiles above basement dish machine. Missing light shield in main dish room.

headline: Rat infestation: live rat and 70+ droppings
summary: One live rat and about 70 or more rat droppings found in hallways, stair areas, and Suite 7. Open rodent bait traps found. No sanitizer for dishwashing; sanitizer was delivered during inspection. Hood not working; wall openings must be sealed.

headline: Rodent droppings and live flies found
summary: About 25 small rodent droppings in dining area beverage cabinet. 22 live black flies in rear prep area and near the entrance. Pest control required; citation issued. Food and syrup spills in cooler and cabinet; water pooling under dishwasher.

headline: Clutter on basement storage floor
summary: Clutter stored on the floor in the basement storage area. Manager must remove unused articles and equipment to prevent pest harborage. This was the only item noted.

headline: Rusty, dirty walk-in shelves; plates not inverted
summary: Rusty, dirty shelves inside walk-in coolers must be cleaned, repainted or replaced. Serving plates stored uninverted, risking dust. Floors along walls and under the stove and dry storage need cleaning.

headline: Rusted racks; moldy caulking; restroom waste lid
summary: Chipped paint and rust on wire racks in a rear cooler; must be repainted or replaced. Blackened, moldy caulking along the rear dish machine area must be replaced. Restroom needs a covered waste receptacle.

headline: No hand-washing sink in rear prep area
summary: No hand-washing sink in a convenient location in the rear prep area. Manager was told to install one. Heavy debris build-up behind the ice machine; manager told to clean it.

headline: Live roaches found; no certified manager
summary: Manager on site lacked City food manager certification while chicken and coleslaw were prepared. Live roaches, too many to count, at the front counter, plus about 10 near rear dish area. Pest service required before 01/06/2026. Citation issued.

headline: Food on floor in cooler and freezer
summary: Food items stored on the floor in walk-in cooler and freezer; must be raised six inches. Unlabeled food and spices outside original containers. Debris on floors in utility and storage areas. Dust inside walk-in cooler.

headline: No certified manager during deli prep
summary: No City-certified food manager on premises while deli meats and cheese were prepared. Certified manager with original certificate must be present. Three-compartment sink missing a stopper. Food debris build-up inside an unused cooler.

headline: No City-certified manager; expired food handler cards
summary: Person in charge lacked a valid City food manager certificate; a ServSafe certificate was shown. Food handlers lacked hair restraints, corrected on site. All food handler certificates found expired.

headline: Greasy exhaust hood; missing food handler training
summary: Exhaust hood had grease and ash build-up beyond the filters; must be cleaned. One food handler lacked food handler training. A City sanitation manager lacked allergen training. Both must be provided.

headline: No vomit cleanup supplies; rodent entry gap
summary: No procedure or supplies for vomit and diarrhea cleanup. Front door gap could let rodents in. No hand-washing sign at restroom sink. Also dust, chipped paint, damaged floor tiles and missing lid on a restroom trash can. No pests were found.

headline: Improper storage; dried food on equipment and floors
summary: Kitchenware stored improperly on prep-area shelves; must be inverted. Cooler door gaskets are worn. Cooling unit interiors and equipment need cleaning. A restroom sink did not run for 20 seconds. Floors under equipment have dried food debris.

headline: Water leak under three-compartment sink
summary: Water on the floor, possibly from a tank under the three-compartment sink. The source of the leak must be found and repaired.

headline: No hot water at dish room hand sink
summary: Dish room hand sink had no hot water; it must provide at least 100°F. Knife and wiping cloths stored in water at 88°F. Open drinking cup in prep area. Mixing bowls not inverted. Cracked floor tiles, ceiling openings, and cluttered basement.

headline: No chemical sanitizer; no training proof
summary: No chemical sanitizers to sanitize equipment and utensils; must be available during all hours of operation. Citation issued. No proof of food handler training or allergen training for food handlers and certified managers.

headline: About 25 mouse droppings; food held too warm
summary: About 25 or more mouse droppings in rear prep area near coolers and grease trap. Rear exit door not rodent-proof. No certified manager on site during inspection. Cooked rice, noodles and chicken held at 65-108°F; about 68 lbs discarded. Citation issued.

headline: No health policy; ceiling tiles and clutter
summary: No written employee health policy on premises; a signed policy is required for each employee. Missing and water-damaged ceiling tiles, uncovered restroom trash, clutter in dry storage, and dirty floor under shelving need fixing.

headline: No hand-wash signage; no thermometers
summary: No hand-washing sign at the dishwashing sink; must be provided. Reach-in coolers need thermometers. No allergen training on site for managers; they must complete training and keep the certificate on site.

headline: No certified manager; cold foods too warm
summary: No certified food manager while TCS foods were prepared and served; citation issued. No written employee health policy. Chicken at 54°F and other cold foods at 44-47°F. Food handler without hair restraint or certificate. Ashtray found in food prep area.

headline: Food stored on freezer floor; mold in produce cooler
summary: Some food stored on floor of walk-in freezer; must be raised. Mold-like substance on produce cooler walls and ceiling; must be cleaned. Floors, walls and equipment under cooking areas and refrigeration need cleaning.

headline: Torn gaskets; expired food handler certificates
summary: Soiled linens stored in open containers on the patio. Torn coffee grinder bumper and cracked plastic containers must be replaced. Torn cooler door gaskets. Black substance on walk-in cooler seams. Several employees have expired food handler certificates.

headline: Front door gap; no restroom trash can
summary: Front double doors have a 1/4-inch gap underneath, so they are not rodent- or insect-proof. Unisex restroom has no trash receptacle; a receptacle with a lid must be provided.

headline: Rust inside ice machine; citation issued
summary: Rust on upper interior of an ice machine used for human consumption. Ice must be destroyed and machine cleaned and sanitized. Citation issued April 23, 2025. Milk crates used to elevate boxes; stained ceiling tiles in rear prep area.

headline: No raw-food advisory on menu; citation issued
summary: Menu lacks a consumer advisory for raw or undercooked eggs and beef burgers; must be provided. Citation issued. Milk crates used for elevation, and food must be six inches off floor. Grease and debris on cooking equipment.

headline: No sanitizer test strips; damaged insulation
summary: No sanitizer test strips for the three-compartment sink; must be obtained. Damaged insulation around walk-in cooling lines must be replaced.

headline: Dish machine not sanitizing; cold hand sinks
summary: Basement restroom hand sinks measured 72-80°F; fixed on site to 102-105°F. Low-temperature dish machine had 0 ppm sanitizer; tagged and not to be used until reinspected. Milk crates used as shelving. Upstairs restrooms lack covered receptacles.

headline: Unlabeled container; leaks; debris under equipment
summary: Unlabeled container near the pizza machine. Mop sink faucet leaks. Items on basement freezer floor must be raised six inches. Dirt and food debris under food areas could attract pests. Light covers missing over hood and stove.

headline: Employee eating in food prep area
summary: Food handler ate a banana in the food prep area while wearing gloves. Managers told staff to eat only in designated areas. Cardboard was used under cooking equipment and was removed. Restroom trash receptacle lacked a cover.

headline: Food boxes on freezer floor; missing certificates
summary: Food boxes stored on the walk-in freezer floor must be six inches off the floor. Missing hand-wash signs. Restroom trash lacks a lid and self-closing door is broken. Several food handlers lack food handler certificates.

headline: Unlabeled chemical cleaner container
summary: Chemical cleaning solution in a working container lacked a common-name label. Working containers taken from bulk supplies must be individually labeled. Citation issued.

headline: Sewage backup; food temperature and hygiene violations
summary: Sewage backed up from a floor drain in the guacamole prep area; area closed, repair ordered. Hot food at 109-121°F and cold raw ribs at 55-70°F were discarded. Raw oysters lacked tags. Hand sinks lacked drying towels, now supplied.

headline: Dirty wiping cloths on counters and floors
summary: Wet, dirty wiping cloths left on counters, prep tables and floors; must be kept in sanitizer. Broken cooler thermometer. Rusted walk-in shelving, missing floor tiles, and cardboard under floor mats must be fixed.

headline: Oversized pot can't be washed; floor water
summary: Oversized pot in basement cannot be submerged in the three-compartment sink. Remove it or provide an approved washing method. Basement floors have pooling water; leaks from walk-in coolers or freezers must be repaired.

headline: Dish machine tagged; sanitizer absent; mold in ice
summary: Dish machine sanitizer measured 0 ppm; machine tagged and cannot be used until reinspected. Prep hand sink water was 86.4°F, fixed on site to 100-101°F. Mold-like substance touched ice. Torn gaskets, greasy fryer, and missing allergen certificate.

headline: Torn walk-in cooler gasket
summary: Torn gasket on the walk-in cooler door. Must be repaired or replaced. This was the only item noted.

headline: Missing food handler certificates; expired allergen training
summary: No food handler certificates on the premises. Proof of training must be shown for all food handling employees. The certified food manager had an expired allergen training certificate. Must provide and maintain.

headline: Cold foods too warm; citations issued
summary: Several cold foods measured 44.6-46.6°F. About 30 lbs, worth $275, discarded on site. Service cooler at 47.6°F; told not to use until fixed. Hand sink lacked paper towels. Food stored on freezer floors. Managers lack allergen training.

headline: Missing thermometers; ripped cooler gasket
summary: Some coolers lack working thermometers; they must be provided. Ripped rubber door gasket on a two-door reach-in cooler must be replaced or repaired. No pests or food temperature problems were noted.

headline: Chorizo too warm in refrigerator
summary: Chorizo in the refrigerator measured 47.7°F, above the 41°F limit. Manager voluntarily discarded 1.5 lbs, worth $15. Priority citation issued.

headline: Rodent droppings; no hot water at prep sink
summary: About 20-30 rodent droppings throughout the back of the prep cooler; citation issued and pest service required. Hand sink measured 74.5°F, not the 100°F minimum; priority violation cited.

headline: Dog on premises; cold foods too warm; citations
summary: No certified manager at start while chicken and beef were cooked; corrected on site when manager arrived. Dog in dining room; removed. Cold foods at 48.6-50.7°F discarded. Vacuum-packaging rules not met; two units tagged. Hand soap missing at prep sink.

headline: Cold hand sink; dead insects; no food handler training
summary: Rear prep hand sink had no hot water (56.2°F); citation issued. Dead insects on glue boards in prep and basement areas. Uncovered pastries and food on walk-in floors. Milk crates used as shelving. No food handler training for employees.

headline: Many cleaning problems; dish machine out of use
summary: Many cleaning problems: greasy hood vents, soiled cooking equipment, rusty shelves, food stored on floor, unprotected utensils, and dirty floors and walls. Dish machine is not in good repair and is not in use. Hand-wash signs needed.

headline: Clean prep tables, walls, and ceiling tiles
summary: Prep tables and hot holding units above the service island need cleaning. Walls of the food prep area need cleaning, and stained ceiling tiles must be cleaned. Only upkeep items noted.

headline: Dead gnats, flies and ants in dining areas
summary: Build-up of dead gnats, flies and ants on dining room floors and window sills. Dead pests must be removed regularly to prevent more pests. Greasy deep fryer interiors, loose faucet handles, and damaged base coving also noted.

headline: No health policy; gap under rear door
summary: No written employee health policy on premises. About 1-inch gap under rear exit door must be closed to prevent pests. Leaks at three-compartment sink; wastewater backs up, a priority violation. Coffee machine lacks a backflow device.

headline: Excess ice and grease on grill and fryers
summary: Excessive ice inside deep freezer must be removed. Excessive grease and food debris on sides of flat-top grill and fryer must be detail cleaned. Wall behind microwave has excessive grease and debris.

headline: No hair restraints; rusty prep tables; spills
summary: Food handlers not wearing hair restraints. Soiled wiping cloths on prep table. Rusted bottoms of prep tables and racks. Equipment too large for three-compartment sink. Spills and debris on cooking equipment and water on prep floors.

headline: Missing hand-wash signs; loose exterior door
summary: No hand-washing signs at exposed prep-area sinks. Exterior door near basement not tight fitting, which could allow pests in; repair ordered. Peeling paint on basement dry storage walls.

headline: Unlabeled containers; improper utensil and food storage
summary: Containers lacked common-name labels for chocolate, ketchup, sprinkles, nuts and coconut. Wiping cloths and tongs stored improperly. Food kept in plastic grocery bags in a cold unit. No allergen training certificate posted for the manager.

headline: Unlabeled bins; food stored on floor
summary: Flour and sugar bins in the rear prep area lacked labels. Boxed food stored on the floor throughout the rear prep area must be raised six inches. Cardboard used as shelf liners. Basement clutter must be organized and raised off the floor.

headline: Greasy racks, slow drains, and basement clutter
summary: Minimal build-up inside ice machine; clean it. Greasy pot storage racks, slow-draining hand sinks, and grease on walls and floors need cleaning. Microwaves and unused items in basement must be removed to prevent pest harborage.

headline: No certified manager; cold foods too warm
summary: No certified food manager on site at arrival. Swiss cheese at 46°F and diced tomatoes at 48°F, above the 41°F limit, were discarded. Hand-sink splash onto prep counter. Previous rusted shelving violations not fixed.

headline: Walk-in cooler floors and walls need cleaning
summary: Floors and walls inside the walk-in cooler must be cleaned to remove spills and debris. This was the only item noted.

headline: Food handled without certified manager; mold found
summary: Staff handled raw chicken, sauce and ham without a certified manager on site. Black mold behind a sink, food debris in coolers, missing wall base, and no food handler training certificates. Some coolers lack thermometers.

headline: Blocked hand sinks; no soap; leaks; citations
summary: Two of three exposed hand sinks blocked by bins; items removed when notified. Soap missing at a hand sink, provided when notified. Front door not tight at bottom, a pest entry risk. Sinks cannot fully shut off.

headline: No pest control logbook; citation issued
summary: No pest control logbook on premises. Must provide a licensed pest logbook with at least two pest inspection reports per year. Citation issued. Unfixed items: unnecessary basement items and no proof of allergen training for certified managers.

headline: Dirty toilet bowls; soiled mop heads
summary: Dirty toilet bowls in both washrooms; instructed to clean. Soiled mop heads must be stored inverted or hanging at the utility sink. Manager corrected the mop-head issue during inspection.

headline: Ice bins uncovered; missing splash guards and prep sinks
summary: Ice bins in three bars lacked lids, and several hand sinks lacked splash guards, risking ice contamination. Bars have no prep sink. Backflow devices on coffee machines could not be verified. Manager was told to fix all items.

headline: Wet wiping cloths on tables; missing light shields
summary: Wet wiping cloths stored on prep tables and cutting boards; must be stored in sanitizer. Light shield above three-compartment sink is missing and cook line shield broken. Inadequate lighting in prep and dish areas. Floors and walls need cleaning.

headline: Missing allergen training certificate
summary: One employee with a City food sanitation certificate had no allergen awareness training certificate on site. Proof of allergen training must be provided for all such employees.

headline: Broken thermometers; rusted shelves; poor lighting
