summary: Broken thermometers in front prep refrigerators must be replaced. Rusted shelving inside a Coca-Cola cooler. Uncovered garbage in women's restroom. Floors around cooking equipment need cleaning. Burned-out bulbs in rear prep area.

headline: No manager certificate posted; old violations open
summary: No original City food manager certificate posted on site; citation issued. Previous core violations not fixed: no food handler certificates and no allergen certificates on site. Citation issued for unfixed core violations.

headline: Raw wood shelves; restroom needs waste cover
summary: Raw wood shelves above the three-compartment sink and in prep area must be painted or sealed. Interiors of prep coolers need cleaning. Washroom has no covered waste receptacle.

headline: Dead house flies; uncovered food and bowls
summary: About 5-10 dead house flies on the floor and shelves near the rear exit; remove and clean. Cornmeal stored uncovered, and a single-use bowl used as a scoop; these must be corrected. Plates and baskets not inverted. Leaking drain pipes.

headline: Dish machine sanitizing too cool; tagged
summary: Sanitizing rinse for high-temperature dish machine measured 152°F; it needs 180°F. Machine tagged and cannot be used until repaired. Citation issued. Bar dump sink lacks a partition; eye wash station on a hand sink must be removed.

headline: Missing labels and hair restraints; greasy surfaces
summary: Food handlers prepped food without hair restraints. Food in coolers and dry storage lacked name labels. Plates and pots not inverted. Mop not stored to dry, risking pest harborage. Floors, walls and cooler interiors need cleaning.

headline: Damaged gaskets; rusty tables; missing allergen proof
summary: Damaged gaskets on a two-door refrigerator must be repaired. Rust on bottoms of prep tables must be repainted or replaced. Leaking faucet bases at three-compartment sinks. Dirt and debris under shelving. No proof of manager allergen training.

headline: Floor build-up under sink and dishwasher
summary: Build-up on the floor under the three-compartment sink and dishwasher. Person in charge was told to clean and maintain the area. This was the only item noted.

headline: No hair restraints; expired food handler cards
summary: Food handlers in prep area without hair restraints. Dirt and stains in rice container. Thick grease on fryer doors. Dirt under heavy equipment, dusty ceiling tiles and vents, and greasy hood filters. All food handler certificates found expired.

headline: Back door needs rodent-proofing; food on floor
summary: Back storage door needs rodent-proofing; no pests were found. Food containers stored directly on the floor. Wiping cloths not kept in sanitizer. Ice machine interior, cooking equipment and floors need detail cleaning. Bulk foods need labels.

headline: Food stored in former detergent drum; citation
summary: Garlic sauce prepared and stored in a drum previously used for dishwashing detergent. About 15 lbs, worth $75, discarded and the drum removed. Citation issued. Unlabeled to-go sauces and puddings. Leaks at sink faucets.

headline: No pest logbook; no health policy
summary: No licensed pest control logbook on premises. No written employee health policy. No sink for food preparation at front coffee area. Leak under the front hand sink. Certified manager lacks allergen training certificate.

headline: No hand-wash signs; damaged cutting board
summary: No hand-washing signs in toilet rooms or at exposed sinks; must be provided. Cutting board in the front prep area has deep grooves and dark stains; refinish or replace. Only minor items noted.

headline: Restroom toilet cover missing; greasy hood filters
summary: Toilet in men's room needs a cover; must be replaced. Hood filters have grease build-up; must be cleaned. Only these items were noted.

headline: Overflowing dumpster; no handwashing signs
summary: Failed. No handwashing signage in washrooms. The outside dumpster overflowed with trash and was above its rim; priority citation was not issued. Soiled mop heads were not hung to dry and must be hung to prevent insect breeding.

headline: No vomit cleanup kit; no dish handsink
summary: Failed. No vomit and diarrhea cleanup kit or procedure on site; priority citation issued. No handwashing sink in the dishwashing area; soap and paper towels must be provided. Clutter in rear area of plates, utensils and boxes.

headline: No health policy; leaks; light and wall damage
summary: Passed with conditions. No written employee health policy on premises. Hot holding equipment was stored under unshielded sewer lines. Loose fryer door; hand sink leak; missing wall section exposing studs; hall and freezer lights out; exhaust hood light missing shield.

headline: Small gaps at rear door; passed
summary: Passed. Small gaps at the side and bottom of the rear exit door must be corrected to prevent pest entry. No pests were noted.

headline: Ice machine buildup; minor spills
summary: Passed. Slight pink buildup inside the basement ice machine must be cleaned. Minor food spills under the grill in the front prep area must be cleaned.

headline: Unapproved desserts and warm food discarded
summary: Passed with conditions, with citations. About 4 pounds of prepackaged desserts from an unapproved source were discarded. Coleslaw at 56.5F and raw chicken wings at 45.9F were discarded. Gap under rear door; no splashguard between prep and dish sinks.

headline: Hand sink signage missing; opening at rear door
summary: Passed. Missing handwashing signage, missing air thermometer in hot holding unit, and an opening at the bottom of the rear exit door (no pests noted). Food handlers lacked hair restraints. Cooking equipment stored in the employee toilet room. Certified manager lacked allergen certificate.

headline: Food on floor; broken dishwasher; passed
summary: Passed. Food containers were on floors in the walk-in cooler, prep and storage areas and must be raised 6 inches. A broken dishwasher was covered with a cloth towel and must be repaired or removed. Trash and debris littered the refuse area.

headline: Leaking dishwashing handsink; cracked tiles
summary: Passed. The dishwashing area handwashing sink faucet leaks and is very loose and must be repaired. Several cracked and damaged floor tiles in the dishwashing area and front service and cashier area must be repaired or replaced.

headline: Side door gap; toilet trash lids missing
summary: Passed. An approximately 1/4 inch gap at the bottom of the side door must be repaired. Trash receptacles in the toilet rooms are missing covers and must be provided.

headline: Dish machine not sanitizing; tagged
summary: Passed with conditions. The low-temperature dish machine did not sanitize at final rinse, with zero ppm chlorine. It is tagged and cannot be used until CDPH removes the tag. Frozen seafood was thawing in standing water; an unlabeled container was found above the three-compartment sink.

headline: No certified manager while handling eggs
summary: Passed with conditions. No certified food service manager was on site while eggs and milk were handled; priority citation required. Deli cups were not air dried and were used as scoops in bulk containers. Live potted plants were in the bar prep area.

headline: Cooler too warm; greasy equipment; conditions
summary: Passed with conditions. Two-door cooler air was 60F and must be repaired or removed. Handsink lacked easy access at the cook line, though the manager made a walkway. Cooking equipment had grease and grime; leaks and rust noted; washroom lacks covered receptacle.

headline: Roaches and flies found; no hot water
summary: Failed. Complaint inspection found 3 live roaches on walls, paper towels and mop closet floor, and 15-20 small flies. No hot running water at a handsink (46.8F). No soap or hand drying at multiple sinks; citation issued for unclean ice machine.

headline: Cold food too warm; handsinks cool; failed
summary: Failed. Hand sinks were 73.9-79.6F, below the required 100F. Cold TCS foods, including milk and pork, were at 50-58.8F; about 6 pounds ($40) discarded; priority citation issued. Ice machine rust, and openings at front door bases.

headline: Personal food in coolers; failed canvass inspection
summary: Failed. Personal food found in walk-in, prep and storage coolers; coolers lacked air thermometers; unlabeled containers; no splashguard at handwash sinks; cracked wall; manager lacked allergen training. Prior violation not corrected; citation issued.

headline: Black buildup in ice machine; failed complaint
summary: Failed. Black buildup inside the ice machine was above ice used for human consumption. Must be removed, cleaned and sanitized. Tableware was not inverted, and damaged wall tiles behind the ice machine must be repaired.

headline: Tall weeds and clutter in rear yard
summary: Passed. Complaint re-inspection found tall weeds and grass in the rear yard, crates and clutter in the rear storage area, and clutter at the service counter.

headline: Oatmeal held too warm; citation issued
summary: Passed with conditions. Oatmeal was held at 66F, too warm for cold food. The manager discarded 4 pounds ($8). Priority violation and citation issued.

headline: Cardboard floor liner; food in construction buckets
summary: Passed. Cardboard was reused as a floor liner and must not be. Orange construction buckets were used to store fries and must be replaced with food-grade containers. Floors under cooking equipment and rubber mats had minor debris.

headline: Sauces and TCS food too warm; citations
summary: Passed with conditions, with citations. Opened cocktail sauce, sour cream and tartar sauce were 45-46F in the prep cooler. Ranch and BBQ sauce sat at 70F outside refrigeration. The prep cooler air was 46F; it must hold 41F or below.

headline: Women's restroom lacks covered trash can
summary: Passed. The women's toilet room had no covered trash receptacle. The person in charge was told to provide one and maintain it.

headline: No certified manager for 20 minutes
summary: Passed with conditions, with citation. No certified manager was present from 8:55 to 9:15 AM while eggs were prepared. Cooked rice and potatoes in coolers lacked date labels; manager corrected on site. Torn gasket and soiled mop head.

headline: Mold, raw meat on racks; failed re-inspection
summary: Failed. Re-inspection found unlabeled sugar and spices, mold on cooler racks, old raw meat hanging over kabob storage, and a cutting board with deep cuts. Old violations uncorrected: torn rodent strip on rear door, greasy fryer. Consumer advisory missing; citation issued.

headline: No certified manager; test strips missing; failed
summary: Failed. No valid food sanitation certificate was posted or provided for the manager on duty while food was prepared and served; citation issued. No quaternary sanitizer test strips were available for the three-compartment sink. Washroom ventilation fan not working.

headline: Vacuum-packed meat without variance; tagged
summary: Passed with conditions, with citation. The facility vacuum-packaged cooked meat without a required variance or HACCP plan. The unit was tagged, and the manager voluntarily discarded 20 pounds ($300). Food debris was throughout storage and prep areas.

headline: Missing thermometer; condenser leak; failed
summary: Failed. Missing thermometer in the prep cooler, a condenser leak causing liquid on the cooler bottom, and an inoperable temperature gauge on the rear warewashing unit, which was not in use; priority citation issued. Manager lacked allergen training.

headline: Reheated food too cool; no vomit kit
summary: Passed with conditions, with citation. Pork at 102.5F, chicken at 125.5F and salmon at 107.2F were placed on a buffet after reheating; manager reheated above 135F. No vomit and diarrhea kit on site. No irreversible thermometer on site.

headline: No certified person in charge; many violations
summary: Failed. No valid food sanitation certificate was on site or posted. No written employee health policy, and no sanitizer on site until an employee bought it. No metal stem thermometer. Cutting boards are in very poor condition. Prior violation uncorrected.

headline: About 20 large flies found; failed
summary: Failed. Complaint inspection found about 20 large flies on the premises. The person in charge must eliminate the fly activity with a licensed pest control technician and sanitize all surfaces. Citation issued.

headline: Rat droppings found; pest control required
summary: Failed. About 10 rat droppings under the kitchen fryer and 10 more in cluttered basement storage. Additional pest control service is needed, and a priority citation was issued. Gap under basement door and no food handler or allergen training proof. Some signage corrected on site.

headline: Wet wiping cloths on prep surfaces; passed
summary: Passed. Wet wiping cloths were on prep surfaces throughout the rear prep area and must be stored in sanitizing solution. Accumulated food debris was in the reach-in coolers in the front seating area.

headline: Live flies found; sink leaking; failed
summary: Failed. About 10-20 live small flies were on walls, ceiling and shelving in the rear prep and dishwashing area. Pest control contact required; citation issued. Front three-compartment sink leaks heavily; debris around dumpster.

headline: Cardboard liners; no food handler certificates
summary: Passed. Re-inspection found cardboard and plastic liners on shelves, and food stored in an open evaporated milk can. A washroom door was not self-closing. Several food handlers lacked certificates, and the manager lacked allergen training.

headline: Torn gaskets and dusty fan guards; passed
summary: Passed. Torn gaskets on the inside of the upstairs pizza prep cooler must be repaired. Dust on walk-in cooler fan guards must be removed.

headline: Broken cold water handle; floor tiles; passed
summary: Passed. Re-inspection found the cold water handle broken at the basement handwashing sink. Broken floor tiles under the pizza oven and in the first-floor prep area must be replaced. Several food handlers lacked certificates.

headline: Cleaning and clutter issues; passed
summary: Passed. Inspector asked for cleaning of waste receptacle exteriors, prep table bottoms, equipment, floors under cooking equipment, dishmachine walls, a vent fan and pipes. Unused items in storage rooms should be removed.

headline: Rusty shelving; food debris on floors
summary: Passed. Prep table shelving had rusty surfaces that must be replaced with smooth, cleanable surfaces. Dried food debris was on floors in the prep area, behind cooling units and under the dish machine.

headline: Leaking utility sink; no backflow device
summary: Passed. The utility sink sprayer and top faucet leak and must be repaired. No backflow device could be located on the utility sink. All-gender washroom lacks a covered receptacle, and no mop drying rack was installed.

headline: No handwashing signs; greasy hood filter
summary: Passed. No handwashing sign in the men's washroom. Mop stored improperly; dirty food prep floors; bulb without cover in basement dry storage; greasy hood filter over the fryer must be cleaned.

headline: Unlabeled to-go soups; passed
summary: Passed. Complaint inspection: soups sold to go lacked ingredient and trace-back labels. Excess ice in freezers, food debris in ovens, unused equipment and missing bulbs in the employee toilet room.

headline: No certified manager; food on floor
summary: Passed with conditions, with citation. No person in charge or certified manager was on duty while chicken, steak and pork were handled. Food containers on front storage floor and not inverted in dish area. Debris and dust on walk-in cooler floors. Manager lacked allergen training.

headline: No hair restraint; dust and debris; passed
summary: Passed. Complaint inspection found a male food employee preparing beverages and handling ice without a hair restraint. Walk-in cooler fan covers had dust, and debris built up under chicken prep area cooler door handles.

headline: No sanitizer test kit; food stored on floor
summary: Passed with conditions, with citation. Food boxes and containers were on the storage floor and must be raised 6 inches. No sanitizer test strip kit was on site, a priority violation. Heavy dirt and dust were noted along walls and shelving.

headline: No sanitation certificate for sushi handling
summary: Passed with conditions, with citation. No valid city sanitation certificate was provided for employees, and a certified manager must be on premises while sushi, tuna and salmon are handled. Food handlers prepping food lacked hair restraints.

headline: Unlabeled bulk food; soiled cloths; failed
summary: Failed. Bulk dry foods were not labeled. Wiping cloths were not kept in sanitizer, and shelf liners of tin foil and cardboard were used. Cracked floor tiles, a hole in men's washroom wall, and soiled mop heads. Prior violations uncorrected, including ice machine buildup and milk crates.

headline: No hot water in restrooms; mold in ice machine
summary: Failed. Restroom handwash sinks were 84.5-96.7F. Black mold was in the ice machine. Low-temperature dish machines sanitized at 10 ppm and were tagged. No quat test devices. Food debris on floors; expired allergen training.

headline: Handsink lacked soap and towels; citations
summary: Passed with conditions. The prep handsink had no soap or hand drying supplies; soap and paper towels were provided during inspection; citation issued. Food storage containers on walk-in floor, a stained cutting board, and a leaking pipe under the three-compartment sink.

headline: Dead bugs on sticky trap; no hair restraints
summary: Passed. A sticky trap behind the grease trap was filled with dead bugs and must be replaced. Food handlers were not wearing hair restraints. Debris under cooking equipment and cardboard boxes used as shelf liners. No food handler training certificates.

headline: Cutting boards with deep cuts; passed
summary: Passed. Cutting boards in the kitchen had deep cuts and stains and must be sanded and sealed or replaced.

headline: Missing handwashing signs; faucet handles
summary: Passed. Handwashing signs must be posted at sinks in women's toilets. Faucet handles must stay on longer for handwashing in unisex and women's toilet rooms. Women's and unisex toilet rooms have no lidded garbage cans.

headline: Food handlers lack certificates; allergen training
summary: Passed. No food handler training certificates for any food handler, and a certified manager lacked allergen training. Ice buildup on freezer shelves; mops stored improperly; wiping cloth stored on shelving over the three-compartment sink.

headline: Items not elevated; dirty floors; passed
summary: Passed. Short complaint inspection found stored items in the walk-in cooler and storage rooms not elevated off floors, milk crates used for elevation, and a slow-draining rear handsink. Dirt and food debris on floors and drains; dust on vents.

headline: Thawing method improper; food on floor
summary: Passed. Re-inspection: frozen meat was thawing in a plastic container in prep, which is not an approved method. Food stored on walk-in cooler and freezer floors must be raised 6 inches. Grease and debris on equipment and floors need cleaning.

headline: No certified manager; water backs up at sink
summary: Failed. No person in charge had a valid certificate, and no certified manager was on duty while sandwiches and wraps were handled. Chips stored on basement floor. Water backs up from the second sink basin into the others; citation issued.

headline: No manager on site; TCS food too warm
summary: Failed. No person in charge or certified manager on site while chicken and beef were served. Shredded beef at 50F, chicken 49F, cheese 52F and hot dogs 48F were discarded, about 40 pounds ($300). Prior violation uncorrected.

headline: No sanitation certificate while handling food
summary: Passed with conditions, with citation. The person in charge had no city certified manager certificate. No one on site held a sanitation certificate while roast beef and chicken were handled. Fryer bottoms and sink caulking need cleaning.

headline: Re-inspection: cloths, scoop and storage issues
summary: Passed with conditions. Wiping cloths were not kept in sanitizer. A rice scoop was stored in 76.1F water, and food in rear storage was not elevated. Cardboard shelf liners and raw wooden shelves must be replaced or sealed.

headline: Rusty pizza storage rack; syrup spills
summary: Passed. The pizza storage rack inside the walk-in cooler has chipped paint and rust and must be repainted or replaced. Dust is on fan covers in the sandwich display cooler. Syrup spills under the fountain syrup racks need cleaning.

headline: Rusty racks; ceiling tiles; expired allergen training
summary: Passed. Cardboard was used on shelves in front of the walk-in cooler and must be removed. Walk-in cooler storage racks were rusty and must be cleaned or replaced. Water-stained ceiling tiles in the rear prep area need replacing. Expired allergen certificates for managers.

headline: Dead roaches in dishwashing area; passed
summary: Passed. Several dead cockroaches were on the floor of the dishwashing area and must be cleaned. Also noted: cardboard shelf liners, food on the prep floor, unlabeled salt and sugar, a washroom door not self-closing, and no food handler certificates.

headline: Liquor on milk crates; holes in walls
summary: Passed. Boxes of liquor were stored on milk crates and single-use items on floors in bars and basement; shelving must lift items 6 inches. Covered receptacle needed in basement restroom. Hole behind urinal, stained ceiling tiles, and dusty vent covers.

headline: Cold food too warm; carnitas discarded
summary: Failed. Cooked carnitas at 50.1F and other cold foods in the two-door cooler were too warm; about 10 pounds ($100) were discarded. Menus lacked full raw or undercooked food advisory statements. Two food handlers had expired certificates. Citation issued.

headline: Re-inspection: dirty ice machine; passed
summary: Passed. Re-inspection found the ice machine interior unclean and grease under the fryer. Heavy clutter at storage hall ends; hole in wall at mop sink and broken floor tiles. Certified managers lacked allergen training proof.

headline: Food on freezer floor; training issues
summary: Passed. Re-inspection: missing handwashing signage at the main prep and men's washroom, no thermometers in coolers, food boxes on freezer floor, an uncovered trash bin, dirty bar floors, a burnt-out reach-in light, and food handlers without certificates.

headline: Debris and boxes in refuse area; passed
summary: Passed. Boxes, wrappers and debris were on the ground of the enclosed refuse area. Management was told to dispose of refuse properly and keep the area maintained.

headline: No certified manager; THC items held
summary: Passed with conditions, with priority citation. No certified food manager was on site while dairy was served. Infused THC products were sold with an unapproved additive; these were tagged, held for inspection, and not to be sold.

headline: No hot water at bar handwash sink
summary: Failed. The bar handwashing sink had no hot running water; the temperature was 87.2F. A citation was issued. Ice bins at the bar were missing lids and must be covered.

headline: Food on floor; torn gasket; passed
summary: Passed. Boxed food was stored on the floor in the rear prep area and must be raised 6 inches. A three-door cooler had a torn gasket. Cutting boards had deep scratches and stains; grease and debris and floors need cleaning.

headline: Live cat on premises; passed with conditions
summary: Passed with conditions. A live cat walked the sales area, and a pet bed and cat food were on the washroom floor. Manager told to remove all animals; citation issued. Food stored on floor, dirty shelves and cooler debris also noted.

headline: Complaint: clean two ice machines
summary: Passed. Complaint inspection required cleaning of the interior of both basement ice machines.

headline: Plates not inverted; debris and spills
summary: Passed with conditions. Plates were not inverted after sanitizing. Cutting boards in the rear prep area had open seams and dark stains. Food debris and spills were on floors and surfaces; detail cleaning is required.

headline: Light grease at fryer bottoms; passed
summary: Passed. Short complaint inspection found a light amount of grease at the bottom of the fryers. The person in charge was told to clean it.

headline: Fruit flies found; pest control needed
summary: Failed. About 20 fruit flies were on walls near a bag-in-box syrup station. Pest control operator must be notified and fruit flies eliminated; citation issued. Certified manager lacked allergen training, a repeat violation.

headline: Grease, holes and debris in kitchen
summary: Passed. Grease and food debris were on cooking equipment and prep tables. Holes were in the ceiling above the mop sink and in the floor near a handwashing sink. Storage closet clutter and dirty floors and corners need cleaning.

headline: Unlabeled bulk salt and sugar; passed
summary: Passed. Large food containers holding salt and sugar lacked common name labels. An ice scoop was stored with its handle in the ice; the inspector gave instructions on proper scoop storage.

headline: No health policy; many citations
summary: Failed. No written employee health policy, and several food handlers lacked certificates; citations issued. Scoops stored inside food containers, rust under prep tables, low water pressure at a hand sink, and food on the floor. No handwashing sign at dispensing sink. Water-damaged ceiling tiles in washroom.

headline: Frozen food thawed in sink; failed
summary: Failed. Complaint re-inspection found frozen food thawing in an empty three-compartment sink rinse basin with no running water. A severe leak at the front prep handsink. Rusty prep tables, dirty coolers and floors, and ceiling tiles damaged; food handlers lacked certificates.

headline: Pink slime in ice machine; ice discarded
summary: Failed. Pink slime buildup inside the ice machine was dripping into ice used for drinks. All ice was voluntarily discarded. The ice machine must be cleaned by re-inspection. Ice machine lacks a visible backflow device; bar handsink pipe leaks.

headline: Wiping cloths and rust found; passed
summary: Passed. Wiping cloths were stored on top of the basement ice cream machine and must be kept in sanitizing solution when not in use. Rusty basement shelving needs repainting or replacing. The front handsink drains slowly.

headline: Food handlers lack training certificates
summary: Passed. Several food handlers had no proof of food handler training certificates. The allergen training certificate found was incomplete. Floors along walls and in corners in the prep and cooking area need detail cleaning.

headline: Ice scoop misstored; rust and cleaning needed
summary: Passed. An ice scoop was stored on top of the basement ice machine and should go in a separate clean container. Rusty prep shelf and grease box need repainting. Dishmachine and floor under it need detail cleaning. Handwashing signage needed.

headline: Shared cooler lacks adequate food protection
summary: Passed. The licensee shares a walk-in cooler with a separately licensed convenience store at the same address. An adequate food protection method must be used for food stored in the shared space.

headline: Exit door gap; slow drains; passed
summary: Passed. Exit door near toilet rooms has an approximately 1/4 inch perimeter gap that must be sealed. Three-compartment sink and handwash sink in the same area drain slowly and must be repaired.

headline: No vomit cleanup kit; hot water fixed on site
summary: Failed. Complaint inspection: no written procedure or supplies for vomiting and diarrhea events; citation issued. Hand sink water was 90.1F, corrected to 102.4F by plumber on site. Several cutting boards and food contact items were damaged; floors and walls need repair.

headline: No pest control log; food labels missing
summary: Failed. No maintained pest control log, and no pest control license number was available; priority citation issued. Bulk rice and beans were unlabeled. Oven and hood filters were heavily soiled with grease. Leaking faucet, missing handwashing sign, and no allergen certificate for a manager.

headline: Cook without hair restraint; frost buildup
summary: Passed. Complaint inspection found a cook without a hair restraint; manager must ensure restraints are worn. A chest freezer had heavy frost buildup and must be defrosted.

headline: Worn weather strip; dirty storage rack
summary: Passed. The weather strip in the middle of the front door is worn and must be maintained to keep pests out. The rear storage rack is dirty and must be cleaned.

headline: Boxes on floor; cardboard liners; passed
summary: Passed. Multiple boxes of food were stored on the floor and must be raised 6 inches. Cardboard was used as shelf liner. Cutting boards had deep scratches and stains. Dirt built up under the three-compartment sink and along walls.

headline: Dish machine too cool; tagged and held
summary: Passed with conditions, with priority violation. The high-temperature dish machine was off and not reaching 165F; it was tagged and must not be used until CDPH reinspects. Both managers lacked allergen training. Bathroom utility sink lacked backflow protection.

headline: No handwashing signs; washroom issues
summary: Passed. No handwashing signage at the handsinks throughout the facility. Residue on the bottom of a one-compartment freezer. Restroom door lacks a self-closing device and the unisex restroom has no covered receptacle.

headline: Walk-in cooler too warm; tagged
summary: Passed with conditions. The walk-in cooler near dishwashing read 46.2F and was tagged held for inspection. Opening at base of patio door must be sealed. No prep sink in the first-floor prep area; missing grout and holes in walls and ceilings.

headline: Cold food too warm; no hot water; failed
summary: Failed. Restroom and hand sinks had water at 67.3F. Shrimp ceviche, cooked chicken and tilapia in the display cooler were too warm; about 13 pounds ($250) discarded. Milk crates used as shelving; leaking dish area handsink; broken floor tiles.

headline: No vomit and diarrhea cleanup supplies
summary: Passed with conditions. Re-inspection found no cleanup supplies for vomiting or diarrhea events, a priority violation. Washrooms lacked covered waste containers and had unfinished drywall walls. The certified food manager had no allergen training certificate.

headline: No signed health policy; cooler gap
summary: Passed with conditions. No verifiable signed employee health policy on site. Missing handwashing signage in toilet room and prep sink. Toilet door not self-closing; rusty cooler shelving; gaps in floor-wall junctures and inside walk-in cooler may allow pests.

headline: Missing hair restraints; rusty racks; passed
summary: Passed. Food handlers were not wearing hair or beard restraints. Rusty storage racks and loose, damaged gaskets on front reach-in coolers noted. Fryer interiors had grease buildup. One food handler had no proof of training.

headline: Roaches, flies and boric acid; failed
summary: Failed. About 15 small flies, 3 live roaches and 3 dead roaches were found in the prep and toilet areas. No licensed pest control operator and no service records. Boric acid spilled on sushi prep surfaces. Gap under rear door and no paper towels at a handsink.

headline: Spillage under freezer; passed
summary: Passed. Spillage was found on the bottom of a reach-in freezer unit. The person in charge was told to clean and maintain it.

headline: Front door gap; cold water pressure low; passed
summary: Passed. An opening at the base of the front door must be sealed to keep pests out, though no pests were noted. Other items: no cold water pressure at one sink, missing backflow device, damaged ceiling tiles, and holes in wall and floor.

headline: No health policy or vomit kit; conditions
summary: Passed with conditions. Re-inspection found no employee health policy or training, no vomit and diarrhea procedure or kit, and no thermometers visible in coolers. Citation issued for the missing health policy.

headline: Torn gasket on two-door cooler
summary: A torn door gasket was found on the two-door stand-up cooler at the rear prep and dish area. Staff were instructed to replace it.

headline: Failed: no hair restraint; garbage bags overfilled
summary: Failed. A food handler lacked a hair restraint in front prep. Three-compartment sink stoppers were in poor condition. Outside garbage bags were overfilled and kept the lid from closing; a citation was issued. The hood above cooking equipment lacked filters.

headline: Failed: cooler too warm; leaks and missing sink
summary: Failed. A cooler did not maintain 41°F or below, was empty, and was tagged. Two cooking-line coolers had no thermometers. Leaks were found under a scrape sink and in the basement water heater area. A required sink for discarding liquids was missing.

headline: Failed: no certified manager; no health policy
summary: Failed. No certified manager was on site while pasta salad was served; citation issued. No verifiable employee health policy was on site; citation issued. A repeat violation for cracked and dirty kitchen floors was not corrected, and no inspection summary was posted.

headline: Leaking toilets; missing food handler training proof
summary: Two of three toilet stalls in the hall men's room leaked water; manager told to repair. Food handler training certificates were missing on site. Manager must provide proof for all food handlers and require training for new hires within 30 days.

headline: Clutter in unused cooler; water-stained tiles
summary: An unused walk-in cooler had many stored items that must be removed to prevent pest hiding spaces. Water-stained ceiling tiles above the prep area and sales floor must be replaced. A certified manager lacked allergen training.

headline: Staff toilet door not self-closing
summary: The staff toilet room door next to the basement prep area is not self-closing. A self-closing device must be installed.

headline: Failed: live flies and rodent droppings persist
summary: Failed. A prior priority violation was not corrected. About 20 live large flies were in the rear dish area, and about 20 rodent droppings were by the reach-in cooler condenser. Pest activity must be eliminated, and a citation was issued.

headline: Ice machine dripping black residue; cleaned on site
summary: A rear dry storage ice machine had a black and brown substance dripping onto ice. The person in charge turned it off and removed and cleaned the ice and machine during inspection. Fryer grease and food debris were also noted.

headline: Dirty shelving, washroom, and storage floor
summary: Storage shelving inside cabinets under the slushy machines must be cleaned. Washroom fixtures and walls need detail cleaning, and rear storage floor along wall bases and corners needs cleaning.

headline: Dead insects in light shields; training gaps
summary: Dead insects were found in light shields in the rear prep area. Other items included plastic ware not upright, worn gaskets, grease, chipping paint, and holes in ceilings. No food handler or allergen training was found on site.

headline: Unlabeled, uncovered bulk food; floor storage
summary: Bulk containers were unlabeled and uncovered, and food was stored on floors in prep and walk-in areas. Soiled wiping cloths sat on prep tables, and cardboard was used as a dipper. Grease buildup and water-stained basement ceiling tiles were also noted.

headline: Failed: live roach, flies, and dish machine too cool
summary: Failed. One live roach near the dish machine plus several dead ones, and about 30 live small flies in prep, dish, and storage areas. Dish machine rinse reached 110°F instead of 180°F; unit held. Pest service required on or after 7/21/26.

headline: Condensation water and employee clothing stored near food
summary: Condensation collected in a tub under the walk-in cooler cooling unit and must be directed away from food storage. Employee clothing was stored on food shelves in the dry storage room; staff were told to store it away from food.

headline: Bent thermometer probe; greasy fryers and walls
summary: A digital thermometer had a significantly bent metal probe and must be replaced. Deep fryers and a line cooler's compressor were soiled, and grease buildup was on walls and ceiling tiles near the main cook-line hood.

headline: Fly strip near prep sink; leaking pipe
summary: A fly strip was attached to the wall near the three-compartment sink in front prep and must be removed; fly strips are not allowed in prep areas. A pipe under that sink leaked. Crumbling brick in toilet rooms and dirty walls by a utility sink need repair.

headline: Rusty shelving and items on walk-in freezer floor
summary: Rust was found on silver shelving inside the walk-in cooler and must be removed or the unit replaced. Items were stored on the walk-in freezer floor and must be moved at least 6 inches off the floor.

headline: Greasy fryers and floors; certificates not found
summary: Grease and food debris were in the deep fryer oil filter unit and on cooking equipment, coolers, and freezers. Floors under fryers and walls in prep had grease and dust. Food handler certificates could not be verified, and a certified manager's allergen certificate had expired.

headline: Rusty carts; items on floor; dusty fan covers
summary: Storage carts in prep and the walk-in cooler had excessive rust and need resurfacing. Items stored on floors in the dish room and basement liquor storage must be moved 6 inches up to avoid pest hiding spots. Walk-in fan covers were dusty.

headline: Bare-hand contact, hot water, and cold food issues
summary: Two food handlers prepared food without gloves, and one used bare hands on ready-to-eat sushi; 1 lb was discarded. Restroom hot water was 48.9 to 54.3°F and was corrected on site. Cold food held at 56.5 to 59.9°F was discarded (27.6 lbs).

headline: Missing handwashing signs; soiled floors and ice machine
summary: Restrooms lacked signs telling employees to wash hands before returning to work; manager told to add them at each hand sink. Underside of the ice machine was slightly soiled, and a storage room floor was heavily soiled. Manager instructed to clean.

headline: Failed: unlabeled food; ceiling and baseboard repairs
summary: Failed. Bulk food in non-original containers was unlabeled, and large pots were not inverted. Restroom ventilation was not working. A prior violation for missing and cracked ceiling tiles and a baseboard hole was not corrected.

headline: Food stored below unshielded waste pipes
summary: In the basement dry storage, shelves, freezers, and containers were under unshielded waste pipes; items must be moved or shielded. Utensils were stored with food-contact surfaces exposed, and a trash can in a unisex toilet room lacked a lid.

headline: Failed: cold foods at 45-50°F; about 50 lbs discarded
summary: Multiple cold foods, including cream cheese, salmon, sausage, cheese, liquid eggs, and deli meat, were held at 45 to 50°F in a prep cooler. About 50 lbs ($400) were discarded. A certified manager lacked allergen training certificate.

headline: Front doors not rodent-proofed; cleaning needed
summary: Front entrance doors were not rodent-proofed and must be sealed to prevent entry. Staff were told to clean a prep cooler, equipment, and floors under and behind equipment. Peeling paint and dusty vents were also noted.

headline: Food debris in cooling units; dirty floors and corners
summary: Accumulated food debris and spills were found inside all cooling units. Debris was on floors, along walls, and in corners of the prep and bar areas. Staff personal items were stored in the prep area, and a food handler lacked a certificate.

headline: No utility sink for mop water; no sanitary bin
summary: The facility has no service or utility sink, so staff were told to provide proper disposal for dirty mop water. The employee restroom lacked a covered receptacle for sanitary napkins; one must be provided.

headline: Failed: no certified manager; sink backs up
summary: Failed. No certified manager was on site while tuna salad was prepared; citation issued. Waste water backed up from one compartment into the next when the three-compartment sink drained; citation issued. Only certified managers had food handler training.

headline: Dead insects and debris on floors
summary: Debris and dead insects were on floors along walls and corners in prep and storage areas. The manager was instructed to clean and maintain them. A cold water handle at the three-compartment sink was stripped and needs repair.

headline: No written health policy; clutter and mops on floor
summary: No written employee health policy was on the premises and must be provided signed by each employee. Unused equipment and clutter in the rear and basement must be removed to prevent rodent harborage. Soiled mops on the floor need proper storage, and the prep floor needs regrouting.

headline: Failed: poor handwashing sinks; sanitizer test kit missing
summary: Failed. Handwashing sinks were in poor repair and not accessible, one lacked a hot water handle, and food was thawing in standing water in a sink; citation issued. No test kit for sanitizer and no thermometer in one cooler. Prior violations were not corrected.

headline: Missing handwashing signs; expired allergen certificate
summary: Several handwashing signs were missing at sinks throughout the establishment and must be provided. An expired allergen training certificate was on site; certified managers must provide current training.

headline: Pork held at 50°F; 48 lbs discarded
summary: Pork slabs at 49.6 to 50.8°F were found in the rear walk-in cooler where meat is packaged; cold foods must stay at 41°F or below. About 48 lbs ($188) were discarded. Ice machine buildup and dirty floors also need attention.

headline: Failed: raw meat too warm; black flies found
summary: Failed. Chicken and pork held above 41°F in three spots; manager discarded 219 lbs (about $420). Two coolers were too warm (78°F and 52.8°F) and held. About 30 black flies were seen throughout; no current pest control log.

headline: Heavy grease, dirt, and unlabeled bulk food
summary: Bulk food was not labeled and a torn gasket was found on a refrigerator. Heavy grease and grime were found inside cooking equipment, floors, walls, and the exhaust hood. Cardboard and foil lining the shelves must be removed; they can hide pests.

headline: Brown buildup in ice machine; cutting boards damaged
summary: A slight brown buildup was found inside the rear ice machine; staff must remove the ice, clean, and sanitize the machine. Cutting boards at the cook-line prep coolers have deep cuts and stains and must be restored or replaced.

headline: Soiled cardboard shelving; damaged ceiling and walls
summary: Soiled cardboard was used on meat department shelving and must be removed. Cracked and damaged plaster in the ceiling and walls throughout the rear storage area needs repair.

headline: Paper shelf liners, grocery bags, missing allergen training
summary: Paper lining was on front prep shelves and grocery bags were used to store food; both must be replaced with smooth, food-grade materials. A certified manager lacked allergen training certificate; manager was told to obtain it.

headline: Failed: no date marking; food discarded
summary: Failed. No date marking system was used for food held over 24 hours, including cooked rice, beef, and chicken; that food was discarded. Several prior violations were noted, including damaged floor tiles, dirty floors behind equipment, and an expired allergen certificate.

headline: Missing lids in customer and employee washrooms
summary: Washrooms for customers and employees lacked lids. The manager must provide lids and keep them in place.

headline: Expired allergen certificates; rusty wire racks
summary: Chipped paint and rust were on wire storage racks next to the dish sink and must be removed or the shelves replaced. All allergen training certificates were expired; certified managers must complete training and keep certificates on site.

headline: Failed: no certified manager; no hot water at sink
summary: Failed. No certified food manager was present while ground beef was prepared, and a citation was issued. The bread prep handwashing sink had no hot water and no paper towels. A required splashguard was missing, and a prior violation for missing exposed handwashing sinks was not corrected.

headline: Beef thawed at room temperature; no allergen training
summary: Beef was thawing at room temperature under a prep table; staff were told to thaw food under refrigeration, cold running water, or as part of cooking. Food was stored on the walk-in floor, and a styrofoam cup was used as a dispenser.

headline: Failed: mouse droppings and warm cold-holding units
summary: Failed. Over 50 mouse droppings were found in fryers, along a wall base, and in the furnace room. Cold foods were held at 46.8 to 52°F and about 25 lbs were discarded. Two refrigeration units were tagged held. Allergen certification had expired.

headline: Plates and utensils stored face up
summary: Plates and utensils were observed facing up. Staff were instructed to store them inverted.

headline: Failed: fruit flies; no backflow device
summary: Failed. About 15 fruit flies were seen on kitchen walls. A citation was issued; the manager must notify pest control and eliminate the flies. The basement ice machine lacks a backflow device; walls and floors also need work.

headline: Gap at side exit door; greasy ventilation hood
summary: A 1/4 inch gap under the side exit door sweep must be sealed to keep rodents out. The ventilation hood had food and grease buildup, and the manager must clean it.

headline: Electric oven not under exhaust hood
summary: An electric oven was found at the premises not under a hood. The manager must provide the required hood coverage.

headline: Unlabeled bulk containers; dusty hood filters
summary: Bulk containers in the rear prep area were not labeled with their common name. Dust and grease had built up on the hood ventilation filters. Staff were instructed to label the containers and clean the filters.

headline: Failed: live roaches and rat droppings; no CFM
summary: Failed. Repeat violation: about 30 or more live roaches were in window sills over the sink and on basement floors, plus about 15 rat droppings near the rear door. No certified manager was on duty while hot-held foods were served; citation issued.

headline: No hand soap at bar sink; broken floor tiles
summary: The bar handwashing sink had no hand soap; staff were told to provide it. Other items: food debris in a drawer cooler, a sealed mop sink, peeling paint in the walk-in, broken floor tiles, utility lines on the bar floor, and no allergen training for the manager.

headline: Loose freezer gasket; dirty floors and drain
summary: The bakery walk-in freezer gasket was coming loose and must be repaired. The front prep floor drain had caked-on debris that could attract pests. A leaking faucet at a meat processing sink and general dirt and debris in several areas need attention.

headline: Grease buildup on fryer, shelves, and microwave
summary: Grease was found on the outside and inside of the deep fryer, kitchen storage shelves, tops and bottoms of prep tables, and inside the microwave. Staff were instructed to detail clean these items.

headline: Raw chicken cooler spills; cardboard by dumpster
summary: Food spills were inside the bottom of a two-door refrigerator where raw chicken is stored; these must be cleaned. Several cardboard boxes were stacked by the outside dumpster area and must be managed.

headline: Rusty racks and mold-like buildup in walk-in
summary: Rusty metal racks inside the walk-in cooler must be cleaned, repainted, or replaced. Green storage racks with white mold-like buildup were also found inside the walk-in cooler and need cleaning.

headline: Leaky drain pipe under handwashing sink
summary: A drain pipe under a handwashing sink was leaking. The manager was instructed to repair and maintain it.

headline: Certified managers must complete allergen training
summary: All city-certified food managers must complete allergen training and keep certificates on site at all times.

headline: Failed: unsafe hot and cold food; discards made
summary: Hot foods measured 90.7 and 104°F, below 135°F, and cold foods were at 64 to 68°F in a prep cooler; the manager discarded about 39 lbs. The prep cooler measured 60.3°F and was tagged. No vomit cleanup procedure was on site; citation issued.

headline: Failed: bare-hand contact, raw eggs above ready food
summary: Failed. An employee handled ready-to-eat food without washing hands or gloves; citation issued. Raw eggs were stored above ready-to-eat foods. Several cold foods were held too warm and 63 lbs were discarded. A prep cooler at 51°F was tagged.

headline: No certified manager while chicken sandwiches served
summary: No certified food manager with a city sanitation certificate was present while chicken sandwiches were prepared and served; a citation was issued. Management was instructed that a certified manager must be present at all times when such foods are prepared or served.

headline: No proof of food handler training
summary: No proof of food handler training was available for any food handlers on site. Staff were instructed to provide and keep these records on site at all times.

headline: Failed: rat droppings in basement; machine held
summary: Failed. Over 30 rat droppings were in a basement HVAC closet and over 10 more behind equipment. Large gaps under basement doors and a bent exterior door were noted. A vacuum packaging machine lacked an approved plan and was tagged held.

headline: Deep-cut cutting boards; missing receptacle lids
summary: Cutting boards in the front prep area had deep cuts and stains. Both unisex bathrooms lacked lids on receptacles. A broken, stained lobby ceiling tile indicates a leak and needs repair. Food handler and allergen proof was missing.

headline: Failed: heavy cooler spills; old violations uncorrected
summary: Failed. Heavy spills were on the basement walk-in cooler floor. A hood light bulb lacked a shield. Prior violations were not corrected: encrusted grease under fryers, a bar sink leak, and a kitchen baseboard hole. A citation was issued.

headline: No valid manager certificate during chicken prep
summary: No valid city food sanitation manager certificate was on site while chicken was prepared and served; a citation was issued. No employee health policy or vomit and diarrhea cleanup procedure was found. Floor tiles throughout are cracked.

headline: Food on walk-in floor; ice machine residue
summary: Food items were stored on the floor in the walk-in cooler and must be raised six inches. Residue was on the interior surfaces of the ice machine and must be cleaned. A food sanitation manager lacked allergen training certificate.

headline: No certified manager on site; missing thermometers
summary: No certified manager with a valid certificate was posted during deli, tuna, soup, and meatball preparation; citation issued. Thermometers were missing in the walk-in and front prep coolers. Only 2 of 4 food handler certificates were on site.

headline: Grimy sinks; cold water handle stripped; dirty drains
summary: Food and grime built up on all sinks, especially around water handles. The dish area hand sink's cold water handle is stripped and must be repaired. Dirt and litter were on storage room floors and inside floor drains. Hood grease must be cleaned.

headline: Items on floor; grease on fryers; slow drain
summary: Single-service items were stored on the floor and were not inverted in prep and front counter areas. Grease buildup was on fryers and the grill, and the three-compartment sink drains slowly.

headline: No thermometers inside coolers and display units
summary: Reach-in and display coolers had no ambient air thermometers inside. Staff were instructed to provide clear, easy-to-read thermometers inside all refrigerator units to monitor air temperature.

headline: Failed: ice machine slime dripping onto ice
summary: Failed. Ice machine interior was heavily soiled with black and grey slime dripping onto ice used for consumption. Manager was told to discard the ice and clean. Scoops were stored with handles touching food, and sewer-line shielding was needed.

headline: Single-service items on floor; leaky sink faucet
summary: Single-service items were stored on the floor in the front register area and must be raised off the floor. A three-compartment sink faucet leaked and needs repair.

headline: Ice machine buildup; leaking faucet and drains
summary: The ice machine interior had some buildup and needs cleaning. A three-compartment sink faucet leaked, a break room sink drained slowly, and floor drains throughout the facility need cleaning.

headline: Failed: low hot water, cold food, and warm cooler
summary: Failed. Customer restroom hot water measured 51 to 63°F; minimum is 100°F. Several cold foods were at 47°F and were discarded ($45). A deli cooler measured 46°F and was tagged. Eyewash stations were attached to food-prep handwashing sinks.

headline: Failed: live rodent and over 100 droppings
summary: Failed. One live rodent was seen behind refrigeration units, and over 100 rodent droppings were scattered on the food prep floor. Cooked foods lacked discard dates, and no employee health policy or vomit cleanup supplies were found. Citations issued.

headline: Bacon and chicken held too warm; 6 lbs discarded
summary: Uncooked bacon and chicken were held at 47.5 to 48.1°F; cold foods must be at 41°F or below. All out-of-temperature food was discarded (6 lbs, $40). Ripped cooler gaskets, a stained cutting board, and food buildup on sinks also need attention.

headline: No norovirus disinfectant on site; pest entry gap
summary: No disinfectant effective against norovirus was on site; manager must obtain and keep it. An opening at the base of the front double door must be sealed against pests. Also a stained cutting board, a wall hole, and a mop drying rack needed.

headline: Dirty walk-in cooler floor and dim lighting
summary: Inspector found dirt and debris buildup under shelving and in the corners of the walk-in cooler, and low lighting there. Staff were told to clean the area and add brighter light. No pests noted.

headline: Failed: no health policy; missing handsinks and certificates
summary: Failed. No employee health policy was on site. Handsinks were needed in the dish area and front bakery prep area. An outside waste receptacle was needed, and food handlers and sanitation certificate holders lacked certificates and allergen training documents.

headline: Food stored on floor in walk-in freezer
summary: Food was stored on the floor in the walk-in freezer. Staff were told to raise it at least 6 inches on proper shelving, not milk crates. Multi-use utensils were not stored upside down; staff were told to invert them.

headline: Leaks, greasy fryers, and dirty floors and vents
summary: Thick ice buildup covered the walk-in freezer floor. Leaks were found at a sink faucet, and fryers, filters, floor drains, and vents were dirty. A hole above a toilet sink needs sealing. A certified manager lacked allergen training.

headline: Cardboard liners; damaged floors and walls
summary: Cardboard and pegboard lined the candy rack and cold holding units and must be removed. A utility sink lacked a backflow device. Many floor tiles, walls, and ceilings need repair, and cold holding units and floors in the retail area need cleaning.

headline: Missing sink stoppers and handwashing sign
summary: The rear dishwashing sink lacked a handwashing sign. Three sink stoppers were missing from the three-compartment sink. Floors throughout the facility need cleaning.

headline: Soda gun holder has grayish buildup
summary: The soda gun holder had minor grayish buildup. Staff were instructed to clean and sanitize it.

headline: Broken gaskets, grease, and missing training certificates
summary: Ice chute had early mineral buildup and broken gaskets were found on two reach-in coolers. Grease and debris were behind the cook line; cardboard was used as shelf liner; a faucet leaked. Food handler and allergen certificates for new staff were missing.

headline: No vomit cleanup kit; rear door not rodent-proof
summary: No vomit or diarrhea cleanup kit was on site and one must be obtained. The rear exit door is not rodent-proof at the bottom. No food handler certificates were on site.

headline: Unlabeled bulk food; spoons in stagnant water
summary: A bulk food container was not labeled and must be labeled. Large spoons were stored in stagnant water at room temperature; they must be kept in a dry, clean container. Deli cups were not air-dried after washing.

headline: Damaged wall bases at two walk-in coolers
summary: Damaged wall bases were found on the outside of the beer walk-in cooler and inside the food walk-in cooler. They must be repaired or replaced to be in good repair.

headline: Failed: mouse droppings and warm egg roll filling
summary: Failed. Egg roll filling was held at 50°F in the walk-in cooler; 10 lbs were discarded. About 50 mouse droppings were found behind and under cooking equipment, and more pest control is needed. Citation issued.

headline: Unlabeled bulk dry storage container
summary: A bulk dry storage container was not labeled with its product name. The manager must label it and keep it labeled.

headline: Handle-less containers used to scoop food
summary: To-go containers without handles were used to scoop and serve food from prep coolers. Staff were told to use tongs, serving spoons, or a ladle. Floors along wall bases and under equipment in the rear prep and dish areas need cleaning.

headline: Uncovered light switches
summary: Light switches were uncovered. The person in charge was instructed to cover all light switch outlets and maintain them.

headline: No certified manager; dated food discarded
summary: The person in charge had no city food sanitation certificate, and none was posted; citations issued. Cooked beans, beef, and tomatoes held over 24 hours had no date labels and were discarded. No written employee health policy; menus lacked the required consumer advisory.

headline: Ice maker floor drain moldy and dirty
summary: The floor drain for the ice maker was not maintained, with mold and debris noted. Staff were instructed to clean and maintain it.

headline: Failed: no certified manager; cold food too warm
summary: Failed. No certified manager was on premises; citation issued. Cold foods were held at 46.0 to 61.7°F, and the manager discarded 5 lbs. A small cooler at 46.6°F was held. Red mold-like buildup was found in the ice machine. Menu lacked raw food advisories.

headline: Dirty toilet room fixtures
summary: Plumbing fixtures in the toilet room needed cleaning. The manager was instructed to clean them.

headline: Missing health policies; door gaps; leaks
summary: No signed employee health policies were on site. Front and rear doors are not tight-fitting and need sealing to prevent pests. A faucet leaked and needed repair, and a mop sink lacks a backflow device. A toilet room lacks a lidded garbage can.

headline: Sink hot-water and leak problems; upkeep issues
summary: Passed after re-inspection. No hot water at a cheese-prep sink and a leaky cold-water valve at another sink. Handwashing signs and toilet-room trash can lids were missing. Crates used for storage and grime needs cleaning.

headline: Syrup spill under soda machine; missing outlet cover
summary: Syrup from the soda machine was on the counter area under the machine and must be cleaned. A missing outlet cover on the wall next to the pizza oven must be replaced.

headline: Failed dish machine; no sanitizer in final rinse
summary: The dish machine had no sanitizer in the final rinse (0 ppm) and was tagged held. Sliced tortillas were stored in grocery bags, a drain leaked under the three-compartment sink, and no valid allergen training was found for a certified manager.

headline: Broken floor tiles; chipped dry storage paint
summary: Missing grout, missing tiles, and broken floor tiles were found in rear prep, dish, dry storage, and cafe areas. Chipped paint on dry storage walls and a hole in a dry storage wall must be repaired.

headline: Dish machine failing; flies in three areas
summary: The wine room dish machine was not sanitizing at 10 ppm and was tagged. About 15 small flies at the main bar and about 10 in the kitchen and R&D bar were found. Expired food was discarded, and a citation was issued.

headline: Black slime inside ice machine dripping onto ice
summary: The ice machine interior had black slime buildup dripping onto ice used for drinks. The manager was told to clean and sanitize all food-contact surfaces, and a citation was issued. Missing sink stoppers and dusty ventilation hood filters were also noted.

headline: Rust on shelving; no allergen training
summary: Rust was found on dry storage shelving and cooler shelving in the rear prep area. The certified manager on site had no allergen training at the time of inspection. The person in charge was told to provide it on site.

headline: Gap at entrance door; food debris in coolers
summary: A half-inch gap at the front entrance door sweep must be rodent-proofed. Food debris was in the reach-in coolers and on front prep shelves. The employee washroom lacked a covered trash receptacle.

headline: No manager certificate; no hair restraints
summary: The person in charge had no Chicago certified food manager certificate, and no certified manager was on site while TCS foods were served. Handlers had no certificates, handled food after handling gloves, and wore torn gloves. A citation was issued.

headline: Unlabeled containers; rusty racks; dirty floors
summary: Food containers identified by common name, such as flour, salt, and sugar, must be labeled. Rusty storage racks, a grease-caked potato cutter, and unsealed raw wood were noted. A walk-in light bulb was not working.

headline: No hand-washing sign; no cooler thermometer
summary: No hand-washing sign was in the employee restroom, and no ambient air thermometer was in the walk-in cooler. Food and grime were found under prep tables, on prep cooler handles, and in outlet boxes. Each item must be corrected.

headline: Missing ceiling tiles; chipped restroom paint
summary: Missing and water-stained ceiling tiles were found in the basement prep area. Chipped paint on restroom and hall walls must be repainted so walls are smooth and cleanable.

headline: Food stored on freezer floor; no allergen training
summary: Food was stored on the floor inside the walk-in freezer; the manager was told to raise it six inches. The freezer had no light. Also loose baseboards, damaged floor grout, and no allergen training for the certified manager on duty.

headline: Low hand sink water temperature; corrected on site
summary: Hand sink water measured 91-95F in restrooms and was repaired on site to 102-113.6F before inspection ended. A basement restroom lacked a covered receptacle and self-closing door. An outdated summary report was posted on site.

headline: Unlabeled sugar; low sneeze guard; dirty ice machine
summary: A bulk sugar container was unlabeled. The sneeze guard on the hallway side was too short. Gray water pooled at the ice scoop holder, and gray film was on the ice machine's interior panel. Each item was flagged for correction.

headline: Dirty overhead vent; no cooler thermometer
summary: No ambient air thermometer was inside the display cooler near the front line. Mop drying was improper at the utility sink. A dirty overhead vent in the employee restroom must be cleaned.

headline: No certified manager; both hand sinks blocked
summary: No person in charge was present, and no certified sanitation manager was on site while TCS foods were handled. The manager arrived at 1:00 PM. Both hand sinks were blocked and were unblocked by the end of inspection. Citations were issued.

headline: No grease trap; large basement floor hole
summary: No grease trap was on the bar three-compartment sink. No covered receptacle was in unisex restrooms. A large jagged hole in the basement floor must be made smooth. Items on the basement floor must be raised six inches.

headline: Dusty fan covers and dirty kitchen floors
summary: Staff were told to clean floors under and around kitchen equipment, bars, and storage. Dust was seen on fan covers in the walk-in cooler near the patio bar and must be cleaned.

headline: No health policy; no allergen training
summary: No employee health policy was on the premises. Single-service items were stored on the floor. Cutting boards were scratched and stained. No backflow device on the ice machine. One certified manager lacked allergen training.

headline: 70 or more mouse droppings; citation issued
summary: Over 70 mouse droppings were found on floors in the kitchen utility closet, ice machine storage room, and rear storage room. The manager was told to clean and recommended pest control service before reinspection. A citation was issued.

headline: Women's restroom lacks covered trash can
summary: The female restroom lacked a covered trash receptacle. The manager was instructed to provide one in any unisex or female restroom.

headline: No hot water at trailer restroom hand sinks
summary: Portable trailer restroom hand sinks had no hot water under city pressure. Water must be at least 100F for proper hand washing. A citation was issued.

headline: No food handler training records
summary: No proof of food handler training was shown for any food handler. Records must be kept on site at all times.

headline: Three-compartment sink missing stoppers
summary: The three-compartment sink had no stoppers. The manager was told to obtain them for proper washing and sanitizing.

headline: Drain buildup; dirty walk-in freezer floor
summary: The drains had food debris and slime and must be cleaned. The walk-in freezer floor had debris under the shelving. Dirt and food debris were in wall corners and under equipment.

headline: Expired food manager certificate; conditional pass
summary: No valid City of Chicago food manager certificate was on the premises. The certificate expired on 09/04/23. A valid original certificate must be posted on site.

headline: Uncorrected core violations; greasy hood
summary: Core violations from a prior inspection were not corrected. The food prep floor must be cleaned, and grease must be removed from the ventilation hood and filters. A citation was issued.

headline: Cardboard floor liners; leak under hand sink
summary: Cardboard was used as floor liners in the rear prep area and must be removed. A minor leak under the deli prep hand sink needs repair. A cracked bakery wall tile and food crumbs on the bakery floor were also noted.

headline: Wiping cloths not stored in sanitizer
summary: The manager was instructed on properly storing wiping cloths in sanitizing solution when not in use.

headline: Dock door gap; dirty fryers and ceilings
summary: A rear dock door has a half-inch gap that must be rodent and insect-proofed. Fryers had grease and dirt buildup. Water-stained ceiling tiles and dusty vents were noted. Multiple food handlers had expired certificates.

headline: Cracked display glass; leaking produce sink
summary: Cracked glass in the cake display cooler must be replaced. Fryer sides had grease and food debris. A leak in the produce three-compartment sink pipe must be repaired. Ceiling tiles above fryers were heavily greased.

headline: No food manager certificate; no hand soap
summary: No valid certified food manager was present while sushi rice was prepared. A certified manager arrived about 10:45 AM. Hand sinks lacked soap, paper towels, and signage. About 5 pounds of rice without date marks was discarded.

headline: No hair restraint; no allergen training
summary: A food handler was not wearing a hair restraint and was instructed to do so. No allergen training certificate was shown for the food service manager; they were told to obtain it.

headline: Food debris on rear storage floors
summary: Trash and food debris were found on the floor under rear storage shelving, which the inspector said could attract pests. A large hole in the wall behind the beverage system must be made smooth and cleanable.

headline: No food manager certificate; many hand-sink gaps
summary: No certified food manager certificate was posted, and no health policy or sanitizer was on site. Hand sinks lacked soap, paper towels, and signs. No pest control logbook, and a three-compartment sink did not drain.

headline: Unlabeled food containers; drainage and faucet issues
summary: Food in coolers, the walk-in cooler, and dry storage lacked name labels after removal from original packaging. Wood shelves must be sealed. Slow drainage and a stripped hot-water handle at prep hand sinks must be repaired.

headline: Items on floor; grease over cooking equipment
summary: Items were stored on the floor in the food prep and rear areas and must be raised six inches. Grease was on the vents above cooking equipment. The restroom door lacked a self-closing device and there was no covered trash receptacle.

headline: No certified manager; broken seafood case handles
summary: Person in charge had no proof of food safety management training. Food handlers prepared TCS foods without a certified manager on site. Broken door handles on the seafood display case must be repaired. A citation was issued.

headline: Employees eating and drinking at prep area
summary: Employees were drinking and eating at the kitchen prep area. A designated break area must be provided. Serving plates were not inverted and a slimy substance was found inside the soda dispenser.

headline: Basement sink leak; floor drains dirty
summary: A leak below the basement three-compartment sink drainpipe must be repaired. Dirt and debris were seen on floor drains in the basement food prep area, which must be cleaned.

headline: No certified manager; no paper towels
summary: No person in charge was present during inspection. No certified food manager with a city certificate was on site while deli meats and sandwiches were prepared. The front service area had no paper towels, and no hand sink was at the rear bakery.

headline: No certified manager on site; floor debris
summary: No City of Chicago certified food manager with a valid certificate was on site while sliced tomatoes, deli meat, and cooked chicken were prepared. Single-service articles were stored on the floor, and the grease trap could not be located.

headline: Over 100 mouse droppings; no manager; ill-kept
summary: Over 100 mouse droppings were found in prep, storage, and basement areas. No certified manager was on site while beef was prepared. Food was stored on floors, and waste water buckets were not emptied. No vomit kit was available. A citation was issued.

headline: Over 50 mouse droppings; food too warm
summary: Pasta, chicken, and beef stew were held at 44.9-50F and about 20 pounds was discarded. Over 50 mouse droppings were on the kitchen prep floor and shelves, and cutlery boxes were gnawed. Food stored on floors, grime, and torn gaskets were also noted.

headline: Raw eggs over salad; no sanitizer; no certificate
summary: No valid food sanitation certificate was on site while beef was cooked. Raw eggs and chicken were stored above fresh cilantro and onions and were discarded. Sanitizer was missing from the dish sink. Several foods were held too warm or cold and discarded.

headline: Hand sink blocked by leak; broken ice lid
summary: The prep line hand sink was not accessible because of a large water leak below it. The ice machine lid is broken and must be repaired. A citation was issued for the hand sink.

headline: About 80 mouse droppings; citation issued
summary: About 80 or more mouse droppings were found on shelves and floors in several aisles, near energy drinks, charcoal, and mop buckets. Front entrance doors have openings that must be rodent-proofed. A citation was issued.

headline: Dim and out lights; dirty fryers and drain
summary: Two prep kitchen lights were dim and two were not working. A walk-in cooler light was out. Fryer compartments had grease buildup, the floor drain below the three-compartment sink was soiled, and exhaust filters were dusty.

headline: Dish machine not sanitizing; coolers too warm
summary: The low-temperature dish machine was not sanitizing, measuring 0 ppm chlorine, and was tagged and held. Prep coolers were at 50-60F and had to be turned on. Also no allergen training and no food handler certificates on site.

headline: Scoop handles in dry storage; dirty dish floor
summary: Scoop handles in dry storage bins were in contact with contents and must be kept out. The high-heat dish machine had no temperature measuring device, which the manager purchased. Floor below the three-compartment sink was heavily soiled. Mops were stored in the utility sink.

headline: Frozen chicken in grocery bags; expired food handler card
summary: Chicken was frozen in grocery bags in the rear chest freezer. Only food-grade materials may be used. One food handler had expired training. A torn walk-in cooler gasket and a dirty microwave were also noted.

headline: Moldy ice machine dripping onto ice
summary: Black mold-like buildup on the ice machine interior was dripping onto ice. The ice must be discarded and the machine cleaned. Many other items were flagged, including a torn cooler gasket and a missing wall base. A citation was issued.

headline: Expired allergen training for multiple managers
summary: Multiple food service managers had expired allergen awareness training certificates at the time of inspection. The person in charge was instructed to renew them and keep them on site.

headline: Smoked salmon, caviar held too warm; flies
summary: TCS foods were held at 49-65F, and 100 pounds of smoked salmon and 40 pounds of caviar were discarded. A cooler was at 50F and was repaired. More than 50 flies were found throughout the facility. A citation was issued.

headline: Leaking condenser wets cooler shelf
summary: A leaking condenser above the front prep cooler causes water to collect on the bottom shelf. The manager was instructed to repair and maintain it.

headline: Hand sink slow drain; no splash guard
summary: Slow-draining hand sinks and a missing splash guard at the front hand sink next to dish storage were noted. Worn cutting boards, a broken freezer gasket, and unlabeled juice for sale were also found. Uncorrected prior violations were cited.

headline: Insect carcasses in basement; ice machine calcium
summary: Several dead insects were found throughout the basement, and the manager was told to remove them. Calcium buildup was found inside the ice machine and must be cleaned.

headline: Hand sink water too cold; food over 41F
summary: Hand sink water measured 66F; it was repaired on site to 101F. Beef, barbacoa, and goat in the walk-in cooler were held above 41F, and 12 pounds was discarded. A citation was issued.

headline: No backflow device on ice machine
summary: No backflow prevention device was found on the ice machine water line. One must be provided at a location where it can be serviced.

headline: Heavy grease and food debris throughout
summary: Grease and food debris were found on cooking equipment, prep tables, coolers, freezers, and shelves. A leak under the three-compartment sink must be repaired. An ice scoop was left on the ice machine.

headline: Food handler training not documented
summary: The manager was told to comply with Illinois food handler training requirements for all food employees.

headline: No handwashing signs; allergen certificate expired
summary: Three bathrooms and the kitchen hand sink lacked hand-washing signs. The floor in the northern basement office was heavily soiled. The manager in charge had an expired allergen training certificate.

headline: No certified food manager; hot holding broken
summary: No valid certified food manager certificate was posted, and the person in charge lacked one. The hot holding unit was inoperable, the menu lacked a raw food advisory, and the three-compartment sink backs up. Many repairs ordered.

headline: No splash guard between sinks
summary: No splash guard or protective barrier was found between the hand sink and the three-compartment sink. One must be provided.

headline: Blinking light; soiled foil on shelf
summary: Soiled aluminum foil was used as a shelf liner in the prep area and must be removed. A blinking ceiling light in the women's restroom must be fixed. A paper towel dispenser was moved next to the hand sink.

headline: Leaking faucet; pallets used for storage elevation
summary: Wooden pallets were used to elevate food in rear storage and must be replaced with shelving at least six inches off the floor. Cardboard shelf liners and white plastic on a prep table must be removed. A leaking eastside sink faucet must be repaired.

headline: Rat and mouse droppings; no certified manager
summary: Over 100 rat droppings and over 100 mouse droppings were found in prep, dish, storage, basement, and office areas. No certified sanitation manager was on site. The dish sink was clogged and not accessible. An exterminator was instructed, and a citation was issued.

headline: No food manager; no pest logbook; gaps at doors
summary: No City of Chicago food manager certificate was on premises. No pest control logbook was on premises. Quarter-inch gaps at both exit doors must be rodent-proofed. Backflow devices are needed at the mop sink, and no bar sink or allergen certificates were on site.

headline: Restrooms missing covered trash cans
summary: Both all-gender restrooms lacked covered waste receptacles. Wiping cloths were stored in water without sanitizer. No hand-washing sign was at the front prep sink. Employee beverages were stored above food.

headline: Dirty ice machine interior; dusty fan cover
summary: The large ice machine interior needs cleaning. Coffee beans and debris were on floors in prep areas, and a missing vent fan cover in a washroom must be replaced. Four food handlers had expired certificates.

headline: No employee health policy; torn gasket
summary: No verifiable employee health policy was on site. A torn cooler gasket and food stored in plastic grocery bags were found. Soiled mop heads must be hung. No allergen training was on site.

headline: Water-damaged ceilings; dirty vents; cardboard shelves
summary: Wiping cloths were stored on prep coolers instead of in sanitizer. Cardboard was used on shelving. Water-damaged ceiling tiles, dusty vents, and grease on hood filters were noted. One of two light bulbs over prep coolers was out.

headline: No covered trash can in restroom
summary: No covered receptacle was inside the restroom. The operator was told to provide one.

headline: Single-service trays face up; low hot water
summary: Single-service trays at the cook line were facing up and must be inverted to protect them from overhead contamination. Hot water pressure was low in the women's restroom and must be repaired.

headline: Splash guards needed; cement floor not cleanable
