summary: Splash guards are needed between hand sinks and food prep areas. Expanding spray foam sealed gaps behind a cooler and must be removed. A cement floor in front of the three-compartment sink is not smooth or cleanable.

headline: Soiled wiping cloths left on prep tables
summary: Soiled wiping cloths were stored on prep tables instead of in sanitizing solution. A torn freezer door gasket and debris along walls were also noted. No food handler training certificates were shown for employees.

headline: 75 or more mouse droppings; citation issued
summary: About 75 or more mouse droppings were found at the bar, on railings, and throughout the basement near the ice machine and shelving. The droppings must be removed and areas sanitized. A pest control service was recommended, and a citation was issued.

headline: Dish machine not sanitizing; food stored on floor
summary: The dish machine was not sanitizing, with 0 ppm chlorine, and was repaired on site to 100 ppm. Food containers were stored on the floor in the walk-in cooler and freezer. Food was in plastic bags; wet wiping cloths and no food handler certificates were found.

headline: Missing thermometers; no backflow device
summary: No thermometer was placed in the bottled beverage reach-in cooler. The rear utility sink has no backflow device. Missing and damaged ceiling panels above the service sink must be replaced.

headline: No food handler training; no backflow device
summary: No food handler training was seen for employees who handle food. The utility sink lacks a backflow device. The certified manager on duty had no allergen training. Corrections must be documented on the next visit.

headline: No food handler training certificates
summary: No food handler training certificate was shown for any food employee. The operator was instructed to provide them.

headline: Hand sink blocked; no paper towels; no summary
summary: The basement dish area hand sink was blocked by a storage rack; the manager moved it. The third-floor bar hand sink had no paper towels; the food handler obtained them during inspection. The inspection summary was not posted and a copy was given. A citation was issued.

headline: Uncovered cooler food; missing thermometers
summary: Reach-in coolers lacked ambient air thermometers, and food containers lacked common-name labels. Food stored uncovered in coolers must get lids or covers. Dirt and grease were found in the mop sink area and fryer area.

headline: No vomit cleanup kit; no summary posted
summary: No procedure or clean-up kit for vomit and diarrhea events was on site. Wiping cloths were stored on prep tables. Soiled mop heads, dust in an employee restroom vent, and dirt behind basement refrigerators were noted. The inspection summary was not posted.

headline: No certified manager; no vomit kit; overflowing trash
summary: No certified manager was on duty and no valid certificate was posted. No vomit and diarrhea supplies were on site. Dumpsters were overflowing with trash. Food handlers had no training, and a citation was issued.

headline: Single-use articles not inverted; no hot water
summary: Single-service articles and utensils were not inverted in the prep area. Two male employees had no food handler training. The utility sink lacked hot water and a backflow device. A large ceiling opening in the rear prep area must be sealed.

headline: Clogged hand sink; sink water spills on floor
summary: The hot-prep hand sink was clogged and not draining and must be repaired. Hand soap was missing and then provided. Waste water spilled from the deli sink drain, and the deli prep area was closed. A citation was issued.

headline: Dirty prep cooler; hole under sink
summary: Spills and debris were in the prep cooler and must be cleaned. A hole in the wall under the three-compartment sink must be repaired to keep out pests.

headline: Unclean prep tables, shelves, and sinks
summary: Preparation tables, shelving units, and sinks were not clean and must be cleaned. Floors in preparation areas were also not clean and must be cleaned.

headline: Food residue in coolers; torn gaskets
summary: Food residue was found on shelving in the basement walk-in cooler and in reach-in cooler gaskets. Torn gaskets were found on a salad cooler, and debris was on the basement freezer floor. The manager was told to clean and repair.

headline: No certified manager; milk held above 41F
summary: No certified food manager was on site while TCS foods were prepared and served. Foods were held at 46-48F; 2.5 gallons of milk and a quart of half-and-half were discarded. A 1/4-inch rear door gap must be sealed. A citation was issued.

headline: No vomit and diarrhea cleanup kit
summary: No written procedure or supplies existed for vomit and diarrhea cleanup. The front entrance door has a half-inch gap and must be rodent-proofed. Raw wood at the customer counter must be sealed.

headline: Ice machine buildup; food debris on bar floors
summary: Slight buildup was inside the donut shop ice machine and must be cleaned. Food debris was on bar floors and walls and must be cleaned.

headline: Missing backflow device; no allergen training proof
summary: The basement utility sink faucet is broken and needs a backflow device. Water-damaged ceiling tiles, holes in the kitchen door, and a missing light shield were noted. No proof of allergen training for the certified food manager was shown.

headline: Staircase food storage; greasy equipment
summary: Canned and boxed food was stored on staircases and must be moved to shelving off the floor. Wiping cloths were stored on cutting boards. Heavy grease and food debris were on grill, prep, and cooler equipment and walls. Crates used for food storage must be removed.

headline: No food manager training; TCS foods unprotected
summary: The person in charge had no food safety management training proof. Food handlers prepared TCS foods without a certified manager on site, and a citation was issued. Multiple uncorrected core violations were noted, including an unclean ice machine and no food handler training proof.

headline: Flies throughout building; hand sinks blocked
summary: More than 15 small flies were found in the main floor bar, second floor bar, and second floor kitchen. Hand sinks were blocked by strainers, and one was used as a dump sink. The ice machines had black-pink buildup. A citation was issued for pests.

headline: Small gap at rear exit door
summary: A small opening at the bottom of the rear exit door must be rodent-proofed.

headline: Seven dead cockroaches; torn gaskets
summary: About seven dead cockroaches were found in the main prep area, storage closet, and secondary prep area. Torn gaskets were on two refrigeration units, and raw wood shelves must be sealed. Missing and damaged floor tiles throughout must be repaired.

headline: Ice buildup in chest freezer; clutter behind
summary: Excessive ice buildup was in the ice cream chest freezer and must be removed. Dirt and debris were in the front three-door cooler. Clutter, buckets, pallets, and unused equipment must be removed to prevent rodent harborage.

headline: Unclean ice machine interior
summary: The inside of the ice machine was not clean. The manager was told to remove ice, clean, and sanitize all surfaces.

headline: Grease behind cooking line; no training certificates
summary: Wiping cloths were not stored in sanitizer, and there were no sink stoppers for the three-compartment sink. Grease and food debris were on walls and equipment behind the cooking line. No food handler or allergen training certificates were on site.

headline: Dish machine sanitizing rinse too cool; citation
summary: High-temperature dish machine's final sanitizing rinse measured 79°F; it must be at least 165°F. Citation issued. Also milk crates used to elevate used-oil containers, and dust on the ceiling and wall near the ice scoop holder.

headline: Slimy ice machine; wastewater backing up
summary: Ice machine interior had black and pink slimy buildup; citation issued. Wastewater backs up when the three-compartment sink drains, grease trap overflows, and the basement mop sink cannot drain; a technician cleaned the grease trap on site. No raw-food menu advisory.

headline: Milk crates used as shelving; torn freezer gaskets
summary: Milk crates were used for elevation and must be replaced with proper shelving, with food 6 inches from walls. Torn, dirty freezer gasket in front prep. Excessive grease on deep fryers and heavy debris in walk-in shelves. Manager allergen proof required.

headline: No vomit and diarrhea cleanup kit on site
summary: No kit or procedure for vomit and diarrhea cleanup was on site; a norovirus-effective sanitizer must be kept on hand. Also missing handwashing signs, no utility sink, a door not self-closing, and no covered receptacle.

headline: No certified manager at opening; flies and gnats found
summary: No certified food manager on site at the start of inspection while TCS foods were handled. About 12-15 small flies or gnats in prep, dish, dry storage, and bathroom areas; citation issued. Also no employee health policy and no sanitizer test strips.

headline: No vomit and diarrhea cleanup procedure or supplies
summary: No procedures or supplies for responding to vomiting and diarrhea events; manager told to provide a cleanup policy and supplies. Also no backflow device on utility sink, no covered receptacle in washroom, and no washroom ventilation.

headline: Basement storage floors not clean
summary: Floors in basement storage areas were not clean and must be cleaned.

headline: Missing food handler and allergen certificates
summary: No food handler certificates and no food allergen certificates were on site; all staff and managers must obtain them. Hair restraints were corrected on site. Wiping cloths on a prep table were not stored in sanitizer; floors and vents need cleaning.

headline: Cooler gasket residue; items stored on basement floor
summary: Food residue was on the gaskets of a two-door cooler. Items stored on the basement floor must be raised at least six inches. A missing outlet cover behind the register area must be replaced to prevent pest harborage.

headline: Restroom exhaust fans not working
summary: Exhaust fans at the restrooms were not operational. The facility must repair them.

headline: Fly paper found; grime and expired manager allergen training
summary: Fly paper hanging in rear prep area; manager told to remove it and have a licensed pest technician address flying insects. Also excessive grime in service sink and drains, grease on walls, items on floor, and expired allergen training.

headline: Flies throughout; prep coolers lack thermometers
summary: About 50 or more live small flies found in dining, prep, dish, bar, and basement areas; pest control service recommended, citation issued. Also no thermometers on prep coolers, a front door gap, a slow sink drain, and grease and ice buildup.

headline: No certified manager; no vomit cleanup plan
summary: No certified food manager on site while TCS foods were handled; citation issued. No procedure for vomit and diarrhea cleanup; citation issued. Also unlabeled bulk containers, a dirty floor drain, and no public summary posted from the previous inspection.

headline: No cooler thermometer; crates and rust found
summary: No thermometer for the small glass reach-in cooler and prep cooler; one must be provided. A food handler lacked a hair restraint. Crates must be removed from storage, rust removed, and the rear door closure repaired. Dust, dirt, and damaged floor tiles noted.

headline: Unscreened kitchen window; cook lacks training proof
summary: Open kitchen window to the outdoors was not screened; a tight-fitting mesh screen is required to prevent pest entry. Rusty, dirty shelving under a prep table. A cook lacked proof of food handler training.

headline: Minor leak near truck wastewater tank
summary: A minor leak was found at the bottom of the truck near the wastewater tank; instructed to repair it.

headline: No certified manager; smoking inside facility
summary: No valid certified food manager on site; TCS (time/temperature-controlled) foods held at 59.5-74.5°F, and about 10 lbs were discarded. Thawing was improper and no vomit cleanup kit was present. Smoking inside with cigarette butts on the floor, citation issued.

headline: Dish machine at 0 ppm; mouse droppings, dead roaches
summary: Low-temperature dish machine read 0 ppm chlorine; tagged, citation issued. Over 50 mouse droppings in storage and basement, and dead roaches on glue boards; pest control required, citation issued. Also heavy fryer grease and a wet basement floor.

headline: Hood vent system dusty
summary: The hood vent system needs cleaning to remove dust buildup. Instructed to clean and maintain.

headline: Expired manager allergen certificate; freezer ice
summary: Heavy ice buildup and spillage inside the basement chest freezer must be cleaned. The City of Chicago food manager's allergen certificate was expired and must be renewed.

headline: Droppings in several areas; no soap at sink
summary: About 15-30 droppings found along walls in produce, soda storage, deli, and basement areas; citation issued, and pest control service with proof required by 5/13/2025. No soap at fish department handwash sink, citation issued.

headline: No certified manager; no soap or paper towels
summary: No certified manager on site while chicken was prepared; citation issued. No soap or paper towels at exposed handwash sinks in the prep area and bar; citation issued. Beef thawing on a pan above the cook line; broken dish machine; no test strips.

headline: Food on floor; cup used as scoop
summary: Food containers stored on the floor in prep, storage, and walk-in coolers and freezers must be raised 6 inches. A handleless cup was used to scoop food. Serving plates not inverted, knives stored by a sink, and basement clutter cited; managers lack allergen training.

headline: Mouse droppings in food storage closet
summary: About 25 mouse droppings on the floor of the food prep storage closet; cleaning and additional pest control required, citation issued. A half-inch gap at the rear exit door to the alley must be sealed. Basement clutter must be raised off the floor.

headline: Deli cooler too warm; about 90 lbs discarded
summary: TCS (time/temperature-controlled) deli meats and cheeses held at 55-65.5°F in a reach-in cooler; about 90 lbs ($300) discarded. The cooler, at 50.8°F, was tagged and must not be used until it holds 41°F. Knives stored in standing water.

headline: No certified manager while TCS foods served
summary: No City of Chicago food sanitation manager was on site while TCS (time/temperature-controlled) oysters, pork, and eggs were prepared and served. A manager must be on site at all times; citation issued.

headline: Loose bathroom faucet; one dishwashing light out
summary: Bathroom sink faucet was extremely loose and moved when the handle was turned; manager told to secure it. One light was not working in the rear dishwashing area; manager told to service all lights.

headline: Heavy grease spills under cooking equipment
summary: Heavy grease spills on floors under cooking equipment were observed. The facility must clean and maintain these areas.

headline: Oysters lacked tags; ice machines had mold-like buildup
summary: Fresh oysters in a cooler had no shellstock tag; the container was voluntarily discarded on site, valued at $150 (6 lbs). Ice machines had mold-like and pink or black buildup. A raw-food menu advisory was added on site.

headline: Basement leaks, rust, mold; some fixes made on site
summary: Stored pots were removed by the manager, and the basement dish sink was cleaned during inspection. Ordered repairs include leaking spray arm, missing floor drain cover, moldy caulking, rusty racks, plastic crates used for elevation, and removal of an unused oven.

headline: Grill exterior and kitchen floors need cleaning
summary: Clean the exterior of the grill in the kitchen. Clean the floors around and under kitchen equipment, and the walls around and behind cooking equipment.

headline: Over 30 mouse droppings; handwash sinks blocked
summary: Over 30 mouse droppings on the basement floor and along walls; citation issued, and pest control service is required. Both handwash sinks were blocked by equipment and lacked hand-drying supplies; paper towels were provided during inspection.

headline: Rodent droppings found; no certificate or health policy
summary: About 100 mouse droppings found in dry storage, walk-in coolers, and near the grease trap; more pest control needed, citation issued. No valid food sanitation certificate, no employee health policy, pest log not kept, and no public summary posted.

headline: Three-compartment sink backs up wastewater
summary: Wastewater backs up in the three-compartment sink when its compartments are drained. The person in charge must repair and maintain it; citation issued.

headline: Greasy hot-holding units; bent door sweep
summary: Rear door sweep has bent bristles and must be repaired to be tight-fitting. Excessive grease and food debris on hot and cold holding units, shelving, fryers, and walk-in cooler must be cleaned. A bearded food handler needs a beard guard.

headline: No certified manager while beef was served
summary: No certified food manager on site while TCS (time/temperature-controlled) beef was prepared and served; citation issued. Also no designated person in charge, no food handler training, unlabeled melon, and food stored on floor.

headline: Backflow leak, peeling ceiling paint, greasy vents
summary: Complaint inspection found a leak at the backflow preventer under the three-compartment sink, peeling paint over basement pasta storage, a dirty dish area floor, and greasy hood vents. All were ordered repaired or cleaned.

headline: Cold foods held too warm; flies found
summary: Cold TCS (time/temperature-controlled) foods held at 49.8-53.3°F; about 15 lbs discarded. A cold-holding unit at 53.1°F was tagged. About 40 small flies found; pest control recommended. Also missing handwashing signs and a sink at 87.8°F.

headline: Torn cooler gasket; soiled cloth curtains
summary: Cutting boards and utensils must not be stored at the prep handwash sink. Plastic bowls without handles were used to dispense food. A torn gasket on a two-door cooler must be replaced. Missing floor tile and a hole in the washroom wall need repair.

headline: Items on hallway floor; missing ceiling tiles
summary: Single-service items in the hallway closet are on the floor and must be raised. Raw wood shelving must be painted or sealed. Dust on a restroom vent, dirty closet floor, missing ceiling tiles in prep, and an inoperable employee restroom vent.

headline: Handwash sink not easily accessible; stoppers fail
summary: The bakery prep and service area lacks easy access to a handwashing sink; one must be installed. Three-compartment sink drain stoppers do not hold water, so sinks cannot be filled for dishwashing; repair or replacement required.

headline: No soap or paper towels; dish machine too cool
summary: No soap at rear dish sink and no paper towels at main prep handwash sink; citations issued, employee supplied them during inspection. High-temperature final rinse was 148°F (needs 180-194°F); low-temperature sanitizer read 10 ppm (needs 100).

headline: Unlabeled bulk food; food stored on floor
summary: Bulk food in basement containers was not labeled with its name. Food containers stored on the floor in prep, storage, and walk-in cooler; raised shelving 6 inches off the floor is required. Also leaking faucets and cardboard lining shelves.

headline: Frozen steak thawed in standing water
summary: Frozen steak was thawed in cold standing water in the three-compartment sink; manager told to thaw TCS (time/temperature-controlled) foods properly. Also a heavily scored cutting board, broken container lids, a leaking backflow device, and broken wall tiles.

headline: Food stored in grocery bags; stained cutting boards
summary: Food in coolers and freezer stored in grocery bags; must use food-grade bags or containers. Stained cutting boards, torn sushi-cooler gasket, and milk-crate shelving also cited; shelves must sit 6 inches off floor.

headline: Produce on floor; uncovered food in prep cooler
summary: Boxes of uncut produce stored on the floor in prep and dry storage must be raised 6 inches. Food in a two-door prep cooler was uncovered; food-grade lids or covers are required. Tape was used to repair a torn freezer gasket.

headline: No food handler training; debris by dumpsters
summary: No food handler training for employees who handle food and equipment; training must be provided. Debris on the ground around dumpsters must be cleaned and maintained.

headline: One handwashing sink not hot enough
summary: One of four handwashing sinks was not getting hot enough water. The facility must repair and maintain it.

headline: Raw foods stored above ready-to-eat foods
summary: Raw fish, beef, and eggs stored above ready-to-eat shrimp, tempura, vegetables, and uncovered rice in a reach-in cooler; all foods removed, citation issued. Most menus lacked a raw-food advisory. Certified manager had no allergen training proof.

headline: Hair restraint missing; wiping cloths left on tables
summary: Employee not wearing a hair restraint while food was prepared and served. Wiping cloths were stored on prep tables instead of in sanitizing solution. Also leaking sink handle, low water pressure at a handwash sink, and dusty light covers.

headline: Meats held too warm; about 20 lbs discarded
summary: Steak at 45°F in a two-door refrigerator; pastor, raw chicken, and chorizo at 45-52°F. TCS (time/temperature-controlled) foods must be at 41°F or below; about 20 lbs ($200) discarded voluntarily. Citation issued. Also torn freezer gasket.

headline: Over 40 mouse droppings; no certified manager
summary: Over 40 mouse droppings found on desk, floor, and shelves in office area; exterminator required, citation issued. No certified food manager on site while TCS foods were served, citation issued. Food stored on floor.

headline: Torn cooler gasket; holes near walk-up window
summary: A torn gasket on the front prep cooler must be repaired. Two holes in the wall near the walk-up window must be repaired to prevent pest entry.

headline: Fly strip above sink; greasy fryers
summary: A fly strip was hanging above the rear three-compartment sink and must be removed; fly strips should not be hung in prep areas. Thick grease in deep fryers, dirty coolers and freezers, broken floor tiles, and greasy ventilation filters.

headline: Cut tomatoes and lettuce held too warm
summary: Cut tomatoes and shredded lettuce held at 48°F; TCS (time/temperature-controlled) foods must be at 41°F or below. About 3 lbs tomatoes and 1/4 lb lettuce ($10) discarded; citation issued. Also a leaking three-compartment sink faucet and soil buildup around dish and ice machines.

headline: Wiping cloths lack sanitizer; loose bakery faucet
summary: Wiping cloths in the storefront were stored without adequate sanitizer solution; they must be kept in sanitizer between uses. Soiled cold-holding gaskets, a loose bakery sink faucet, and insufficient lighting in basement walk-in coolers.

headline: Loose cooler gaskets; expired food handler cards
summary: Loose gaskets on a three-door cooler in the smoothie prep area must be sealed or replaced. Expired food handler training certificates were found; all food handlers must obtain valid certificates. Food allergen certificates for managers were also expired.

headline: Handwash water too cool; flies and rust found
summary: Handwashing sinks measured 75.6-95.2°F; they must reach at least 100°F (citation issued). About 15 large flies and fly activity in rear prep area; pest control recommended. Rust inside ice machine, bar sink drain disconnected, and a damaged dumpster lid.

headline: Certified manager missing allergen training
summary: A City of Chicago certified manager was missing allergen training. Staff were instructed to obtain training and keep verification on site.

headline: No certified manager while milk was prepared
summary: Complaint inspection found no City of Chicago certified food manager on premises while TCS (time/temperature-controlled) milk was prepared. Citation issued; a certified manager must be present during TCS food preparation.

headline: Rat droppings found; no raw-food advisory
summary: About 30 rat droppings found on floor around the ice machine in rear prep; citation issued and pest control recommended. Front entrance doors not rodent-proof. The menu lacks a raw or undercooked food advisory; no handwashing sign by the prep sink.

headline: Spills under sink need cleaning
summary: Spills under the one-compartment sink must be cleaned.

headline: Ice machine black residue; dish machine failed
summary: Ice machine interior had excessive black substance; ice disposed, cleaning ordered, citation issued. Low-temperature dish unit read 0 ppm chlorine, was tagged, and must not be used. Also stained cutting boards, reused sour cream containers, and missing handwash signs.

headline: Unlabeled batter flour; greasy fryer and walls
summary: Batter flour was out of its original container without a product name label; staff told to label all foods and spices. Heavy grease and food debris found in the fryer oil filter unit and on walls and floors along the hot food line.

headline: Propane tanks stored in furnace room
summary: Single-service articles were not inverted in the prep area. Propane tanks and unused equipment in the furnace room must be removed to prevent pest harborage. A light shield near the hood is missing. Certified managers lacked allergen training.

headline: Certified managers lack allergen training
summary: Serving plates on prep and dining shelves were not inverted. Certified food managers on duty lacked allergen training certification; management must obtain it.

headline: Food stored in tin cans; rusty walk-in shelves
summary: Food items were stored inside tin cans in coolers and refrigeration units; approved food-grade containers are required. Rusty, dirty shelves in walk-in coolers must be cleaned, repainted with food-grade paint, or replaced.

headline: Hot meats cooled improperly; food left uncovered
summary: Hot meats were stored in the walk-in cooler without proper cooling methods; food in the front service area was uncovered. Also missing handwashing signs, no ambient air thermometers in walk-in coolers, and a missing sink stopper.

headline: Food stored on floor in prep and storage
summary: Food items were stored on the floor in prep and storage areas. Management was instructed to elevate all food items six inches off the floor.

headline: No employee health policy; food handler without certificate
summary: No written employee health policy on premises; citation issued. A food handler lacked proof of training. Previous violations were not corrected, and a leak at the three-compartment sink drain must be repaired.

headline: Backflow device not found on ice machine
summary: A backflow device could not be located on the ice machine; one must be installed where it can be serviced. Allergen training had expired; training must be obtained and verification kept on site.

headline: Pink buildup in ice machine; no backflow device
summary: Slight pink buildup inside the ice machine must be cleaned. A backflow prevention device was not visible at the ice machine water line and must be provided. One food manager lacked allergen certificate and one had an expired certificate.

headline: Women's restroom hand sink not working
summary: The middle metered hand sink in the women's restroom was not working; instructed to repair. A wet mop was stored in a bucket in the dishwashing area; mops must be hung to dry.

headline: No norovirus disinfectant; food handler without hair restraint
summary: No disinfectant effective against norovirus was available for vomit or diarrhea cleanup; citation issued. Handwashing sink in rear prep had no soap; corrected on site. Food handler not wearing hair restraint. Dust, ice buildup, and food on shelves cited.

headline: Food service manager lacks allergen training
summary: The food service sanitation manager had no allergen training certificate. Staff were instructed to meet the requirement.

headline: No employee health policy or training
summary: No employee health policy or training was on site; a signed policy is required for each employee, citation issued. Handwashing signage needed at the sink outside the washroom. A leaky faucet neck at the three-compartment sink and plywood and debris behind the dumpster.

headline: Mop not drying properly; hood vents dirty
summary: A mop was not positioned to dry, which can harbor pests; it must be mounted for air-drying. Ventilation hood and filters above cooking equipment need cleaning and maintenance.

headline: Ice machine guard dirty; food stored on floor
summary: Dirt on the ice machine interior guard in rear prep must be detail cleaned. Bulk food containers stored on the floor in rear prep must be raised 6 inches. Deeply scratched cutting boards, a torn cooler gasket, and food debris on floors.

headline: No partition at hand sink; calcium buildup
summary: No partition between the hand sink and three-compartment sink in the rear prep area; one must be provided. Calcium buildup on the men's restroom faucet must be cleaned.

headline: Over 30 rat droppings; no handwash signs
summary: Over 30 rat droppings were found along walls at the rear bar; citation issued. Staff must detail clean, sanitize, and consult pest control. No handwashing signs at the bar sink. Serving plates not inverted; leaks under the bar sink and ice bin.

headline: Front door gap; ice buildup in basement freezer
summary: An opening at the base of the front entrance outer doors must be sealed to prevent pest entry. Ice buildup on condenser lines in the basement walk-in freezer must be removed. Mop drying in utility sink needs a drying rack.

headline: Dish machine failed sanitizing; corrected on site
summary: Low-temperature dish machine read 0 ppm (parts per million) sanitizer at rinse; staff told to hand-wash in the three-compartment sink, and the machine was tagged. A repair person corrected it to 100 ppm on site. Dirty freezers and hood vents also cited.

headline: Packaged food on dry storage floor; dull knife
summary: Packaged food and beverages were stored directly on the dry storage closet floor; must be moved 6 inches above ground. Also wet soiled wiping cloths in a bucket, a chef's knife missing its tip, and a certified manager without allergen training.

headline: Unlabeled seasonings; residue inside ice machine
summary: Seasonings and breadcrumbs were out of original containers without product name labels; all must be labeled. Residue was found inside the ice machine and must be cleaned. A fan in the walk-in cooler needs cleaning.

headline: No food sanitation manager; hand-washing lapse
summary: No City of Chicago food sanitation manager on site while chicken was being prepared; citation issued. A food handler washed hands at the three-compartment sink and then fried chicken; citation issued. A soiled mop head was not stored properly.

headline: No employee health policy; door needs rodent-proofing
summary: No employee health policy verification available. Must be provided and maintained for each food employee, citation priority. Instructed to rodent-proof the bottom of the door in the party room.

headline: Certified manager lacks allergen training certificate
summary: A covered receptacle for sanitary napkins is required in the female toilet room. The certified food manager lacked an allergen training certificate; must complete training and keep the certificate on site.

headline: Meatballs covered while cooling; plastic cups as scoops
summary: Meatballs were covered with plastic wrap while cooling in the walk-in; TCS (time/temperature-controlled) foods should be loosely covered or uncovered. Single-use plastic cups were used as scoops in sauce containers. Floors beneath fryers were heavily soiled.

headline: Roach infestation; no soap; hot water failed
summary: About 30 or more live roaches found on walls, shelves, sinks, and wall bases in prep and dish areas; about 40 live small flies in bar and dining areas. Pest control service required, citation issued. No soap or hand towels at some sinks; hot water was below 55°F.

headline: Greasy fryers and oven; manager lacks allergen training
summary: Fryer and oven interiors had food and grease buildup. A certified food manager (CFM) lacked an allergen training certificate. Also cited: rusty cooler racks, cracked restroom wall, and dirt and food splatter in the kitchen.

headline: Employees eating at prep area; roast beef too warm
summary: Employees were drinking and eating at the kitchen prep area; a designated break area is required. Two containers of roast beef measured 44.9-50.1°F in a service cooler; about 7 lbs ($50) voluntarily discarded, citation issued. Food on floors in walk-ins.

headline: Over 100 mouse droppings; gnawed chips for sale
summary: Over 100 mouse droppings found on display shelves, floors, and storage areas; several roaches on sinks. Gnawed chips contaminated with droppings were on sale and must be discarded. Dumpster lids missing. Exterminator required; citations issued.

headline: Unlabeled butter and flour; cloths on wire cart
summary: A butter bottle and a flour container had no labels; common names are required. Wiping cloths for equipment and food surfaces were stored on a wire push cart; staff told to use a sanitizing bucket.

headline: Items stored on floor behind bar
summary: Items were stored on the floor behind the bar in the front dining area. The person in charge was told to keep all items at least six inches off the floor.

headline: Greasy fryer and floors around cooking equipment
summary: Accumulated grease and food debris were found inside the fryer and on floors around cooking equipment. The facility was instructed to clean.

headline: No signed employee health policy; repeat violations
summary: No signed employee health policy on premises; citation issued. A food handler lacked proof of training. Previous violations not corrected: certified managers lacked allergen training, citation issued. A leak at the three-compartment sink drain must be repaired.

headline: No handwash signs; single-use items not inverted
summary: No handwashing signs at the sink by the washroom and in the beverage area; single-service articles were not inverted in prep. Repeat violations: oversized pots without a written procedure and no manager allergen training; citation issued.

headline: Mouse droppings under sinks; dead ants
summary: About 40 or more mouse droppings found under sinks, behind ovens, and in dry storage; pest control recommended, citation issued. Dead ants on the basement stair landing. Pink and black buildup in the ice machine. No allergen training certificate on site.

headline: Certified manager lacks allergen training
summary: The certified food manager on duty had no allergen training certificate. Management was told all certified food managers must show proof of allergen training.

headline: New liquor license requires prep sink
summary: The establishment is adding a liquor license. It must install at least a one-compartment prep and dump sink in the drink preparation area, or remove the door to give unobstructed access to kitchen sinks.

headline: Flies throughout; cold food and water too warm
summary: More than 15 small flies were found in both bar areas, dish, dry storage, and upstairs storage. Fish was held at 48F and a cooler at 50F, and both were tagged or discarded. Handwashing sink water reached only 72F.

headline: Over 100 rodent droppings; 100+ flies; sewage backup
summary: Over 100 mouse and rat droppings and over 100 small flies were found in the main prep, dish, and storage areas. Spoiled food worth $450 was discarded. Wastewater backed up in the three-compartment sink, and handwashing sink water was 71-72F.

headline: About 75 live roaches and mouse droppings found
summary: Inspector found an infestation of about 75 or more live roaches near the biscuit prep table and about 30 or more mouse droppings at the drive-thru. Food handlers lacked certificates, and employee health policies were missing. Pest control service was required.

headline: Leaks under employee handsink and three-compartment sink
summary: Inspector observed a leak from the bottom of the employee washroom handsink and a leak from the pipe under the three-compartment sink. The facility was instructed to repair both leaks.

headline: Employee washed hands in prep sink; corrected on site
summary: An employee washed hands in the sushi prep sink instead of the handwashing sink. The manager was told hands must be washed at the handwashing sink. Clogged and leaking sinks and debris under shelving also need attention.

headline: Missing splash guards on handwashing sinks
summary: Splash guards were missing from several handwashing sinks in the front prep and barista areas. The operator must install them to prevent contamination.

headline: Dirty shelves, walk-in cooler, and dishwashing area
summary: Inspector required detail cleaning of shelving, prep stations, counters, and the walk-in cooler interior. Floors, floor drains, and areas under sinks and the dish machine needed cleaning. Standing water in the dishwashing area had to be removed.

headline: Missing food handler certificates; wall panel loose
summary: No food handler certificates were on site for staff handling food, a repeat core violation. Cutting boards had stains and deep cuts. A wall panel beside the ice machine was separating and must be repaired.

headline: Five live cockroaches on kitchen wall; citation issued
summary: Five live cockroaches were seen crawling on a kitchen wall. The operator must eliminate all pest evidence and clean and sanitize affected areas. A citation was issued. Open baseboards with heavy grease also need cleaning and sealing.

headline: Improper chicken thawing; rear door sweep damaged
summary: Vacuum-packed chicken was thawed in sinks without running cold water. The operator was told to thaw food properly. A rear door sweep was damaged and must be repaired. Several other cleaning and storage items were noted.

headline: No covered trash can in women's restroom
summary: The women's restroom had no covered receptacle for sanitary napkins. The operator was instructed to provide one.

headline: Dish machine too cool; no hot water in some sinks
summary: Dish machine final rinse reached only 155F and must reach 160F; the machine was tagged. A dish machine leak, cleaning-procedure gaps for large kettles, and restroom sinks with no water or hot water below 100F were also found.

headline: Dusty walk-in fan covers; loose wall coving
summary: Dust was on walk-in cooler fan covers and must be cleaned. Wall coving in the rear storage area was in poor repair and must be reattached where needed.

headline: Dish machine not sanitizing; cluttered basement
summary: Low-temperature dish machine sanitized at 0 ppm chlorine and must reach 50-100 ppm. It was tagged as a priority violation. A dishmachine sprayer leak, a cutting board with grooves, cluttered basement floors, and non-working restroom fans were also noted.

headline: Overflowing dumpster; expired food handler certificate
summary: The outside dumpster was overflowing, and the dumpster area was not maintained, a priority violation. A food handler certificate had expired. Handwash signage was missing, and food workers lacked hair restraints. Core violations were not corrected.

headline: Dish machine gauge inaccurate; hole in wall
summary: The high-temperature dish machine's final rinse gauge read 162F, but the actual temperature was not accurately shown. This is a priority violation. A large hole in the rear linen room wall must be sealed.

headline: Food debris in floor drains; oil leak
summary: Food debris was found in floor drains. An oil leak from a used oil tank in the rear prep area caused spillage on the floor. The person in charge was instructed to clean and maintain the area.

headline: Pest control records missing; no hot water in restrooms
summary: Pest control log was missing required information and visit records. The high-temperature dish machine lacked a required temperature indicator. Restroom sinks had no hot water, which must be repaired. No citations were issued at this visit.

headline: Deep cuts in cutting boards; grease under sink
summary: Cutting boards had deep cuts and stains and must be cleaned and restored or replaced. Grease and debris were on the floor drain under the three-compartment sink. A box with equipment tops was stored on the floor.

headline: Unlabeled packaged treats; leaking two-compartment sink
summary: Unlabeled cookies and pecan bars for self-service in the dining room needed food names, ingredients, and packer information. Two-door refrigerator gaskets were damaged. The two-compartment sink faucet leaked, and a backflow device was missing from an employee utility sink.

headline: No handsink in rear prep; dishmachine not installed
summary: No handwashing sink was in the rear prep area, so the operator must install one. A dish machine was not installed or approved and was tagged. The pest control log was missing required records, which were updated during the inspection.

headline: Uncertified staff handling food; cooler display broken
summary: Food was prepared without an on-site certified food manager, and the original certificate was not posted. The walk-in cooler outside display thermometer was not working, though the internal air reading was under 41F. Floor tiles and ceiling panels need repair.

headline: Single-use items stored on floor; corrected on site
summary: Single-service items were stored on the floor and not inverted. The manager was told to elevate and invert them. Clutter was also stored on the restroom utility closet floor, which can attract pests.

headline: Broken faucets, leaks, and deteriorated ceilings
summary: Multiple plumbing problems were noted, including a faucet with no hot water and a leaking backflow device in the bakery. Ceilings and handsinks were in poor repair. Milk crates and pallets were used as shelving, and floors needed cleaning.

headline: Missing food handler certificates; floors need cleaning
summary: Multiple food handlers lacked food handler certificates, which must be provided. Bulk containers had no labels, and food debris was under cooking equipment. A handsink had no signage, and unfinished wood on a shelf needed sealing.

headline: Greasy equipment; no service sink; expired allergen cert
summary: Cooking equipment, coolers, and shelves had grease and food debris, and the facility had no service sink for mop water. A toilet room door was not self-closing, and one manager's allergen certificate had expired.

headline: No certified manager; grease trap leaking
summary: No city food sanitation manager was on site while TCS foods like chicken were prepared, a priority violation with a citation. The grease trap under the three-compartment sink leaked onto the prep floor. No food handler or allergen training was on site.

headline: Raw chicken and foods held too warm; 30 lbs discarded
summary: Raw chicken was held at 45F inside the walk-in cooler, and cheese, burgers, pork, chili, and wings were held at 45-47F. Cold food must stay at 41F or below. About 30 lbs was voluntarily discarded.

headline: Greasy, debris-filled floors in dish and storage areas
summary: Food debris and buildup were found on floors under the handsink and high-temperature dish machine, and grease on the grease trap. Storage closet floors, wall bases, and corners in the hallway also need cleaning.

headline: Wet wiping cloths stored loose; floors need cleaning
summary: Wet wiping cloths were stored around the dishwashing areas in the bar and kitchen instead of in sanitizing solution. Floors under the three-compartment sink and in the kitchen prep area need detail cleaning.

headline: Broken and missing ceiling tile above mop sink
summary: Broken and missing ceiling tiles were found above the mop sink and cleaning supplies storage area. The operator was instructed to replace them.

headline: Uncovered bread and water boxes on milk crates
summary: Bread in the prep area was uncovered and needed protection from overhead contamination. Water boxes were stored on milk crates in the walk-in cooler and must be elevated on shelving. Debris near a grease trap was also noted.

headline: About 12 live and 30 dead roaches found
summary: About 12 live cockroaches were seen under the three-compartment sink, behind coolers, and near the rear exit. About 30 dead cockroaches were found in the dining area and kitchen. A citation was issued, and pest control service was needed.

headline: Missing cooler thermometers; mop sink backflow device
summary: Some coolers lacked thermometers. A mop sink backflow prevention device was not located where it could be seen. The manager must provide working thermometers for all coolers.

headline: No written vomit and diarrhea cleanup policy
summary: No written policy or procedure for cleaning up vomit and diarrhea was on the premises. The facility must keep one on site with the required supplies. This is a priority violation.

headline: Unlabeled ready-to-eat foods; about 50 lbs discarded
summary: Cooked shrimp, chicken, beans, and pork lacked date labels. About 50 lbs was discarded and denatured. A sink backed up, and the prior core violations were not corrected, including no food handler certificates and no allergen training.

headline: No employee health policy on site
summary: No employee health policy was on site during the inspection. The operator was told to keep verifiable policies for each employee on site at all times. No citation was issued at this visit.

headline: About 60 mouse droppings; handwashing lapses
summary: About 60 or more mouse droppings were found on floors, under equipment, and in dry storage. Food handlers did not wash hands before changing tasks or after putting on gloves. Cold foods were held at 47F and discarded. A citation was issued.

headline: Handsink blocked; wiping cloths left on prep tables
summary: An exposed handwashing sink in the front prep area was blocked by a serving basket and must stay accessible. Wiping cloths were stored on prep tables. Grocery bags were used as food storage. Some food items lacked labels, and an allergen certificate had expired.

headline: About 40 small flies in dish and bathroom areas
summary: About 40 small flies were found throughout the dish room, near the mop sink, and in the employee bathroom. The operator was told to consult pest control. This is a priority violation with a citation.

headline: Deli ceiling hole; leaking sinks and dirty floors
summary: A hole above the deli cooler leads into the ceiling and must be sealed to prevent pests. Leaks at the produce area three-compartment sink and butcher room faucet need repair. Floors and hood vents had grease and dirt, and a basement restroom door was not self-closing.

headline: No manager on duty; flies, rat droppings, and more
summary: No certified manager was on duty while TCS foods were prepared, and a bare-handed food handler touched pancakes. Hot food was held at 101-125F. About 150 or more live small flies and 20 large flies were found, along with rat droppings. A citation was issued.

headline: No certified manager for 18 minutes during chicken prep
summary: No certified manager was on site from 10:35 to 10:53 AM while chicken and other TCS foods were prepared. Food was stored on the walk-in floor, and soiled wiping cloths were left on prep tables. A prep area light was out.

headline: No certified manager; cold food and cooler too warm
summary: No city-certified manager was on site. Cold food was held at 68-71F, and a cooler was 71F and tagged. Side doors lacked screening, no food handler training was shown, and food handlers had no hair restraints.

headline: Disposal-area rear door not rodent-proof
summary: The rear outer door leading to the disposal area was not rodent-proof. The inspector instructed the operator to make the door rodent-proof.

headline: Tongs and warmers dirty; flooring debris
summary: Tongs hung off cooking equipment instead of being stored in a clean container. Warming equipment had crumbs and dirt, and floor drains and corners had dirt and food debris. Vent above cooking equipment was dirty.

headline: Dirty cutting boards and walk-in cooler fan covers
summary: Cutting boards in meat and produce areas had deep grooves and stains. A splash guard, vent cover, and walk-in fan covers with thick dirt were noted. There was no lighting in the basement walk-in freezer.

headline: Sanitizing solution needed for wet linens
summary: Sanitizing solution for wet linens must be provided at prep tables. This was a re-inspection with no other issues listed.

headline: No certified manager certificate; handsinks lack soap
summary: No original city-certified food manager certificate was on site. Four handsinks lacked soap, and one employee cafeteria sink had no hot water. A dish machine failed to sanitize consistently at 157F and was tagged. Two coolers were too warm at 47F.

headline: Slimy ice machine; 10 dead insects; sink not working
summary: Ice machine components were covered in black and gray slime that dripped onto ice used for people. About 10 dead insects were found in basement storage. A three-compartment sink was not fully functional. Leaking pipes and spills also need repair.

headline: No city-certified manager; handling deli meats
summary: No certified manager was on site while deli meats and soup were handled, which is a priority violation. No verifiable employee health policy was on site, and a male food handler with a beard lacked a restraint. Walls and light shields need repair.

headline: Leaking faucet; restroom lacks covered receptacles
summary: A leaking faucet at the wash compartment of the three-compartment sink in the Ember dishwashing area needed repair. Women's washroom stalls #1 and #2 had no covered receptacles for sanitary products.

headline: No handwash signs; unlabeled bulk containers
summary: Handwash signage was missing at all prep and kitchen handsinks. A basement ice bin was not clean. Dry ingredients in unlabeled bulk containers and cutting boards with deep cuts and stains were noted. An outside receptacle lid is broken.

headline: Slow-draining restroom sink; no covered trash can
summary: The restroom handwashing sink drains slowly and must drain quickly. The restroom also lacked a covered trash receptacle, which must be provided.

headline: Three-compartment sink still leaking after reinspection
summary: Water was still leaking from the middle to the left compartment of the three-compartment sink when turned on. The manager must repair it. This is a priority violation.

headline: Cold food held too warm; about 60 lbs discarded
summary: Many cold TCS foods were held between 47.5-61F, including shredded cheese, ham, turkey, eggs, and pork. About 60 lbs valued at $240 was discarded. A cold holding unit at 54.9F was tagged. The high-temperature dish machine wash temperature was 140F and was later corrected.

headline: Spills and debris under equipment; boxes on floor
summary: Spills were found inside the lemonade cooler and must be cleaned. Food debris and trash were found under the cooler, heavy equipment, and in basement storage. Boxes and bins on basement floors must be raised six inches.

headline: Food stored too warm; prep cooler not holding temp
summary: Cold TCS food stored in the taqueria prep cooler was at 57.2-57.8F and was discarded. The prep cooler at 52.7F was tagged and cannot be used until reinspected. Open coffee and employee eating near food were also noted.

headline: Sticky fly trap over prep table; hood fly trap
summary: A sticky fly trap hung directly over a food prep table and must be moved. A cold holding unit display thermometer was inaccurate. The high-temperature dish machine lacked a data plate. Interior surfaces and floors need cleaning.

headline: Stored items must be raised off floor
summary: Re-inspection found stored items in the front prep area and basement sitting on the floor. These items must be raised off the floor and kept that way.

headline: Basement door gap; missing covers and ceiling tiles
summary: Basement exit door had a 1/4-inch gap at the bottom and rust, and needs a tight seal. A covered waste receptacle is required in coed washrooms. Holes in walls and ceilings, missing floor drain covers, and missing dish room ceiling tiles need repair.

headline: Sinks blocked by utensils; utensils stored improperly
summary: Handsinks in prep and dish areas were not accessible because utensils were stored in them, which is a priority violation. Ice scoopers were stored on ice, and food was stored uncovered or on the floor. Food lacked labels, and food handler and allergen training were missing.

headline: Cluttered basement floor; mops left in standing water
summary: Wiping cloths were stored on prep tables and must be kept in sanitizing solution. The gasket on a reach-in cooler was torn, and ice machine interiors were soiled. Floors in several areas were heavily soiled, and mops were left standing in water.

headline: No employee health policy; door gaps; clutter
summary: No employee health policy or training was found on site. Exterior main door gaps (1/4 inch) could let in pests and need repair. Unused items in the basement must be removed and raised, and water under the basement stairs needs to be cleared.

headline: Ice bin dirty; cutting boards stained; vent dusty
summary: The ice bin interior needed cleaning and sanitizing. Cutting boards had open seams and dark stains and must be refinished or replaced. The ceiling vent above cooking equipment was dirty and dusty.

headline: Crates used for storage; grease and debris buildup
summary: Crates were used for food storage in the walk-in freezer and must be replaced with proper shelving. Fryer interiors, floors under the dish machine, and walls behind cooking equipment need cleaning. Lighting above the hood is dim.

headline: Flies in dry storage; broken bar sink faucet
summary: Over 25 small black flying insects were found in dry storage and the dish area, which requires pest control. The bar handsink faucet was broken. Wiping cloths, a dirty ice machine, cooling flan, and a dish sink too small for large pots were also noted.

headline: Metered faucet shuts off; milk crates used for storage
summary: A metered faucet at the handwash sink in the front prep area could not maintain water flow for 15 seconds. Milk crates were used above the three-compartment sink. Debris under refrigerators storing chicken and a sprayer leak were also found.

headline: No hot water at unisex washroom handsink
summary: The second-floor unisex washroom handsink had no hot water, at 52.3F. It must be repaired to 100F, which is a priority violation. Employees prepared food without hair restraints, and the front prep handsink had no signage.

headline: Wet wiping cloths left on prep surfaces
summary: Wet wiping cloths were left on several prep surfaces. Operators were told to store them in sanitizing solution between uses to prevent contamination of equipment and food. This was a re-inspection.

headline: Front door gap; dumpster area littered with food
summary: A 1/4-inch gap under the front entrance door sweep must be sealed. Food and litter were scattered around the outside dumpster and need cleaning by reinspection.

headline: Employee fridge lacks thermometer; dirty microwave
summary: The employee break room refrigerator had no thermometer. The break room microwave needed cleaning, and a prep area microwave had a loose handle. These are minor items and were not corrected on site.

headline: Cracked floor and ceiling tiles; dirty drains
summary: Cracked or broken floor tiles and missing or damaged ceiling tiles were found in the rear area. Floors and floor drains were dirty and needed detail cleaning. Light shields also needed cleaning.

headline: No certified manager on site; hot water too cool
summary: No certified food manager was present, and no valid city sanitation certificate was on site. Hot water at the rear handwashing sinks was too cool; a technician fixed it on site (102-105F). Ice machine door residue and a dirty drive-thru cooler were also noted.

headline: Dust and food debris in dining area and expo line
summary: Dust was on the bottom shelf at the expo line where takeout containers are stored. Dust and food debris were also found behind dining booth cushions. Items must be cleaned and sanitized.

headline: Manager lacked allergen training certificate
summary: A food service sanitation manager did not have an allergen training certificate. The operator was instructed to meet the requirement.

headline: Bare-hand contact with ready-to-eat food; corrected
summary: The manager touched ready-to-eat torta bread with bare hands. He washed his hands and provided gloves during the inspection. A citation was issued. Other issues include unlabeled containers, undated cold foods, and ice machine residue.

headline: No certified manager on duty while food was prepared
summary: No certified manager certificate was posted, and no certified manager was on duty while pizza and chicken were prepared. The manager arrived at 10:48 AM with the certificate. A cook was chewing gum, and crates and damaged floor tile needed attention.

headline: Dish machine at 0 ppm; 40+ live flies
summary: Low-temperature dish machine sanitized at 0.0 ppm and was tagged for hold until repaired. More than 40 live small flies were on walls and ceilings in prep and dish areas. A pest control operator was recommended.

headline: Low floor tiles and food buildup in prep areas
summary: Low floor tiles at the dish area need repair and regrouting. Food debris and dirt buildup on floors and walls in the prep and dish areas must be cleaned.

headline: Cold food held too warm; 8 lbs discarded
summary: Chicken at 64.2F and beef at 50.4F were held in the prep cooler, and about 8 lbs ($90) was discarded. This is a priority violation. Greasy cooking equipment and floors with food debris also need cleaning.

headline: Missing signage, no thermometer, and drainage issues
summary: Handwashing signage was missing, and no food temperature thermometer was available, which is a priority violation. A worker wore no hair restraint, and wiping cloths were stored on prep tables. Sinks did not drain properly.

headline: Food debris and grease on walls and vent hood
summary: Food debris was on the prep area west wall, and grease buildup was on the walls, ceiling, and ventilation hood and filters. These must be cleaned and maintained.

headline: No certified manager on site; corrected on site
summary: No person in charge held a valid city food sanitation certificate. A certified manager arrived at 11:00 AM. Boxes were stored on the floor, and cleaning under sinks was needed. No proof of food handler training was provided.

headline: Rusted shelving; dirty sushi prep area
summary: Rusted prep table shelving in the main prep area and basement needed repair or replacement. Sushi prep coolers, floors, and the hood vents had grease and dust. Liquor was stored directly on the storage room floor, and a floor tile was missing in front of the grease trap.

headline: No certified manager on site; prior violations uncorrected
summary: No certified food manager with a posted certificate was on site, a priority violation. Food handler and allergen training were missing, and prior core violations remained, including greasy cooking equipment, cluttered basement storage, and dim hood lights.

headline: Missing drain stoppers; backflow device not accessible
summary: Warewashing sinks lacked working drain stoppers, and a bar sink faucet was loose. A mop sink backflow device was not located where it could be serviced. No approved allergen training certificate was available.

headline: Overflowing garbage; open containers on ground
summary: Outside garbage containers were open and overflowing, with garbage on the ground. The operator was told to contact the garbage company for pickups and add regular pickups. This is a priority violation with a citation.

headline: Dish machine wash temperature too low
summary: Rear high-temperature dish machine wash solution was 109F, below the 150F minimum, and was flagged as a priority violation. Containers lacked food name labels, large bowls were stored upright, and the washrooms lack self-closing doors. No allergen training was provided for a certified manager.

headline: Manager without city sanitation certificate on site
summary: A manager on site did not hold the required city food service manager certificate. Floor drains, the basement walk-in floor, and equipment near a handsink were dusty or dirty. Floors throughout the facility need detail cleaning.

headline: Hand washing lapses; flies; uncorrected core violations
summary: Male food handlers did not wash hands when handling phones, taking payments, or putting on gloves. About 10 large flies were found in prep areas. A middle handsink leaked, and prior core violations were not corrected.

headline: Leaking drain under sink; food spills on equipment
summary: A leaking drain pipe and valves under the three-compartment sink needed repair. Food spills and debris were on beverage machines, coolers, and counters. A rear dish area handsink lacked signage and a nearby waste receptacle.

headline: Black dirt inside ice machine; ice discarded
summary: Black dirt buildup inside the ice machine was dripping into ice used for drinks. The ice was voluntarily discarded. The manager must clean the interior by the reinspection date. A food manager also lacked allergen training.

headline: No hand soap at handsink; greasy equipment
summary: No hand cleanser was available at a handsink during inspection, a priority violation with a citation. The person in charge provided it on site. Food debris on floors, greasy equipment, and sink interiors with buildup were also noted.

headline: Dirty cooking equipment; dish area handsink leaking
summary: Cooking equipment was dirty and must be cleaned and sanitized. A faucet and handsink in the dish area leaked. Floors needed cleaning, and vents had peeling paint. Damaged ceiling tiles were found in the rear prep area.

headline: No vomit and diarrhea cleanup plan; no self-closing door
summary: No written procedure or plan for responding to vomiting and diarrhea events was on site. Supplies needed include gloves, face masks, disposable mops, and norovirus-effective sanitizer. The washroom door did not self-close.

headline: Missing handwashing sign and waterstained ceilings
summary: Handwashing sign was missing at the bar sink. A sticky fly trap hung over the basement prep area. Other issues included rust on walk-in cooler racks, waterstained restroom ceiling tiles, and a missing light shield.

headline: Repeat violations: paper towels, milk crates, debris
summary: Prior violations were not corrected, including paper towel placement, milk crates used for storage, and debris under the three-compartment sink and in walk-in coolers. Raised shelves were provided. A citation was issued.

headline: Fly strips on ceiling; food stored on floor
summary: Fly strips hung from ceilings in rear prep and dish areas and were to be removed. Food items stored on the floor in prep and storage areas had to be raised six inches. Grease buildup inside the hood vent needed cleaning.

headline: Summary report not posted; minor leak under sink
summary: The inspection summary report from the last visit was not posted for the public, which is a priority violation. A minor water leak under the main prep handsink must be repaired.

headline: No handsink in prep area; food held out of temperature
summary: There is no exposed handwashing sink in the sixth-floor prep area. Chicken and other time-controlled foods were held out of temperature without logs. The certified manager's allergen certificate had expired. Citation issued.

headline: Manager lacked original certificate on site
summary: The manager on site did not have the original City of Chicago food manager certificate. The manager must keep the original certificate on site at all times. Citation issued.

headline: About 20 mouse droppings in basement prep
summary: About 20 mouse droppings were in the basement food prep area. Pest activity must be eliminated and pest control contacted. Gaps at the rear and front doors must be sealed. The basement handsink trap needs repair.

headline: Truck lacked cleanup kit, test strips, and water
summary: The food truck had no vomit and diarrhea cleanup kit and no sanitizer test strips; the strips were corrected on site. It had no hot or cold running water because it was not filled at the commissary. Floors, walls, and vents need cleaning.

headline: Exposed brick wall behind milkshake station
summary: The wall behind the milkshake preparation area is exposed brick. It must be made smooth and easy to clean.

headline: Dishwasher sanitizer at 0 ppm; tagged out
summary: The chlorine dishwasher dispensed 0 ppm sanitizer and is tagged; it must not be used until repaired. Clean utensils were stored above the dirty sink. Missing ceiling tile and light shield were noted. No allergen certificates were provided.

headline: No valid manager on site; flies in dishwashing area
summary: No person in charge with a valid certificate was on site; a certified manager arrived at 2:40 PM and this was corrected on site. About 10 small flies were in dishwashing. Food handlers lacked proof of training and hair restraints.

headline: Broken cold-water handle at three-compartment sink
summary: The cold-water handle at the three-compartment sink is broken and must be turned with a tool. Debris is in the prep-area freezer, and calcium buildup is inside the ice machine. Both need cleaning.

headline: Greasy hood filter above cooking equipment
summary: The filter above the cooking equipment must be cleaned to remove grease and debris.

headline: Employee on duty lacked food handler training
summary: An employee on duty had no food handler training. All employees must complete training and keep records on site at all times.

headline: Dish machine at 0 ppm; tagged out
summary: The chlorine dish machine dispensed 0 ppm sanitizer and is tagged; it must not be used until repaired. A milk refrigerator thermometer is inaccurate. A flour bulk container is unlabeled, and the rear handsink is dirty.

headline: Heavy debris on floor around equipment
summary: Heavy debris was on the floor around various pieces of equipment. The manager was told to clean and maintain the area.

headline: No certified manager while smoothies and sandwiches made
summary: The only employee on site lacked a certified food manager certificate. Smoothies and sandwiches were made without a certified manager present. Raw wood at the prep entrance, dirty floors, and a missing allergen certificate were also noted. Citation issued.

headline: No certified manager certificate posted during food prep
summary: No valid certified food manager certificate was posted while chicken, pasta, and soup were prepared. No hand-drying supplies were at prep sinks; paper towels were provided during inspection. Food was stored on the freezer floor. Citation issued.

headline: No handwashing signs; gap under rear door
summary: Handwashing signs are missing at both prep handsinks and the washroom. A 1/4-inch gap at the bottom of the rear exit door must be sealed tight to keep pests out.

headline: Food and dust buildup on prep walls
summary: Food and dust buildup was found on prep area walls. Management must clean the walls and keep them maintained.

headline: No vomiting and diarrhea cleanup kit on site
summary: No kit was on site for cleaning up vomit or diarrhea. Staff must provide one that works against norovirus. Also noted: missing handwashing signs, residue in the ice machine, rusty shelves, and debris around the dumpster.

headline: No valid certificate posted; handsink leaks
summary: No valid City of Chicago food service sanitation certificate was posted for food employees. The dishwashing handsink leaks during use and is inaccessible. A cooler in the rear prep has a torn gasket. No allergen training was on site.

headline: No vomit kit; sinks blocked and lacking supplies
summary: No vomit and diarrhea kit or procedure was on site. A rear handsink was blocked by items, and some sinks lacked soap and paper towels. No pest control contract or logbook was available. Food was stored on the walk-in floor.

headline: Food handlers without certified manager; salmon at 47°F
summary: Food was prepared without an original certificate or certified manager on site. Salmon at 47°F in a display cooler was voluntarily discarded, 2 lbs. Unlabeled food containers and grease, flour, and dead insects on equipment need cleaning.

headline: About 30 live ants in rear prep area
summary: About 30 live ants were crawling along the wall in the rear prep area. The person in charge must remove the insects, inform pest control, and clean the area. Gaps around the windowsill and missing outlet covers must be sealed.

headline: Cracked floor grout; dusty walls on second floor
summary: Floor tiles along the second-floor cook line and dishwashing area need regrouting. Walls in the dishwashing area are dusty and must be cleaned. One food manager lacks a food allergen training certificate.

headline: Grease and debris on equipment; cardboard on floor
summary: Grease and food debris cover cooking equipment, prep tables, coolers, and shelves. Dirt is under the three-compartment sink and cooking equipment. Cardboard on the prep-line floor must be removed, and one burnt-out light needs replacing.

headline: Sink leak in meat processing room; clutter
summary: A bottom-pipe leak at a sink in the meat processing room must be repaired. Clutter near the cardboard baler and chemical rack must be cleared. Items must be stored at least six inches off the floor.

headline: Ice machine residue; cutting board stains; cold water knob
summary: Orange residue is on the inside panel of the first-kitchen ice machine and must be detail cleaned or serviced. A cutting board with open seams and stains must be replaced. A cold-water knob at the cook-line handsink is broken.

headline: About 30 rodent droppings in furnace closet
summary: About 30 rodent droppings were inside a furnace closet in the rear food prep area. Pest activity must be eliminated, and pest control is recommended. A 1/2-inch gap at the rear steel door must be sealed. Pest traps set by staff must be removed.

headline: No certified manager while rice and soup prepared
summary: No City of Chicago certified food manager with an original certificate was on site while rice, soup, shrimp, and egg rolls were prepared and served. Earlier violations were not fixed, including unlabeled food and a worker without a food handler certificate.

headline: Scoops stored in food; wet cloths on cutting boards
summary: An ice scoop was on the meat slicer. Rice scoops were stored with handles inside food. Wet wiping cloths were left on cutting boards in the front prep area and must stay in sanitizer when not in use.

headline: Food on floors; unlabeled containers; holes in ceiling
summary: Food and paper products must be raised six inches off the floor. Storage containers must be labeled. Worn cooler gasket and cutting board need repair, and holes in the rear prep ceiling must be sealed. The food manager lacks allergen training.

headline: Openings at revolving door; leaking faucets
summary: Openings at the base of the revolving entrance door must be sealed to prevent pests. Both faucets at the three-compartment sink leak and must be repaired.

headline: Washrooms lack trash lids, self-closing doors, ventilation
summary: Washrooms have no covered trash receptacles, and a toilet room door lacks a self-closing device. The women's washroom has no ventilation system. Each item must be installed.

headline: No certified manager certificate on site during food prep
summary: No valid original City of Chicago food sanitation certificate was on site while rice and fish were prepared and served. The person in charge was told to keep it on site at all times. Citation issued.

headline: Live flies and rodent droppings found on site
summary: About 35 live flies were on cooling units, equipment, grocery products, and in a toilet room. About 20 small rodent droppings were under snack racks. Pest control must be called and activity eliminated. No waste removal contract was on site.

headline: About 40 live flying insects in prep areas
summary: About 40 live small flying insects were on walls and ceilings in the food prep and dishwashing areas. Additional pest control service is needed. A certified manager lacks an allergen certificate, and food handlers lack certificates. Citation issued.

headline: No certified manager while deli meat handled
summary: No City of Chicago certified manager was on site while deli meat and beef were handled. The person in charge lacked a certificate. The manager lacks proof of allergen training. Caulking near the three-compartment sink needs cleaning.

headline: No certified manager on duty; sinks lack soap
summary: No certified food manager was on duty while food was prepared; the manager arrived at 2:45 PM. Prep sinks lacked soap and hand towels, and a rear sink pipe leaks. No food handler or allergen training was provided. Citation issued.

headline: Dishwasher had no sanitizer and was tagged
summary: The low-temperature dishwasher had 0 ppm chlorine sanitizer and was tagged; it must not be used until reinspected. Handwash signs were missing at the restroom and prep sinks. Food was stored on floors, and wiping cloths were left on prep surfaces.

headline: Missing light shield in walk-in cooler
summary: A light shield is missing on the light in the walk-in cooler. It must be provided and kept in place.

headline: Missing handwashing sign; food handling and cleaning issues
summary: A handwashing sign is missing at the rear dishwashing sink. A plate was left in refried beans during transfer, and cooled chicken was on a walk-in cooler floor. Ice on a cooler condenser, grease under the grill, and cardboard under mats also need fixing.

headline: No certified manager while sandwiches made
summary: No City of Chicago certified food service manager was on premises while ham and turkey sandwiches were prepared and served. This was corrected on site when the manager arrived at 2:25 PM. Citation issued.

headline: Dirty ice bin; greasy kitchen surfaces
summary: The ice bin interior needs cleaning. Grease covers cooking equipment, walls, floors, and shelving in the kitchen and prep areas. A broken covered receptacle in the all-gender washroom must be replaced.

headline: Wiping cloths and cooler gaskets need correction
summary: Wiping cloths must be stored in sanitizer when not in use. Reach-in cooler gaskets are in poor repair. The smoothie blender base and microwave interior need cleaning. The toilet room needs a covered receptacle, and prep-area floors need detail cleaning.

headline: Food prepared without hair restraints
summary: Employees preparing food at the prep area had no hair restraints. They were told to wear them at all times. Ice buildup in the walk-in freezer must be repaired. Basement dry storage clutter must be removed to limit pest hiding places.

headline: No certified manager; about 30 live flies
summary: No certified manager was on duty while time-controlled foods were prepared; the manager arrived at 4:03 PM. About 30 or more live small flies were in prep, washroom, and storage areas. An unauthorized man entered the food prep area from the alley.

headline: Staff ate and drank in prep area; cleaning needed
summary: Employees were seen drinking and preparing food in the prep area; a separate break area was required. Ice machine interior, unlabeled refrigerated food, and grease on the hood and floors also needed correction. Re-inspection passed.

headline: Certified manager lacks allergen training
summary: No allergen training certificate was on site for the certified food manager. The manager was told to obtain allergen training and keep the certificate on site.

headline: Greasy fryer and hot-holding unit sides
summary: The fryer needs deep cleaning on all sides to remove grease buildup. The sides of the hot-holding unit in the rear area need cleaning to remove grease splatter.

headline: Mop sink backflow device not located
summary: The backflow prevention device for the basement mop sink was not located and must be installed where it can be serviced. Raw wood shelves in dry storage must be painted or sealed. One certified manager lacks an allergen training certificate.

headline: Leaking utility sink; dirty floors and drains
summary: The utility service sink faucet leaks and must be repaired. Floors behind the CO2 tank, ice machine, soda system, and under the dishwasher have dirt and debris. Floor drains under the dishwasher are dirty.

headline: Rear handsink lacks hot water
summary: The rear handsink had no hot water (52.3°F) and a damaged hot-water handle. At least 100°F is required. A drainpipe under the front handsink leaks. Food spills are on equipment, and food handlers have no training. Citation issued.

headline: Broken grocery cooler thermometers
summary: Broken or missing thermometers in grocery display coolers must be provided to monitor food temperatures. Shelves were dusty, and fans in the walk-in cooler are caked with dust and dirt.

headline: No handwashing sink in rear prep; openings to seal
summary: There is no handwashing sink in the rear prep and dishwashing area. Gaps at the dumpster-area doors and front entrance must be sealed to keep pests out. Other repairs include a cooler gasket and a missing thermometer.

headline: Basement cooler interior rusty and soiled
summary: The interior of the basement two-door upright cooler is rusty and soiled with food debris. Staff were told to clean these non-food-contact surfaces often enough to prevent buildup.

headline: Debris on bulk containers; grease and allergen certificate
summary: A small opening behind the bulk dry ingredients must be sealed. Bulk container lids had debris, and one was cracked. Grease under the grill and debris on electrical boxes and dishwasher need cleaning. The certified manager lacks an allergen certificate.

headline: No verifiable employee health policy on site
summary: No verifiable employee health policy was on site. Handsoap and paper towels were missing at some sinks, and handwashing signs were absent. No food thermometer was on site, and no food handler certificates were available. Citation issued.

headline: Dusty washroom vent; greasy hood
summary: Dust covers the ceiling vent in the employee washroom and must be cleaned. The kitchen exhaust hood and filters have heavy grease buildup and must be detail cleaned.

headline: Sink faucet too short for all compartments
summary: The faucet neck at the three-compartment sink does not reach all compartments. The owner was told to install a longer neck. The owner has another faucet on site.

headline: Bare-hand food contact; about 150 lbs discarded
