summary: Two food handlers touched ready-to-eat food bare-handed. Cold foods held at 46.5°F to 77.0°F were discarded, about 150 lbs. A refrigerator at 55.0°F was tagged. Kimchi made without an approved plan was discarded, about 15 lbs.

headline: Improper hand washing; cold food too warm; dead roaches
summary: Food handlers rinsed hands without soap and dried them on wiping cloths. A rear prep sink had no running water. About 85 lbs of cold food above 41°F was discarded. Dead roaches were under cold units. A prep cooler at 55.0°F was tagged.

headline: Torn cooler gasket; dirty fryers and freezer
summary: A prep cooler has a torn door gasket that must be replaced. Interiors of the deep fryers and one-door freezer need cleaning. Floors behind the bar and in the walk-in, and greasy prep-area walls, also need cleaning.

headline: Two coolers too warm; cold food discarded
summary: Two coolers ran too warm. Cold foods in them, including pepperoni at 50.3°F and cooked chicken at 49.1°F, were discarded. Both coolers were tagged and cannot be used until repaired. A cook lacked a hair restraint.

headline: Ice machine lid left open; cloth on prep table
summary: The lid of the ice machine behind the first-floor bar was left ajar. A wiping cloth was on the rear prep table. An ice scoop was stored on top of the bar. Oven and fryer interiors had grease and food buildup and must be cleaned.

headline: Missing license number; coffee machine issues
summary: The business license number is not printed on the lateral sides of the MFP. No written cleaning procedure exists for the coffee machines. The backflow device on the coffee machines could not be located.

headline: Rat droppings found again after prior violation
summary: Re-inspection found over 40 rat droppings in dry storage, over 25 in kitchen prep, and over 20 at the bar. The earlier rodent violation was not fixed. Chewed foam at pest openings must be sealed. Citation issued.

headline: Toilet room sink leaks; minor floor debris
summary: The handwashing sink in the toilet room leaks and must be repaired. Minor debris on sales and food prep floors must be cleaned and sanitized.

headline: Missing covered receptacle; floor grout gaps
summary: The lobby all-gender accessible washroom has no covered receptacle. Missing grout between floor tiles near the ice machine, dishwashing area, and three-compartment sink must be replaced.

headline: Expired food handler certificate on duty
summary: The food handler on duty has an expired training certificate and must obtain a valid one. Refrigeration unit interiors, the fryer bottom, and cooking equipment exteriors need cleaning.

headline: About 15 live flies; no employee health policies
summary: About 15 or more live small flies were on walls and ceilings in the beverage and dishwashing areas. A pest control service was recommended. No signed health policies, no beverage-area handsink, and hot water at only 93°F were also noted.

headline: Noodles cooled covered; dirty can opener
summary: Noodles were cooling in the walk-in cooler with covers on, but food must be uncovered during cooling. Dry food debris was on the can opener in the rear prep area. Staff were told to clean it.

headline: Blocked handsinks and flies in prep area
summary: Handsinks in front and rear prep were blocked by sponges and buckets. About 10 to 15 large live flies were in the prep area; the person in charge must work with pest control. Citation issued. Cold holding units and floors also need cleaning.

headline: Burnt-out hood light; no allergen training proof
summary: A burnt-out light bulb at the ventilation hood must be replaced. A prior core violation was not corrected: certified food managers have no proof of allergen training. Citation issued.

headline: Onions held at 58.8°F; grease in fryer unit
summary: Hydrated onions in a service cooler were at 58.8°F; about 4 lbs were discarded. Heavy grease was inside the fryer's electrical unit, and food debris was in a cooler. Exhaust hood filters need cleaning. Repeat floor and washroom issues were noted.

headline: Dirty ice bin; deeply cut cutting boards
summary: The interior of the ice machine bin and cover is not clean. Cutting boards in several areas are stained and deeply cut. Grease sits under the fryer. There is no proof of allergen training for certified food managers.

headline: Rear handsink needs splashguards; food on floor
summary: The rear handsink needs splashguards on both sides to protect utensils and peppers. Food stored on the walk-in freezer floor must be raised six inches. Rust on storage racks must be removed, and floor corners need cleaning.

headline: Unshielded sewage pipes above food prep
summary: Sewage pipes above the food preparation area are not shielded. Management was told to shield them to prevent potential drips.

headline: No sanitation manager on duty; sink water 69°F
summary: No certified sanitation manager was on duty at the start while time-controlled foods were handled. The manager arrived around 9:35 AM. Handwashing sink water was 69°F; it must be at least 100°F. Food was stored on the freezer floor.

headline: Missing handwashing signs and allergen training
summary: Handwashing signs were missing at sinks used by employees. The washroom had no covered waste container. Certified managers have not completed allergen awareness training.

headline: No health policy, vomit procedure, or pest logbook
summary: No employee health policy was on site. No procedure or supplies existed for vomit and diarrhea events. The rear prep handwash basin was blocked. The food thermometer was non-functional, and no pest logbook or service proof was on site.

headline: No vomiting and diarrhea procedure posted
summary: No written procedure for vomiting and diarrhea was posted on site. Soiled mops were stored in a bucket and must be hung to dry. Unnecessary items on floors in the rear facility must be raised at least six inches.

headline: No employee health policy or vomit cleanup plan
summary: No written employee health policy was on the premises. No procedure or kit existed for vomiting and diarrhea events. Ice machine interior debris, a 1/4-inch gap under the kitchen exit door, and loose faucet handles were also noted.

headline: Soda gun holder needs detailed cleaning
summary: The soda gun holder behind the bar must be detail cleaned to prevent pest harborage.

headline: No certified manager; steak thawing at room temperature
summary: No certified food manager with a valid certificate was on site while Italian beef, ground beef, and chicken were prepared. Steak was thawing at room temperature. Food was stored on floors, and food handlers had no training. Citation issued.

headline: No certified manager; unsafe food temperatures; bare-hand contact
summary: No certified food manager on duty during food prep. Soups at 119.8°F and 125.4°F and eggs at 50.3°F were discarded. Cooks touched ready-to-eat food bare-handed. Two handwashing sinks were blocked. Dishwasher failed to sanitize.

headline: Open drink on slicer; meat thawing improperly
summary: An open beverage cup was on the slicer; closed-lid containers are required. Frozen meat was thawing improperly in rear storage. Food was stored on the floor, and a food handler lacked a hair restraint. Wiping cloths and unsealed raw wood also need fixing.

headline: Handsinks lack 100°F water; prior violations unfixed
summary: Several handsinks read 68°F to 73°F; 100°F is required. Prior violations were not corrected, including missing handwash signs, no thermometers, unlabeled bulk containers, uncovered washroom bins, and dirty floor drains. Citation issued.

headline: Black debris inside one-door cooler
summary: Black debris is inside the base, sides, and shelving of a one-door cooler across from cooking equipment. The cooler must be cleaned and kept clean.

headline: Dirty floors along walls and under equipment
summary: Floors along wall bases and under equipment need cleaning, especially in the rear dry storage area.

headline: Grease and dirt on floors and corners
summary: Grease, food debris, and dirt built up on floors under cooking equipment, along walls, and in corners of prep, dishwashing, and storage areas. The manager was told to clean all of these areas.

headline: Dirty walk-in floor and drain
summary: The walk-in cooler floor under the shelves and the floor drain under the three-compartment sink need cleaning.

headline: No certified manager on arrival; leaking sink
summary: No certified food manager was on site upon arrival; one must be on site at all times. A prior priority violation was not corrected: a leak at the bottom pipe of the three-compartment sink continues. Citation issued.

headline: Plastic lining on hood; slow handsink drain
summary: Plastic lining on the outside of the hood above cooking equipment must be removed. The prep-area handwashing sink drains slowly and needs repair.

headline: Manager certificate missing; sinks lack hot water
summary: The person in charge lacked a valid certificate. The prep and utility sinks lacked hot or cold water; hot water must reach 100°F. Several cooling units ran at improper temperatures. Large wall holes and cracked toilet-room floors can admit pests.

headline: No certified manager while foods prepared
summary: No certified food service manager or certificate was on site while vegetables, soups, sauces, and meats were prepared. One of three certified managers lacks allergen training. Leaking faucet base, dusty vents, dirty floor drains, and poor lighting were also noted.

headline: Dish machine at 0.0 ppm; no consumer advisory
summary: The low-temperature dish machine sanitized at 0.0 ppm and is tagged. Staff must use the three-compartment sink. The menu lacks a consumer advisory for raw or undercooked foods such as poached eggs. Scoops were stored inside food containers.

headline: Water dripping under sink; microwave splatters
summary: Water drips from a pipe below the three-compartment sink and must be repaired. Food splatters inside the microwave must be cleaned. Minor dust is on the ventilation hood.

headline: Raw chicken stored in garbage cans
summary: Raw chicken was stored in large garbage cans in the walk-in cooler. Food-grade containers are required instead. Dust was found on a vent and ceiling tiles in the prep area, which must be cleaned.

headline: Milk crates used as walk-in shelving
summary: An ice scoop was stored with its food-contact surface exposed; staff were shown proper storage. Milk crates in the walk-in must be replaced with shelving six inches off the floor. No food handler training proof was available.

headline: No splashguard between handsink and drainboard
summary: There is no washable splashguard between the front exposed handsink and the drainboard of the three-compartment sink. One must be installed.

headline: No certified manager; no employee health policy
summary: No certified food manager with a valid certificate was on duty while time-controlled foods were stored, prepared, and served. No employee health policy was on site. A worker lacked a hair restraint. Citation issued.

headline: About 80 rodent droppings across multiple areas
summary: About 80 or more large and small rodent droppings were found in prep, bar, stage, office, dining room, and basement areas. Rodent activity must be eliminated, and pest control is recommended. Three doors were open during inspection.

headline: Fail: no metal stem thermometer on site
summary: Failed. No metal stem thermometer on site to check temperatures of hot and cold TCS foods (foods that need temperature control). Inspector instructed to provide one at all times; citation issued.

headline: Pass: food stored on floor, peeling paint
summary: Passed re-inspection. Food and single-use items stored on floor in walk-in cooler and storage areas; manager told to raise them six inches. Peeling wall paint in prep and storage, damaged light shields in prep, and no allergen training for certified managers.

headline: Fail: live roaches near hot food stoves
summary: Failed re-inspection. About 5-8 live roaches scattered through hot food prep stoves; pest control service recommended; citation issued. Also food stored on floors, soiled wiping cloths, heavy grease and debris throughout, and a food manager lacking allergen training.

headline: Fail: no manager on site, cold foods unsafe
summary: Failed. No person in charge or certified manager on site. Deli meats at 50-56°F and other cold foods at 51-53°F were discarded; a cold unit at 53°F was tagged. Handwash sinks lacked soap and towels. No employee health policy or vomit cleanup procedure. No inspection summary posted.

headline: Pass: grease and dirt in multiple areas
summary: Passed. Heavy grease, food debris and dirt on floors under cooking equipment and along walls in prep, dish, storage and basement areas. Dust on walk-in fan, light shields, and vents. Staff restroom lacks covered receptacle for sanitary products.

headline: Pass: pork in plastic totes, food debris
summary: Passed. Pork stored in plastic storage totes in freezer; management told to use food-grade bags or containers. Food debris and spills throughout floors and surfaces require detail cleaning. Raw wood shelves near front counter must be sealed or painted.

headline: Fail: no commissary agreement, no dish detergent
summary: Failed. No signed commissary agreement with the hatchery, and no dish detergent on the truck. Also no thermometer in prep cooler, no drying rack, incorrect sanitizer test strips, no garbage receptacle in truck, and duct tape and peeling paint in prep area.

headline: Pass with conditions: hot food held too cool
summary: Passed with conditions. Ready-to-eat hot foods below 135°F: macaroni and cheese at 131.7°F, red beans and rice at 126.5°F, chicken at 95.5-104.9°F. About 35 lb (about $120) discarded; citation issued. No food handler training for employees; rear door has a gap.

headline: Pass with conditions: missing health policy, handler certificates
summary: Passed with conditions. No employee health policy or training on site, and food handlers lack training certificates. Also food stored on floor in display area, unlabeled containers, rusted racks in walk-in cooler, backflow preventer not accessible, and clutter in basement storage.

headline: Pass: unsecured cold units in dining area
summary: Passed re-inspection. Cold-hold units holding prep food in customer dining area were not secured; they must stay secured while open. Also a leaking three-compartment sink faucet stem and grease buildup on hood filters.

headline: Pass with conditions: no certified manager on site
summary: Passed with conditions. No certified food manager with a valid certificate on site while eggs and sausage were handled; citation issued. Also pink substance inside ice machine, cracked ice bin lid, leaking chemical piping under sink, and missing handwash signs and trash-can cover.

headline: Fail: live roaches and rat droppings found
summary: Failed. 12 live roaches in prep areas, freezer, and cracks behind the cooktop; 30 rat droppings in basement and rear prep; dead rat found; pest control needed. Moldy cheese discarded (about 30 lb, $500). Bleach stored above food removed. Citations issued.

headline: Pass: torn cooler gasket, dim walk-in light
summary: Passed re-inspection. Prep-line cooler across from the pizza oven has a torn door gasket to replace. Walk-in cooler lighting is dim and must be kept adequate at all times.

headline: Pass with conditions: no certified manager on site
summary: Passed with conditions. No City of Chicago food service sanitation manager on site, and no original certificate posted, while milk and sandwiches (TCS foods) were prepared and served. A certified manager must be on site whenever open. Citation issued.

headline: Fail: cold beef, no cleanup kit, overflowing dumpsters
summary: Failed. Three pounds of beef held at 48.2°F in front prep cold unit, discarded. No vomit and diarrhea cleanup kit on site. Outdoor dumpsters overflowing with trash and debris; trash must be stored inside receptacles. Food on walk-in floor; food manager lacks allergen training.

headline: Pass: no food handler training proof
summary: Passed. No proof of food handler training for any food handler, and an employee with a food manager certificate lacks allergen training. Also taped gaskets on two coolers, rust on a prep table shelf, floor buildup, dusty vent, and a non-working light.

headline: Pass: milk crates, peeling paint, clutter
summary: Passed re-inspection. Ice machine on milk crates on floor must be raised at least 6 inches. Handwash sink lacks signage; melted cutting board near stove; peeling walk-in ceiling paint; dusty floors under equipment; cluttered outdoor waste enclosure; poor light fixture in rear storage.

headline: Pass: heavy grease and debris throughout kitchen
summary: Passed. Heavy grease, food debris and dirt on prep tables, inside reach-in coolers, under cooking equipment, and on floors and walls. Hood and filters heavily greased. Duct tape covers a restroom knob. Container labels are worn.

headline: Pass with conditions: dish machine not sanitizing
summary: Passed with conditions. Low-temperature dish machine sanitized at 10 ppm (parts per million), below the required 50-100 ppm; unit tagged and held for inspection. Also no handwashing signs, missing splash barrier at drain board, dirty floor drains, inoperable restroom ventilation, and missing hood filters.

headline: Pass: rear door gap, freezer condenser ice
summary: Passed re-inspection. Opening at base of rear exit door leading to alley must be sealed to prevent pest entry. Ice buildup on front, bottom and back of the walk-in freezer condenser must be removed.

headline: Pass: no food handler certificates, no mop sink
summary: Passed. No food handler training certificates for employees and no mop sink on premises. Food manager lacks allergen training. Also grooved cutting boards, food debris inside coolers, a leaking prep handsink faucet, missing sink stoppers, and dirty prep-area walls.

headline: Pass: cardboard shelf liners, peeling paint, door
summary: Passed. Cardboard used as shelf liner in rear storage must be removed. Peeling paint on shelving in a two-door cold hold unit must be repaired or replaced. Women's restroom door is not self-closing; a closing device must be installed.

headline: Pass: missing handwash signs, leaking drainpipe
summary: Passed. Handwash signs are missing at a prep-area sink and a rear washroom sink. Drainpipe under the rear prep handwash sink is leaking. Debris on the ground around dumpsters must be cleaned.

headline: Pass with conditions: no certified manager on site
summary: Passed with conditions. No certified food manager with original certificate on site while open; citation issued. Pork and seaweed-knotted bins stored on floor, no ambient thermometers in cold units, handwash sign missing, and insect traps stored above clean dishware. Floors and ice machine need cleaning.

headline: Pass: greasy equipment, broken light shield
summary: Passed. Sides of cooking equipment have grease and food buildup; clean to prevent pests. Unused beverage equipment next to the pizza station should be removed. Protective light shield over the two-compartment sink in rear dish area is broken and must be repaired.

headline: Fail: uncorrected core violations, no allergen training
summary: Failed. Repeat core violations from an 8/5/22 inspection were not corrected, including a 1/2 to 1 inch gap under the front door and debris on floors. Food handlers lacked hair restraints, cardboard served as shelf liner, and no certified manager had allergen training.

headline: Pass with conditions: dish machine and cold food
summary: Passed with conditions. Dish machine chlorine sanitizer measured 0 ppm (parts per million); a technician serviced it to 100 ppm during inspection. Ground beef at 48.5°F and sausage/bacon at 47.1°F in cold-hold unit; 6 lb discarded. Food stored on walk-in floors; grease and dirt beneath equipment.

headline: Pass: wall cracks and missing coving
summary: Passed re-inspection. Cracks and crevices in food prep area walls must be sealed. No coving between floor and wall under the three-compartment sink and dish machine; the joint must be made tight-fitting.

headline: Pass: uncovered food and unlabeled containers
summary: Passed. Food in prep cooler left uncovered, and food stored in plastic grocery bags in the basement freezer; both must be fixed. Also unlabeled storage containers, an ice bin needing cleaning, scoops stored inside containers, and missing light shields.

headline: Pass with conditions: no certificate posted
summary: Passed with conditions. No valid City of Chicago food service sanitation certificate posted; citation issued, with more citations to follow if not kept. Second-floor ice machine interior needs cleaning, first-floor prep sink pipe leaks, and gaps at second-floor wall base must be sealed.

headline: Fail: black substance dripping into ice
summary: Failed. Ice machine in the dish room had black substance touching and dripping onto ice used for people to consume. The person in charge (PIC) turned the machine off and contacted a service provider. Citation issued.

headline: Pass: expired allergen training, restroom issues
summary: Passed. Expired allergen training for a city certified food manager. Handwash signs missing in restrooms and kitchen prep. Restroom ventilation not working, handsink hot water pressure low, and a dish area handsink drains slowly. Light residue in ice machine and soil on can opener.

headline: Pass: certified manager lacks allergen training
summary: Passed. Certified food manager had no food allergen training. Pots were too large for the three-compartment sink; manager instructed to provide a clean-in-place procedure.

headline: Pass with conditions: no certified manager on site
summary: Passed with conditions. No person in charge with a valid certificate, and no certified food manager on site while TCS foods were prepared and served; citation issued. Food stored by and under handwash sink, manager told to remove it. Soiled mop heads and floor debris.

headline: Pass: no food handler or allergen training
summary: Passed. No valid food handler training for employees, and certified managers lack valid allergen training. Rear screen door needs 16-mesh screen; leaking drainpipe and faucet; soiled mop head on floor; debris throughout; washroom lacks covered receptacle and ventilation fan.

headline: Fail: no cleanup kit, no pest logbook
summary: Failed license inspection. No vomit and diarrhea cleanup kit or procedure on site. No paper towels at hand sinks. No pest control logbook; a licensed exterminator must service the site at least twice a year. Bar handsink lacks hot and cold running water.

headline: Pass: no food handler training, pest-entry gap
summary: Passed re-inspection. Employees lack valid food handler training. A quarter-inch gap under the rear door could let pests in. Food stored on floor, bulk containers unlabeled, soiled mop heads on floor, and certified managers lack allergen training.

headline: Fail: no certified food manager on site
summary: Failed. No certified food manager (CFM) with a valid Chicago certificate while TCS foods (foods that need temperature control, such as chicken and beef) were served. The person in charge (PIC) also lacked one. Fryers greasy, sink faucets leak, no handwashing sign, CFM lacks allergen training. Citation issued.

headline: Pass: food on floor, milk crate shelving
summary: Passed. Food containers stored on walk-in cooler floor must be raised at least six inches on shelving. Milk crates used as shelving in prep and walk-in areas must be replaced. Employee washroom needs a covered receptacle for sanitary napkins.

headline: Fail: dead roaches, dish machine tagged
summary: Failed. Dead roaches throughout facility. Low-temperature dish machine had 0 ppm (parts per million) sanitizer; unit tagged and must not be used until re-inspected. Black mold-like substance on ice machine panel touched ice. Also greasy surfaces, leaking ceiling above sink, and holes in walls.

headline: Pass: missing sink stoppers, cardboard shelving
summary: Passed re-inspection. Two stoppers missing from the three-compartment sink; they must be provided and maintained. Cardboard boxes used on shelves under the food prep table and cooking equipment must be removed.

headline: Pass with conditions: no allergen certificate
summary: Passed with conditions. No employee health policy on site. Allergen training certificate required. Leaking base of three-compartment faucet must be fixed. Foil on prep table must be removed; raw wood under sink must be sealed. A bed in the rear room must be removed.

headline: Pass with conditions: unsafe cold food, unapproved sausage
summary: Passed with conditions. About 40 lb rice and 25 lb beef at 55.5-59.0°F in walk-in cooler, and smaller amounts at 49-51°F in prep cooler; food discarded. Air-dried Mexican sausage lacked an approved process and was discarded. Expired food handler certificates.

headline: Pass with conditions: allergen training violation uncorrected
summary: Passed with conditions. Certified managers still lack valid allergen training, a repeat violation not corrected from an earlier inspection (report 2637859). Citation issued. Also spills on walk-in cooler floor and no covered receptacle in women's washroom.

headline: Pass with conditions: unsafe temperatures, cooler tagged
summary: Passed with conditions. Walk-in cooler at 50.0°F held raw beef, cooked beef and rice. About 105 lb of food at 47-50°F was voluntarily discarded. Cooler was tagged. Also a mop sink with a large hole, missing and stained ceiling tiles, and no allergen training proof.

headline: Pass: missing thermometer, stained cutting boards
summary: Passed. A cold-hold refrigeration unit lacks a thermometer for monitoring air temperature. Three cutting boards have open seams and dark stains. All-gender bathroom needs a covered receptacle for sanitary napkins.

headline: Pass: certified manager lacks allergen training
summary: Passed re-inspection. A certified food manager had no food allergen training. The manager was instructed to meet the requirement.

headline: Pass with conditions: missing health policy, cleanup kit
summary: Passed with conditions. No verifiable employee health policy on site; a template was left. No vomit and diarrhea cleanup kit or procedure; the kit must include a norovirus-effective sanitizer. Handwashing signs missing at sinks throughout.

headline: Fail: 50+ rat droppings, gnats found
summary: Failed. Over 50 rat droppings on kitchen floor and 10 or more gnats on prep-area wall. Pest control service required before reinspection. Rear exit door not fully rodent-proof. Person in charge had only a copy of certificate; citation issued. Leaking handsink pipe and greasy equipment.

headline: Pass: leaking drain pipe, cluttered basement
summary: Passed. Small drain-pipe leak under the rear prep sink must be repaired. Basement storage room is cluttered with items on the floor and must be organized and kept off the floor. Floor drain under the three-compartment sink is dirty and must be cleaned.

headline: Fail: no cleanup kit, no pest logbook
summary: Failed license inspection. No vomit and diarrhea cleanup kit on site. No pest control logbook or proof of service, and no garbage receptacle or contract. Food and bottles on floor must be raised six inches. Notes this license has not been inspected since 2009.

headline: Pass: no hair restraints, no allergen training
summary: Passed. A food handler was not wearing a hair restraint. Food handler and certified food manager (CFM) lack allergen training certificates. Also greasy deep fryers, a mop stored on the floor beside dirty water, and no backflow device on rear mop sink.

headline: Pass: clean spice racks, prep tables, cooler
summary: Passed. Clean wire spice racks and prep tables in the rear prep area. Clean the doors and door handles of the two-door prep cooler under the grill.

headline: Pass: no food handler training for employees
summary: Passed re-inspection. No food handler training for employees. Also missing restroom handwash signs, a non-working cooler thermometer, unlabeled bakery containers, a damaged freezer gasket, rusted shelving, debris throughout, and items stored on floors.

headline: Pass with conditions: pizzas held too cool
summary: Passed with conditions. Four pizzas stored on the front counter at 64.3-65.3°F, which the inspector marked as improper hot-holding temperatures. The pizzas were disposed of, worth about $60. Citation issued.

headline: Fail: about 25 live flying insects found
summary: Failed. About 25 live small flying insects on walls and ceilings of prep and dish areas, beverage station, and behind the bar. Additional pest control service needed; citation issued. Menu lacks consumer advisory for raw or undercooked foods like salmon, steak and eggs.

headline: Pass: two managers lack allergen training
summary: Passed re-inspection. Two certified food managers on duty had no valid allergen training certificate. Management was instructed that all certified managers must hold one.

headline: Fail: no valid food manager certificate on site
summary: Failed. Person in charge could not provide a valid certificate while food was prepared and served; citation issued. Black slimy substance inside ice machine dripping into ice. No employee health policy or vomit/diarrhea cleanup supplies. Dirty floors, unlabeled containers, and a half-inch rear door opening.

headline: Fail: mold-like ice machine buildup, cold sink
summary: Failed. Mold-like substance inside the ice machine (ice not for human consumption). Three-compartment sink water measured 40.7°F; minimum required is 110°F. Priority citation issued. Handsink and mop sink sit side by side with no partition.

headline: Pass: food debris on kitchen floor
summary: Passed. Food debris on the floor beneath cooking equipment and under the three-compartment sink must be cleaned.

headline: Fail: no handwash sink, no thermometer
summary: Failed. No handwash sink in rear prep and warewashing area. No written vomit and diarrhea cleanup procedure or supplies. No metal stem thermometer or sanitizer test kit. No commercial dumpster contract. Paper towels were missing; one was obtained during inspection.

headline: Pass: rust, wall splatters, no allergen training
summary: Passed re-inspection. Rust on underside of shelving above the compartment sink must be removed or replaced. Splatters on rear prep walls need cleaning. The certified manager on site had no allergen training; training and certificate required.

headline: Fail: flies and live roach found
summary: Failed re-inspection. About 10 small flies in dry storage and prep/dish areas, plus one live roach above the three-compartment sink. Pest control recommended. Also a sink without running water, a leaking faucet, and repeat violations like cardboard shelf liner and unsanitized wiping cloths.

headline: Fail: live flying insects, unsafe cold food
summary: Failed. Over six live flying insects (bumblebees) at the bar. Cold TCS foods at 46-59°F in prep cooler; about 15 lb discarded. Dish machine final rinse 168°F, below the required 180-194°F. No soap or paper towels at main prep sink. Expired food handler certificates.

headline: Pass: managers must obtain allergen training
summary: Passed re-inspection. All City of Chicago certified food managers were instructed to obtain allergen training certification and keep it on site for review.

headline: Pass: disposable scoop, utensil drying issues
summary: Passed. Deli cups were not air-dried and had stickers left on. A disposable container was used as a food scoop; proper utensils are required. Soiled utensil holding area sits beside the clean utensil rack at the three-compartment sink; a barrier was requested.

headline: Pass with conditions: dish machine not sanitizing
summary: Passed with conditions. Dish machine final rinse had no chlorine sanitizer; repair required to reach 100 ppm (parts per million). Dead cockroaches found inside its electrical panel, which must be cleaned. Fly strips hang over food prep area, and an employee has an expired food handler certificate.

headline: Pass: two workers lack food handler training
summary: Passed. Two male food handlers lack proof of food handler training. Also hair restraints not worn, including a bearded worker without a beard guard; cardboard used as floor liner; greasy equipment; rusted refrigerator shelves; and no covered restroom receptacle.

headline: Pass: wall holes, broken restroom ventilation
summary: Passed re-inspection. Holes in walls and cracked, missing duckboards must be repaired. Women's restroom ventilation is broken; a working exhaust fan must be provided.

headline: Pass: food debris inside slicer
summary: Passed. Food debris found inside the slicer; manager instructed to clean it and keep it maintained.

headline: Pass: damaged cutting board, cooler gaskets
summary: Passed. Tabletop cutting board has deep dark grooves and must be replaced or resurfaced. Two-door cooler has torn, damaged gaskets to repair or replace. Wall near the furnace is broken and damaged and must be made smooth and cleanable.

headline: Fail: about 20 small flies found
summary: Failed. About 20 small flies throughout facility, active in dishwashing and dry storage areas. Licensed pest control company recommended; citation issued. Also exposed ice in bar bins needs lids, and missing grout between floor tiles needs repair.

headline: Pass: door gap, floor debris and grime
summary: Passed. Half-inch gap under an exterior restroom door must be made tight-fitting. Debris on floor in rear storage near the walk-in cooler, and grime under the three-compartment sink and in storage areas, must be cleaned.

headline: Pass: ice scoop stored inside machine
summary: Passed. Ice scoop was stored inside the ice machine; a clean container is required. Women's restroom ceiling vent cover is missing. One food manager lacks an allergen training certificate.

headline: Fail: about 20 live cockroaches in prep area
summary: Failed re-inspection. About 20 live cockroaches on floor and countertop in front prep area; additional pest control needed; citation issued. Dead insects need cleaning. Also no backflow device at basement mop sink, greasy floors and walls, wall gaps, and spiderwebs.

headline: Fail: missing pest log, vehicle lacks lid
summary: Failed re-inspection. No pest control log book provided; the log must list vehicle VIN and service records with IDPH license number. No MVP license number on both sides of vehicle. No garbage receptacle with a lid on the vehicle.

headline: Pass: missing backflow device, clutter
summary: Passed. No backflow prevention device could be located on the water line of the butcher-area ice machine; one must be installed and maintained. Clutter in back storage rooms and cooking area must be removed.

headline: Fail: about 60 mouse droppings found
summary: Failed re-inspection. About 60 rodent (mouse) droppings found under dry storage racks, in electrical room, chemical closet and at bar shelf. Detail cleaning and additional pest control required; citation issued. Also mold-like buildup in walk-in racks, unused equipment, and wall openings under beverage system.

headline: Fail: uncorrected core violations from 2023
summary: Failed. Repeat core violations from a March 2, 2023 inspection were not corrected: soiled wiping cloths, food debris and spills, no washroom receptacle, dirty floors, and dusty hood. Also unlabeled bulk containers, dirty reach-in coolers and steamer oven. Staff attire corrected during inspection.

headline: Pass with conditions: no certified manager on duty
summary: Passed with conditions. No person in charge with a valid certificate, and no certified food manager on duty while chicken, steak and duck were served; citation issued. Dish machine measured 0 ppm (parts per million) sanitizer and was serviced during inspection. Milk crates used as shelving must be removed.

headline: Pass: equipment repairs and storage fixes needed
summary: Passed. Inaccurate thermometer in a two-door reach-in cooler. Ice machine repaired with tape. Milk crates used for elevation, cardboard and foil shelf liners, and a cracked light shield over the three-compartment sink. Replacement or repair ordered.

headline: Pass: pink substance in ice machine
summary: Passed. Slight pinkish substance found inside the basement ice machine; manager instructed to clean and sanitize. A shoestring was used in place of a toilet flusher in the employee restroom and must be replaced with a cleanable flusher.

headline: Pass: certified manager lacks allergen training
summary: Passed re-inspection. The certified manager had no allergen training certificate on site. The manager was instructed to obtain allergen training and keep the certificate on site.

headline: Pass: rear door gap, missing sink stoppers
summary: Passed. A quarter-inch gap at the rear exit door sweep must be sealed to keep out rodents. Three-compartment sink is missing stoppers. Ceiling lights above the sink are not working and must be replaced.

headline: Pass: unlabeled desserts, rear door gap
summary: Passed. Repackaged desserts on display must be labeled, and bulk storage containers need product names. A quarter-inch gap at the rear exit door must be sealed. Several areas need cleaning, and the food manager needs an allergen certificate.

headline: Pass: restroom and storage room repairs needed
summary: Passed. Two restrooms lack covered waste receptacles. Second-floor washroom door is not self-closing and has no ventilation fan. Dry storage room needs replacement ceiling tiles and drywall repairs.

headline: Pass: about 10 dead roaches in traps
summary: Passed. About 10 dead roaches found in traps behind the prep cooler, cold hold unit, compartment sink and above the basement door; manager told to remove and sanitize. Also no handwash signs, unlabeled food containers, a torn cooler gasket, and food debris throughout.

headline: Pass with conditions: no hair restraints, dirty units
summary: Passed with conditions. Food handlers on first floor not wearing hair restraints. Third-floor rear prep has stained cutting boards with open seams. Dish machine is missing its data plate. Cold-holding units have excessive food debris in gaskets and interiors.

headline: Pass with conditions: foods held above 41°F
summary: Passed with conditions. Cold foods above 41°F in rear prep unit, including eggs at 50.1°F and stewed tomatoes at 65.0°F; about 14 lb (about $68) discarded. A refrigerator at 48.5°F was adjusted and now meets requirements. Citation issued.

headline: Pass: no food handler certificates on site
summary: Passed re-inspection. No food handler certificates on site. Food stored on walk-in freezer floor, unlabeled containers, soiled wiping cloths on prep tables, milk crates used as shelving, grease buildup, and dirty mop heads.

headline: Fail: ice machine debris, expired allergen training
summary: Failed. Ice machine interior has encrusted debris. No thermometers in refrigeration units, and the food manager's allergen training has expired. Many repeat violations from a 06/10/2025 inspection, including food on floors and worn cutting boards. Corrections due by 7/9/2026.

headline: Pass: leaking faucet, dirty hood and filters
summary: Passed. Leaks at the three-compartment sink faucet must be repaired. Ice machine interior panel must be cleaned. Hood and filters above cooking equipment are dirty and must be cleaned to remove grease and debris.

headline: Fail: live small flies in basement areas
summary: Failed. 30 live small flies on walls of basement sandwich prep area and 30 more in basement storage rooms; must be removed by reinspection; pest control service advised. Also missing covered trash receptacle in basement washroom and unused cooler to remove or repair.

headline: Pass: leaking pipe under handwash sink
summary: Passed. Pipe under the handwash sink in the B-DAP prep area is leaking and must be repaired and maintained.

headline: Fail: over 20 rat droppings in storage
summary: Failed. Over 20 rat droppings on floor and shelves in rear storage; exterminator required; citation issued. Food stored on floor in rear storage. Also greasy equipment, grooved cutting boards, leaking 3-compartment sink faucets, and tong handles resting on peppers.

headline: Fail: blocked and non-working handwash sinks
summary: Failed. Prep handwash sink blocked by a container; restroom handwash sink had no running water. Missing soap was corrected on site when the manager provided it. No paper towels at prep sink. Three-compartment sink leaks; grooved cutting board. Citation issued.

headline: Pass with conditions: cold food unsafe, cooler tagged
summary: Passed with conditions. Ham, sausage and cut tomatoes at 49-50.2°F in prep cooler were discarded (about 15 lb, $50). Prep cooler at 52.9°F was tagged and must not be used until repaired and at 41°F or below. Broken floor tiles in warewashing area cause standing water.

headline: Pass: heavy debris, damaged floors and ceilings
summary: Passed re-inspection. Heavy food debris on walls, shelves and equipment, and excess items and cardboard on floors. Soiled crates used for elevation. Missing floor tiles, damaged walls, and water-stained ceiling tiles. Thermometers needed inside cooling units.

headline: Pass: rust, torn gasket, stained cutting boards
summary: Passed. Rust on wire shelving in two-door coolers must be removed and the shelves repainted or replaced. Frozen foods in plastic grocery bags in chest freezer must move to food-grade bags or containers. Torn cooler gasket and stained cutting boards need repair or replacement.

headline: Pass: food manager lacks allergen certificate
summary: Passed. Food service manager had no allergen certificate on site. Manager was instructed to obtain one.

headline: Cold food and rice too warm; food discarded
summary: Two-door refrigerator held foods above 41F, including rice at 73.0F, sliced mushrooms at 50.5F, and pepper sauce at 55.6F. Manager voluntarily discarded about 20 lbs ($75 value); citation issued. Leaking faucet, grease and dirt buildup, and hood needs cleaning.

headline: Missing handwash signage; ice scoop stored in ice
summary: Handwashing signage missing at the dish-area handsink. An ice scoop was stored with its handle in the ice, and staff were told to store handles up. Dust on walk-in cooler fan guards. Low hot water pressure at the dessert prep handsink.

headline: No certified manager on site; prior violation uncorrected
summary: Person in charge lacked a city certified manager certificate, and no manager was on site while shrimp and rice were handled; citation issued. A prior priority violation was not corrected: menu lacks a raw or undercooked food advisory. Citation issued.

headline: No health policy on site; leaks and missing signs
summary: No written signed employee health policies. Missing handwashing signs and thermometers in two coolers. Leaking washbowl in toilet room, toilet room door not self-closing, and missing lidded trash can. Broken wall base near prep area. Manager lacks allergen training certificate.

headline: Hair restraints missing; food stains on walls and freezer
summary: Food handlers in the prep area were not wearing hair restraints; staff must wear them. Food stains and dirt on the basement freezer, prep-area walls and floors. Clutter in the basement area must be removed.

headline: No exposed handsink at bar; handwash water too cool
summary: No exposed handwashing sink in the front bar area; one must be installed. Handwashing sink water measured 75.6 to 82.8F, below the required 100F. Missing splash guards in sushi area and wastewater on the ground near the dumpster.

headline: Cooler racks and gaskets in poor condition
summary: Cooler and walk-in racks are not smooth and easily cleanable. Gaskets on cooking-line reach-in coolers are in poor repair. Large equipment needs cleaning in place. No food handler certificates or manager allergen training proof available on site.

headline: Rust and damaged shelves; manager allergen certificates missing
summary: Clean utensils hung on the three-compartment sink faucet. Milk crates used for elevation; excessive rust on grease trap and shelves; chipped pressed-wood shelving; rusty shelving in front cooler; peeling plaster behind freezer. Employee bags stored in food area. No allergen certificates for managers.

headline: Missing handwashing sign; restroom ventilation not working
summary: No handwashing signage at the handsink in the taqueria area; manager instructed to provide and keep it posted. Mechanical ventilation in the restroom was not working; the person in charge was told to repair it.

headline: No certified manager on site; bare-hand contact with food
summary: No certified food manager on site when food was prepared; manager arrived about 25 minutes later; citation issued. An employee used bare hands to handle chopped lettuce; the food was discarded and hands washed. Rusty racks, scratched cutting boards, and spills on kitchen floors.

headline: No certified person in charge; cold food too warm
summary: No person in charge with a valid city sanitation certificate; citation issued. Cold food held at 46.8 to 50.2F; 6 gallons of milk and heavy cream were too warm. Manager discarded about 46 lbs, worth $40, on site. A prep cooler at 54F was tagged.

headline: Burner area charred; restroom fan not working
summary: Charred material and dirt built up around the burners and oven. Leaks at the base of the middle one-compartment sink faucet. Restroom ventilation not working. Person in charge lacked allergen training certificate; certified managers must obtain it.

headline: Hair restraints missing; ceiling tiles dirty and stained
summary: Staff in prep areas were not wearing hair restraints. Water-stained ceiling tiles, dirty prep-area ceiling tiles, and ice buildup and food debris under mats and inside the walk-in freezer. Mops not stored hanging. Allergen certificate posted had expired.

headline: No certified manager certificate posted; citation issued
summary: No city certified food service manager certificate posted on site during inspection. A certified employee must be on site at all times; citation issued.

headline: Cracked rear door to seal; stained ceiling tiles
summary: Re-inspection found a crack at the bottom of the rear exit door that must be sealed. Cooler shelves had rust, kitchen vents and light shields needed cleaning, and stained ceiling tiles needed replacing. Food handler and allergen training required.

headline: Dirt, water-damaged ceilings; allergen certificates missing
summary: Wiping cloths were stored on prep tables and the dish machine. Dirt and debris on floors and walls in dish and prep areas; water-damaged basement ceiling tiles; restroom ventilation not working; inadequate lighting; no manager allergen certificates posted.

headline: Foil shelf liners; torn cooler gasket
summary: Foil was used to line shelves; cardboard boxes must be removed to prevent pest hiding places. A torn rubber gasket inside the prep cooler by the grill must be repaired or replaced.

headline: Chicken thawed on floor at room temperature
summary: Prepackaged chicken was thawing on the floor at room temperature and staff were told to use an approved thawing method. Also: ice scoop handle in ice, soiled wiping cloths on floor, knives stored point-up, grease on pipes, and cluttered boxes.

headline: Unknown substance on ice machine surface
summary: A minimal amount of an unknown substance was found on the surface of the ice machine. It must be cleaned and maintained.

headline: Restroom handsinks too hot; door gaps; citation issued
summary: Restroom handwash sinks measured 143.8 to 144.3F, above the 120F maximum; citation issued. Gaps at the bottoms of front and rear doors must be sealed. Utensils stored uncovered, rust on walk-in shelves, and missing food handler training proof.

headline: Gap under rear exit door; greasy cooking equipment
summary: A half-inch gap at the rear exit door sweep must be sealed to rodent-proof the door. Grease and food debris on cooking equipment, stove, and fryer. Leak behind three-compartment sink; ventilation hood needs cleaning. No food handler or allergen certificates on site.

headline: Pest logbook missing; multiple uncorrected violations
summary: No written employee health policy, and no complete pest control logbook. Ice scoops stored in ice; food-contact items stored on floors; leaking sinks; grease disposed in dumpsters. A prior core violation for water-damaged basement wall was not corrected. Citations issued.

headline: Food in grocery bags; hole in prep-area wall
summary: Food items were stored in plastic grocery bags in the basement chest freezer; management was told to use food-grade bags only. A hole in the wall beside the basement prep handsink must be sealed.

headline: Openings at doors to seal; dish machine data plate missing
summary: Openings found at front and rear doors, which must be sealed to prevent pests. Squeeze bottles unlabeled, utensils not covered, no data plate on the dish machine, and leaking faucets and drainpipes in dish areas. Missing floor tiles near an exit.

headline: Repeat allergen certificate violation; no public summary posted
summary: Repeat core violation: no allergen training certificates for certified food managers. No inspection summary was posted for the public, and a new one was left. Broken lock on a unisex toilet room door must be repaired. Citations issued.

headline: Moldy foods discarded; labels and allergen training missing
summary: Moldy or spoiled foods found in refrigerators, about 16 lbs discarded. About 30 lbs of ready-to-eat foods lacked date labels and were discarded. Missing handwashing signage at bar sink, stained cutting boards, and no certified manager with allergen training. Citation issued.

headline: No certified person in charge for first hour; cooler failing
summary: No certified manager on site for the first hour while food was prepared; citation issued. Cook-line cooler at 62.7F; foods discarded and cooler tagged. Handsinks lacked paper towels or were blocked; bread stored on a garbage can; gaps at front door; floors and walls greasy.

headline: Handsink by fryers blocked, clogged, citation issued
summary: The handsink next to the deep fryers was not accessible: clogged drain, basin filled with water. Management told sinks must always be accessible; citation issued. Also: missing working thermometer in a sandwich cooler and missing floor grout.

headline: Food handler and allergen certificates could not be verified
summary: Inspector could not locate or verify food handler certificates for employees during inspection; certificates must be provided and kept on site. Managers have no proof of allergen training on site and must complete and keep it.

headline: Two live roaches found by dishwashing area
summary: Two live roaches were found on walls by dishwashing areas. Citation issued; operator must notify its pest control operator. Bulk food unlabeled, coolers and microwaves unclean, dumpster area unclean, and floors not clean behind and under equipment.

headline: Mold around three-compartment sink seal
summary: Mold buildup was found around the three-compartment sink seal and must be cleaned and maintained. A splash guard was needed at the handsink where tortilla chips are stored; it was provided. The sink seal needs repair; hood needs detail cleaning.

headline: Unlabeled sugar; dusty ice maker; dim cooler lighting
summary: Bulk sugar container was unlabeled and must be labeled. Ice scoop was stored on a dusty ice maker and must be kept on a clean surface. The main walk-in cooler had inadequate lighting.

headline: Blood odor in meat cooler; fryers and floors need cleaning
summary: Fresh meat blood spills create an odor in the meat cooler and walk-in cooler and must be cleaned. Fryers, grill and cooler interiors need cleaning; dust on fan covers; rust stains on grease receptacle. Missing backflow cap; washroom door not self-closing.

headline: Buildup around rear dish-area floor drain
summary: Complaint inspection found buildup around a floor drain in the rear dish area. The person in charge was instructed to clean it and keep it maintained. No other violations were listed.

headline: Basement ceiling and wall holes; allergen certificates missing
summary: Large opening in the basement liquor storage ceiling and holes in a basement storage wall must be sealed and repaired. Empty crates in liquor storage must be removed. No allergen training certificates were available for certified food managers.

headline: Food debris on walk-in freezer floor
summary: Food debris on the walk-in freezer floor must be cleaned and maintained. No other violations were listed.

headline: No certified manager on site; hot water missing at sinks
summary: No certified food service manager on premises; citation issued. Women's restroom handsink lacked signage. Unlabeled rice and pasta containers. Hot water missing at a men's restroom sink and a compartment sink. Prior priority violation for handwash signage not corrected.

headline: Dirty floors behind and under rear equipment
summary: Floors around, behind and between rear equipment were dirty and must be cleaned and maintained.

headline: Ice machine slime, cold food too warm, citations issued
summary: Kitchen ice machine had black and pink slime dripping onto ice; ice was removed and the machine cleaned. About 400 lbs of cold food, worth $2,500, was discarded. Walk-in cooler #1 at 50.1F was not to be used until reinspected. Citation issued.

headline: Unlabeled bulk foods; cutting boards stained
summary: Bulk foods stored in containers in the rear dry storage were not labeled with contents' names. Cutting boards have open seams and dark stains and must be refinished or replaced.

headline: Unfinished wood shelves; no manager allergen training
summary: Walk-in cooler shelves are unfinished wood and must be painted or sealed. Heavy ice buildup in a freezer and a heavily soiled mop sink. Unshielded lights in basement storage. No allergen training for any certified food manager on site.

headline: Debris on floors; burned-out dish-area light
summary: Loose debris, dirt and dust built up on floors and in corners in prep and dish areas, and must be detail cleaned and kept clean. A burned-out light bulb in the dish-washing area must be replaced.

headline: Beard restraint needed; leaking handsink pipe
summary: A male food handler was working without a beard restraint. A pipe leaks under the coffee prep handsink, and the women's restroom trash receptacle is missing its cover. All were instructed to be corrected and maintained.

headline: Leaking handsink; dirty floors near walk-in
summary: Dish-area handsink leaks at the faucet base and must be repaired. Floors under shelving, along walls, and in the walk-in cooler are dirty and must be cleaned. Floor drains must also be cleaned to prevent pest breeding.

headline: Soiled floors and walls
summary: Floors and walls had soil buildup and the manager was instructed to clean them. No other violations were listed.

headline: Prepared foods held overnight without date labels
summary: Lasagna, pasta and rice held overnight were not date labeled; foods were discarded and citation issued. Rusty shelves, water-damaged ceiling tiles, and soiled mop heads. No proof of food handler training or manager allergen training on site. Summary report was not posted where customers could see it.

headline: No certified manager; dish machine not sanitizing, tagged
summary: No certified manager on duty while tacos and burritos were being prepared. Low-temperature dish machine had 0 ppm sanitizer, below the 50 ppm minimum; it was tagged and must not be used until reinspected. Unlabeled rice and food stored on floors.

headline: Dirty floors; clutter in basement
summary: Dirt and debris along wall bases in rear prep and basement storage must be cleaned. Clutter and unnecessary items in the basement must be removed to prevent rodent hiding places.

headline: Handwash signs missing; expired manager allergen training
summary: Handwashing signage missing at prep, dish and restroom sinks. Dark residue in an idle ice machine. Cutting boards near hot and cold holding units must be replaced. Ice machines need backflow devices. Expired allergen training for a certified manager.

headline: Sticky fly trap over prep table must move
summary: Re-inspection: a sticky fly trap hung directly over a food prep table, which the food code does not allow, and must be relocated. Debris, grease and dirt buildup on floors and walls, and dusty light shields and vents.

headline: Thawing, labeling and cleaning problems found
summary: Frozen fish was thawing in a container in prep; staff were instructed to use an approved method. Food stored on walk-in floor, soiled wiping cloths on prep tables, duct tape repair on freezer, torn gasket, grease buildup, milk crates used, and clutter.

headline: No allergen training certificate for manager
summary: No allergen training certificate for the food service manager. The manager was instructed to obtain one.

headline: Handsinks blocked, unstocked; soap and towels fixed on site
summary: Prep handsink had no soap and no paper towels; a food handler obtained both during inspection. Rear prep handsink was blocked by utensils and a food container and must stay accessible. Citations issued. Grease and debris on floors, and dust on vents.

headline: Food stored on floors; sink drain disconnected
summary: No handwashing sign at rear sink. Food items stored on floors in prep, storage and sales areas. Wiping cloths on prep tables; no stoppers or drainboard for the three-compartment sink; utility sink drain not connected; openings in walls and ceilings; unused items to remove.

headline: Health policy missing; coolers lack thermometers
summary: No employee health policy on premises; manager must provide one for each employee. Missing thermometers in two coolers, unfinished wooden shelves, no backflow device at rear mop sink, and missing floor drain cover.

headline: Unlabeled containers; food stored on floors
summary: Food storage containers without common-name labels; staff told to label them. Food containers were on floors in the walk-in cooler, prep and storage areas and must be raised at least six inches. Cardboard liners on prep equipment must be removed.

headline: Outdoor garbage lid stuck open; citation issued
summary: Outdoor garbage receptacle lid was stuck open and could not close. Manager was instructed to provide tight-fitting lids; citation issued.

headline: Ice machine dirty; items stored on floor
summary: Ice machine door had buildup and was in disrepair; the person in charge was told to clean and maintain it. Items were stored on the floor of a non-working walk-in cooler, and standing soiled water and black buildup were found around the ice machine.

headline: Broken window repaired; restroom fan not working
summary: Re-inspection found a broken window leaving a large gap; it was temporarily covered with foam board and must be repaired to close tightly. Toilet room ventilation fan was not working and must be provided.

headline: Food containers not inverted on drying racks
summary: Food containers were not stored properly on drying racks and must be stored inverted. No other violations were listed.

headline: About 100 live flying insects; cold food too warm
summary: About 100 live small flying insects on walls and ceilings in prep, manager office, dish and dry storage areas; citation issued. Ribs at 50 to 52F and sausage at 52F in cold units; citation issued. No hot water at a handwash sink by the drive-thru.

headline: Gap under rear door; food debris and spills found
summary: About a 1/4-inch gap under the rear exit door needs a tight seal. Stained cutting boards, a broken storage rack, and a broken cooler base. Food debris and spills throughout. One certified manager lacks allergen training certificate.

headline: Frozen meat in grocery bags; food handler lacks training
summary: Plastic grocery bags were used to store frozen meats in the freezer; management told to use food-grade bags only. Food prep table, microwave, oven, and cooler interiors need cleaning. Floors and walls under equipment need cleaning. One employee lacked food handler training.

headline: Roaches crawling and flies in several areas; citation
summary: Re-inspection: about 10 or more live roaches crawling on floors, with debris under unused equipment, and about 40 or more live small flies in bar, prep and dish areas. Citation issued. Restroom hot water only reached 93.4F; no pest log; gap under rear door.

headline: Ice machine has heavy slime buildup; citation issued
summary: Heavy black and pink slime found inside the ice machine used for human consumption; ice must be removed and the machine cleaned and sanitized. Citation issued. Torn walk-in gasket, missing lidded trash can in employee toilet, four of six hood bulbs burnt out.

headline: Dead insects in restroom vents; food handler training lapses
summary: Dead insects found in ceiling vent covers in two washrooms, which must be cleaned. Debris and grease on the grease dumpster lid; dusty buildup in the walk-in cooler. Several food handlers had no proof or expired food handler training certificates.

headline: Torn gaskets on cooler by grill
summary: Re-inspection found torn gaskets on a two-door cooler with cold hold attached in prep areas across from the grill. The operator was instructed to repair and maintain them.

headline: Flies noted? No; food stored on floor; handler training missing
summary: Employee drank from an open beverage container at the cook line. Food stored on the floor and dry containers left open without overhead protection. Plumbing fixtures in poor repair. Food handlers on site lacked food handler training or certificates.

headline: Minor grease buildup inside fryers
summary: Re-inspection found minor grease buildup inside the cooking fryers. They must be cleaned and maintained.

headline: Leaking faucet base at three-compartment sink
summary: Re-inspection found the three-compartment sink faucet base still leaking in the rear food prep area. The operator must repair and maintain it. No other violations were listed.

headline: Missing thermometers; hair restraints not worn
summary: Cold-holding equipment in the front and rear prep areas had no thermometers, and the person in charge was told to provide them. Multiple food handlers were not wearing hair restraints.

headline: Rusty cooler racks; cutting boards cut and stained
summary: Walk-in cooler racks have rust and must be restored to a smooth, cleanable surface or replaced. Cutting boards have deep cuts and stains and must be sanded and resealed or replaced.

headline: No sanitation certificate posted; sink and dish-area problems
summary: No valid city food sanitation certificate posted. No chlorine test kit. Three-compartment sink drains slowly and leaks from the faucet. Dumpster overflowing and cluttered floors near restroom. Water-damaged floor tiles near sink. Citation issued.

headline: Mouse droppings; no hot water; citation issued
summary: About 20 mouse droppings in the washroom, dish room, prep and kitchen; staff must remove them and sanitize. Additional pest control needed; citation issued. No hot water at several sinks until a plumber restored it during inspection. Cutting board with deep cuts.

headline: 50 live roaches found; dish machine 0 ppm sanitizer
summary: About 50 live roaches found in front and rear prep, dish and storage areas. Handsink blocked by cart and bike; citation issued. Dish machine sanitizer measured 0 ppm and was 100 ppm after a tech fixed it on site. Roach poison stored in an unlabeled sprayer.

headline: No certified manager on site; over 30 flies found
summary: No certified food service manager on premises. Over 30 small flies found throughout the facility, including restrooms and bar; citation issued. Dumpster overflowing and cannot close, which can attract pests. Menu lacks raw or undercooked food advisory.

headline: No health policy or vomit cleanup kit on site
summary: No completed employee health policy and no kit for cleaning vomit or diarrhea. Handwashing signs missing at several sinks including restrooms. Bar three-compartment sink lacks drain stoppers. No food allergen awareness certificate present.

headline: Hair restraint missing; grease and cooking equipment dirty
summary: Employee serving food without a hair restraint. Dirty wiping cloths stored on sink and prep tables. Grease and food debris on cooking equipment, floors, and drains. Openings in walls and missing tiles. Prior violations for unlabeled containers and dirty microwave not corrected.

headline: Three-compartment sink drain stopper not working
summary: The three-compartment sink drain stopper was not working and must be repaired. Coolers have soil buildup inside and must be cleaned.

headline: Serving plates not inverted; managers lack allergen training
summary: Serving plates on prep-area shelves were not inverted and must be, to prevent dust. Certified food managers on duty did not have allergen training certificates; all managers must obtain them.

headline: Frozen food stored in grocery bags; leaking sink
summary: Frozen food was found in grocery store bags inside freezers; staff must use food-grade bags only. Rear prep handsink near hot grills is leaking. Broken bulbs inside dairy cooler. Missing food handler certificates must be provided.

headline: Knives wedged between prep table and wall
summary: Knives were being stored wedged between a prep table and the wall. The inspector instructed staff to keep them on a clean surface.

headline: Missing splash guards between handsinks
summary: No splash guards were installed between the front and rear counter handwashing sinks. Washable splash guards must be installed.

headline: Heavy equipment greasy; grease puddles under fryers
summary: Heavy equipment in prep area, including cooler, wok station, and fryer, needs grease and food debris removed. Large puddles of grease and food debris under the wok station and fryers must be cleaned to prevent pests. Food handler training certificates required.

headline: Loose handwash sink in south restroom
summary: The handwash sink in the south restroom is loose from the wall and must be reattached. No other violations were listed.

headline: No certified manager during food prep; citation issued
summary: No certified food manager on site while burgers and ceviche were prepared; citation issued. Pink mineral buildup inside the dish-area ice machine must be cleaned. Excessive grease inside a cooking fryer.

headline: Milk crates used as shelving; unused items stored
summary: Milk crates were being used as shelving in prep and storage areas and must be replaced with shelving raised 6 inches off the floor. Unused equipment and articles in the rear receiving area must be removed.

headline: Soup, vegetables cooled improperly; food discarded
summary: Cooked soup and vegetables were cooled improperly; staff made an ice bath and began chilling them in the freezer on site. Fried garlic held unrefrigerated at 64F; about 10 lbs discarded. Around 20 lbs of tofu and noodles lacked date labels. Overflowing garbage; citation issued.

headline: Two dish machines lacked sanitizer at final rinse
summary: Low-temperature dish machines at the first-floor bar and seventh-floor east bar showed no sanitizer at final rinse. Machines were not in use; management must repair them and use a 100 ppm chlorine final rinse.

headline: Hair restraints and beard guards missing
summary: Some food handlers were not wearing hair restraints. Male food handlers had beards without beard guards. Accumulated debris under the rear prep table and in the cabinet under the drink dispenser in the dining area must be cleaned.

headline: Food stored under wastewater pipes; dirty floors and restroom
summary: Dry foods and a box freezer were stored in the basement directly under wastewater pipes; staff were told to move them. Bulk foods unlabeled, milk crates used as shelves, rusty walk-in shelving, dirty staff toilet, and dirty floors.

headline: Handsink blocked by pitchers; prior violations uncorrected
summary: Handsink in front prep was blocked by plastic pitchers; staff removed them during inspection; citation issued. Grease, food debris, flour buildup on floors and cooler surfaces. Prior core violations for missing handwashing signage and a ceiling hole above the hot water tank were not corrected.

headline: Missing handwash sign; food on walk-in floor
summary: Handwashing sign missing at front prep area; must be provided and maintained. Food containers stored on floors in walk-in cooler and storage area must be raised at least six inches.

headline: Litter around dumpster; dusty fryer hood
summary: Litter and debris on the ground around the outside dumpster must be cleaned to avoid a food source for pests. The filters and hood above the fryers are dusty and must be cleaned and maintained.

headline: Dead roaches found in prep and dry storage
summary: Dead roaches were found in prep and dry storage areas; staff must remove them and clean and sanitize those areas. Plates were not inverted after drying. Leaking dish-area handsink and missing floor grout and damaged tiles in the kitchen.

headline: Rodent droppings found; citation issued
summary: About 30 rodent droppings in the rear storage area, about 10 near the water heater, and about 20 around an unused freezer condenser. Staff must eliminate the activity, clean affected areas, and contact pest control. Citation issued. Also: scoops stored inside product, cardboard shelf liners, and a toilet bowl missing its lid.

headline: About 40 live flying insects; citation issued
summary: About 40 live small flying insects on walls, ceilings, shelves and stock boxes in prep, dishwashing, storage and dining areas. Additional pest control needed; citation issued. No working temperature indicator on high-temperature dish machine; leak under dish machine.

headline: No thermometers inside deli coolers
summary: No thermometers were found inside deli coolers. Thermometers must be placed inside all coolers and maintained.

headline: Dirty shelving, vents and floors; door closer broken
summary: Walk-in cooler shelves, basement shelving, and the ice machine interior must be cleaned. The employee restroom door's self-closing device is in poor repair. Vents above prep very dirty with grease and dust. Floors need cleaning around cooking equipment and basement shelving.

headline: Food covered too tightly while cooling
summary: Food was being covered tightly during the cooling process, which slows cooling. Staff were instructed to cover it loosely or leave it uncovered so it cools properly.

headline: Bread shelf needs cover; rinse before sanitizing
summary: Top shelf of two large bread shelves in the baking area is not protected from dust and debris; overhead cover needed. Employees washed equipment at the 3-compartment sink without rinsing before sanitizing; instructed to rinse first.

headline: No soap, paper towels, or sanitizer at sinks
summary: Dishwashing handwash sink had no soap or paper towels; priority violation. No chemical sanitizer on premises, and no sanitizer test kit. Handwash signs missing. Opening at front entrance base needs sealing. Missing stoppers, a backflow device for coffee machines and a grease trap.

headline: Missing handwash signage; overflowing waste bins
summary: Front service area handwash sink lacked signage reminding employees to wash hands; must be added. Indoor waste containers near rear exit overflowed with food waste; must be covered or moved outdoors.

headline: Rodent droppings and flies throughout food areas
summary: About 80 small rodent droppings on floors, shelves and food boxes; about 28 live flies in prep and dining areas. Must eliminate pests, call pest control, and clean. Also: no hand-drying towels at a prep sink (supplied on site), no food thermometer, no food handler certificates.

headline: Food handler training required for each employee
summary: Re-inspection passed. Each food handler must have food handler training.

headline: Dead flies in bathroom; leaks and cardboard
summary: About 15 dead flies on the floor of the left-hand bathroom; must be removed. Food boxes and ice bags on floors; cardboard lines the walk-in freezer floor. Leaking toilet behind right-hand bowl. Missing food handler certificates for employees.

headline: Slow sinks; leaking condenser; greasy hood filters
summary: Wiping cloths were not stored in sanitizing solution when not in use. Large condenser in walk-in prepared food cooler leaks water. Customer washroom hand sinks drain slowly. Hood filters above prepared foods need cleaning to remove grease build-up.

headline: Unapproved second-floor prep area lacks handsink
summary: Newly added second-floor prep area had no handwash sink; must provide one with hot and cold running water, citation issued. Raw wood cabinet and shelving must be sealed, as must raw brick walls in that prep area.

headline: Live roaches in dish, storage and prep areas
summary: About 4 live roaches in rear dishwashing area, 5 on dish storage rack and 2 in front prep area, plus several dead insects. Contact pest control; service needed before the December 2 return date. Also: leaking dishwasher sprayer valve, greasy equipment.

headline: Ice machine debris; torn cooler gasket
summary: Encrusted debris inside ice machine must be removed, machine detail cleaned and serviced. Torn door gasket on front 3-door prep cooler must be replaced. Dust on ceiling vents over the prep area must be cleaned.

headline: Beans held too warm; handwash sink blocked
summary: Two large containers of cooked black beans held at 61.5°F to 63.5°F in walk-in cooler, above the 41°F safe limit; discarded (about 15 lbs). Handwash sink in warewashing area inaccessible with disconnected pipe; ordered repaired.

headline: Pests found: flying insects, rat and mouse droppings
summary: Numerous flying insects in prep, dishwashing and storage areas; over 10 rat droppings and over 20 mouse droppings found. Manager told to call an exterminator and clean. Also: leaking faucet, damaged cooler gaskets, inspection summary not posted.

headline: Pink slime in ice machine; bathroom wall damage
summary: Pink slime-like substance inside the ice machine; ice is used only for cooling meat, without direct contact with it. Person in charge told to clean and maintain it. Bathroom wall near the toilet is damaged and must be repaired to be smooth and cleanable.

headline: Frozen chicken thawed in stagnant water
summary: Food handler thawed frozen chicken in a prep sink of stagnant hot water; staff told to use running water. Manager discarded 5 lbs of chicken. Also: no covered waste receptacles in women's restroom; sanitation manager lacks allergen training.

headline: Empty boxes; food splatters near chicken cooler
summary: Empty cardboard boxes throughout the facility must be removed. Food splatters on wall near front showcase cooler, where chicken is stored, must be cleaned. Dusty vents in walk-in cooler must be cleaned.

headline: Unsecured cooler doors; leaking hot water tank
summary: Cooler and freezer doors have no key or device to keep them secure in transit; must lock or secure them. Small leak from hot water tank under 3-compartment sink must be repaired. Slight build-up on floors beside cooking equipment must be cleaned.

headline: Dirty floors; small leak; greasy hood filters
summary: Floors throughout have dirt, grease and food debris along walls and under equipment; must detail clean. Shelving with flour, dust and grease build-up. Small water leak above grease trap must be repaired. Heavy grease and dirt on hood edges and filters must be detail cleaned.

headline: Dust on ice machine; grease under fryers
summary: Heavy dust on the side of the ice machine and a nearby fan; must be cleaned. Baseboard lining the rear kitchen wall behind the pizza oven needs repair to prevent insect entry. Grease under deep fryers and debris under front bar equipment must be cleaned.

headline: Improper storage of utensils, cloths, and items
summary: Prep area wiping cloths must be kept in sanitizing solution. Clean utensils must not be stored above the three-compartment sink. Rear items must be off the floor. Masking tape used as splash guard must be replaced. Walk-in cooler floor has food spillage; unused rear equipment must be removed.

headline: Dirty self-serve ice machine; dusty vents
summary: Self-serve ice machine has dirt and build-up; instructed to detail clean and maintain. Dust build-up on ceiling and vents above the prep cooler; must be cleaned.

headline: Walk-in freezer floors not clean
summary: Floors inside the walk-in freezer were not clean; must be cleaned.

headline: Food handler training must be completed
summary: Employees lacked required food handler training; manager instructed to comply with state food handler requirements.

headline: No certified manager on duty; leaking pipes
summary: No city certified manager on duty and no sanitation certificate posted while chicken and beef were handled; citation issued. Previous priority violation not corrected: slime inside ice machine, which must be discarded and cleaned. Leaks under handsink and 3-compartment sink; broken cabinet doors.

headline: Damaged refrigerator door gaskets
summary: Re-inspection passed. Both doors of a two-door refrigerator next to the two-compartment sink have damaged gaskets (door seals); manager instructed to repair or replace them.

headline: Unlabeled bulk food; no hair restraint; no allergen training
summary: Bulk flour, sugar and other foods found without labels; must label. A food handler was not wearing a hair restraint. Interior bottom of a reach-in cooler at the rear was not clean. Sanitation manager lacks allergen training; must provide.

headline: No health policy; no soap or paper towels
summary: No verifiable employee health policy on site; citation issued. No vomit and diarrhea kit or procedure. No hand soap or paper towels at prep handsink; citation issued. No food thermometer or sanitizer test device on site. Pest control logbook unavailable, last report 2022.

headline: Unprotected ready-to-eat food; ripped cooler gaskets
summary: Self-service dining table with hot rice and meats had no sneeze guard or protective cover; priority, must be fixed by re-inspection. Some food handlers lacked hair restraints. Ripped gaskets in produce cooler; milk crates used to elevate items; missing hood filter.

headline: Stored items on floor; rusted hand dryers
summary: Items stored in the basement closet must be elevated from the floor. Rusted, decayed hand dryers in restrooms must be repaired. Tin foil and cloth towels used as shelf liners must be removed. Debris under dish machine; damaged restroom ceiling.

headline: No test strips; no food handler certificates
summary: No sanitizing test strips on premises for the three-compartment sink; must provide by re-inspection, priority. No food handler certificates on premises; all handlers must be certified. No food allergen training certificate on premises. Some handlers lacked hair restraints.

headline: Unapproved cook-chill process stopped
