summary: Hot soup bagged and cooled on site without a variance or hazard analysis plan (HACCP); manager told to stop and discarded 20 lbs of clam chowder ($120). Missing ice bin cover at bar; damaged walk-in cooler lines insulation; food debris and standing water in drawer coolers; hoses on sinks.

headline: Missing handwashing signs; worn cooler gaskets
summary: Handwashing sink near walk-in cooler had no sign reminding staff to wash hands; manager told to add signs. Paper towels stored in employee toilet room must be moved. Torn, missing gaskets on a 2-door cooler; manager told to repair.

headline: Cooler thermometers too hard to read
summary: Refrigerator thermometers at the rear of coolers could not be read. Manager instructed to keep all thermometers in the warmest part of each cooler where they can be read easily.

headline: Unlabeled bulk containers; dirty floor drains
summary: Bulk food storage containers not labeled; must label. Peeling paint on front and rear prep walls; a few broken floor tiles. Dirt and food debris on floor drains throughout; dust on vents in washrooms and dishwashing area must be cleaned.

headline: No manager training proof; uncertified food handlers
summary: Person in charge lacked proof of food safety management training; must provide. Food handlers preparing TCS foods (must be kept hot or cold) without a certificate holder on site; citation issued. Cutting boards deeply cut and stained; heavy grease; floors need deep cleaning.

headline: No certified manager while milk was served
summary: No city sanitation manager or valid certificate on site while milk, a TCS food (must be kept hot or cold), was prepared and served; citation issued. Person in charge provided a photocopy; manager arrived at 11:20 AM. Wet mops stored in buckets; must hang to dry.

headline: Shelving soil residue; slow deli sink
summary: Deli walk-in freezer shelving has soil residue; must detail clean. Slow-draining handwash sink in deli next to plastic trays; must be repaired. One of two customer restrooms lacked a lidded waste can; management provided one during inspection. Wet mops must hang to dry.

headline: Hair restraint lapse; leaking sink faucets
summary: One food handler was not wearing a hair restraint; manager told all handlers must wear effective ones. Bar hand sink faucet leaks and dishwashing hand sink drains slowly; manager told to repair.

headline: Unlabeled bulk containers; debris in drains
summary: Bulk containers in food prep not labeled with common name; must label. Insect control device plugged in above prep table; must be removed from food areas. Excessive debris in floor drains; dust on walk-in cooler fan covers must be cleaned.

headline: No valid manager on site; unlabeled containers
summary: No valid city sanitation manager on site while TCS foods (must be kept hot or cold) were stored, handled and served; citation issued. Food storage containers unlabeled. Ice scoop stored directly on ice; mop stored improperly; missing light shields in washroom and prep area.

headline: Raw or undercooked food not disclosed on menu
summary: Menu does not tell customers which items, such as eggs cooked to order, are raw or undercooked; must disclose on printed and online menus. Staff prepared drinks without effective hair restraints. Food spills in walk-in cooler; items stored on floor.

headline: Handwash water too cool; no handwashing signs
summary: Second-floor employee washroom handwash sinks ran too cool: 78.3°F and 92.8°F, but must reach at least 100°F; priority violation. Handwashing signs are missing at sinks in front prep, rear prep and dishwashing, and employee washrooms.

headline: String on drying rack; no drain board at sink
summary: String used to hold utensils at drying rack; manager instructed to remove it. No drain board provided at the three-compartment sink; manager instructed to install one.

headline: Holes in baseboards; water-damaged ceiling tiles
summary: Holes in baseboards in washroom and grocery area must be sealed. Dirty floors under grocery storage need cleaning. Spray foam sealant must be smoothed. Water-damaged ceiling tiles in rear storage must be replaced. Unnecessary items must be removed to prevent rodent harboring.

headline: No certified manager; dish and ice machines unsafe
summary: No certified manager on site while chicken was prepared; citation issued. Low-temperature dish machine at 0 ppm chlorine, tagged and held. Heavy black slime inside ice machine used for drinks. No employee health policy, no soap at sinks, no metal thermometer; repeat violation.

headline: No certified manager during food preparation
summary: No certified food sanitation manager on site, and no certificate posted, while TCS foods (foods that must be kept hot or cold) were prepared and served; citation issued. No employees had food handler training. Also: single-use items stored on floor, clogged utility sink.

headline: No health policy; no vomit and diarrhea kit
summary: No employee health policy on site; must be provided at all times, priority violation. No written procedure or adequate supplies to respond to vomit and diarrhea events; priority violation.

headline: No certified manager while TCS foods served
summary: No certified food manager on premises while TCS foods (must be kept hot or cold) were prepared and served; citation issued. Multiple employees lacked food handler certificates. Packaged desserts unlabeled; boxed food stored on floor in walk-in cooler. No toilet tissue in women's restroom until staff supplied it.

headline: Rat droppings and live roaches; citation issued
summary: About 20 rat droppings in unused kitchen equipment and rear storage; 4 live roaches under the three-compartment sink and behind a dry storage unit. Clean droppings; more pest control service needed; citation issued. Also: poor cutting board, no allergen certificate.

headline: Doors not rodent-proof; uncovered ice bin
summary: Front and rear doors are not rodent-proof at the bottom; must be sealed. No handwashing signage in toilet room near rear exit. Ice bin behind the bar was filled but uncovered; must be covered when not in use.

headline: Grease trap pipe leak; allergen certificate missing
summary: Water leaks from a pipe leading to the grease trap in the dish area; manager told to repair. The certified food manager had no proof of allergen training certificate; all certified managers told to obtain one.

headline: No vomit and diarrhea cleanup kit on site
summary: No spill kit with a norovirus-effective spray on premises; priority violation, must keep one on site at all times. No handwashing signs at any sink. Also: plumber's putty in a sink, missing backflow device, stained ceiling tiles, missing door.

headline: Black slime in ice machine; debris throughout
summary: Black slimy substance on interior water parts of ice machine, dripping into ice used for human consumption; machine must be turned off, ice removed, and cleaned, priority violation, citation issued. Food debris on floors and surfaces; expired food handler certificates.

headline: No certified manager while handling chicken
summary: Person in charge lacked a city certified manager certificate. No certified manager on site while chicken, a TCS food (must be kept hot or cold), was handled; citation issued. Missing covers for sauces at the prep line; must be provided.

headline: Missing handler certificates; floors and walls need repair
summary: Food handlers without proof of training must complete an approved program. No approved allergen training certificate found. Loose sink and handwash faucet need repair; no backflow device at mop sink; holes in wall around prep area must be sealed.

headline: Dish machine not sanitizing; no handwashing signs
summary: Low-temperature dish machine showed 0 ppm chlorine during inspection, below the required 50 to 100 ppm. Machine tagged and may not be used; must use the hotel main kitchen's high-temperature dish machine. No handwashing signs near food prep sink; must provide.

headline: Hair restraints not worn; restroom trash lacks lid
summary: Food handlers in the prep area were not wearing hair restraints; must wear them. No handwashing signage in kitchen staff's women's restroom. Restroom trash receptacle has no lid. Dirt on the can opener; dust on ceiling tiles and vents.

headline: Broken non-working equipment; leaking basement pipes
summary: Dust on basement shelving must be cleaned and sanitized. Several non-working coolers, a freezer and an oven must be repaired or removed. Broken pipes outside basement washrooms leak onto floors; pipes must be repaired and floors kept dry.

headline: Dusty floors; spillage in walk-in cooler
summary: Dust, dirt and small debris on floors, in corners, and behind cooling units and other equipment. Walk-in cooler had spillage and food debris on the floor. Staff instructed to clean all areas.

headline: Dish machine not sanitizing; rear door gap
summary: Low-temperature dish machine showed 0 ppm chlorine, below the required 50 to 100 ppm; a technician arrived to fix it during report writing. Priority violation, no citation. Rear side exit door has a 1/4-inch gap at the bottom that must be sealed.

headline: Large and small flies; no certified manager present
summary: Person in charge lacked a city manager certificate while beef and cheese were prepared; a phone photo was not accepted. About 10 large and 20 small live flies found, citation issued. Also: 2022 pest service record, no test strips, unlabeled foods.

headline: Sewage backup at floor drain; standing water in cooler
summary: Sewage backed up at a floor drain when water runs at 2 of 3 hand sinks; priority violation, citation issued, must be corrected. Standing water inside the rear pizza cooler; must be cleaned.

headline: Plumbing leak; soiled base coving; wall hole
summary: Small leak at frosty machine plumbing next to ice machine; manager told to repair. Base coving soiled with debris in several areas, including utility sink closet and dry storage. Hole in wall beside utility sink must be repaired or sealed.

headline: About 100 lbs of cold food held too warm
summary: Deli display cooler held TCS foods (must be kept hot or cold) at unsafe internal temperatures, including cooked ribs at 49.1°F and mac and cheese at 47.2°F. About 100 lbs (valued $1,900) discarded. Cooler air at 50 to 60°F; citation issued.

headline: Pizzas held too cool; about 40 lbs discarded
summary: Cooked pizzas held in display case without a time and temperature log, below 135°F: sausage at 80°F, veggie at 90.6°F, cheese at 84.7°F. About 40 lbs (valued $350) discarded, citation issued. Certified manager on duty lacked allergen training; must comply.

headline: No health policy; food handler lacks certificate
summary: No employee health policy or training on site, priority, citation issued. No procedure or kit for vomit and diarrhea events, priority. A food handler lacked a valid certificate. No allergen certificate. Handwash signs missing; slow-draining sink; grocery bags used in cooler.

headline: Burned-out light bulb over dish sink
summary: One burned-out ceiling light bulb above the dishwashing three-compartment sink; must be replaced.

headline: Food handlers on duty lacked training
summary: Food handlers on duty did not have food handler training. Must provide and maintain training records.

headline: Unlabeled dry containers; open food, debris
summary: Dry food storage containers without labels throughout facility. Front entrance has an opening at the bottom; must be sealed. Sugar cones, tea and straws stored in toilet room; must be removed. Uncovered sugar cone box and debris on floors under equipment.

headline: Sanitizer bucket needed; food displayed unprotected
summary: Prep tables need a bucket of sanitizing solution for wiping cloths. Plates and utensils stored on a dining table in public view must be covered or moved. Missing handle on prep cooler cover must be replaced. No food handler training certificate provided on site.

headline: Ice machine debris; torn gasket; backflow device
summary: Encrusted debris inside ice machine must be removed and machine detail cleaned and serviced. Pots and pans not stored inverted; must be. Torn door gasket on kitchen 2-door cooler must be replaced. Hose bib under 3-compartment sink needs a backflow device placed where it can be serviced.

headline: No health policy, handwash signs, or certificates
summary: No employee health policy on site; must have verification on site at all times, priority, no citation. Handwash signs missing at all sinks. No food handler certificates; staff must have them on site, with a one-month grace period for new hires.

headline: Expired handler certificates; greasy cooking equipment
summary: Food handler certificates and a manager's allergen training certificate have expired; must renew. Grease and food debris on cooking equipment and floor drains; cracked floor tiles; leaking 3-compartment sink faucet base; dust in washroom vents.

headline: 60 live flies in storage area; unlabeled bottles
summary: About 60 live small flies found on walls, ceiling, shelving, containers and stock in side storage area; instructed to eliminate flies and call pest control. Also: unlabeled squeeze bottles, hair restraints not worn in prep, dirty walk-in shelves, stained ceiling tiles.

headline: No sanitizer test kit; heavy hood grease
summary: No sanitizer test strip kit on site; a kit must be kept on site at all times, citation issued. Shelves lined with foil and cardboard boxes, which must be removed to prevent pest hiding places. Heavy grease and dirt on hood, filters and pipes.

headline: Wastewater backup at meat room drains; torn strips
summary: Standing and backed-up wastewater from floor drains at the meat cutting room sinks and behind display coolers; repair the source and sanitize affected areas, citation issued. Torn weather stripping on prep and chicken walk-in cooler doors must be repaired or replaced.

headline: No vomit and diarrhea procedure; missing signs
summary: No written procedure or adequate supplies to respond to vomit and diarrhea events; priority violation, must provide. Rear and toilet room handwash sinks lack signage. Front entrance door has a 1-inch gap at the bottom; must be made tight and rodent-proof.

headline: Repeat pest violation; flies in multiple areas
summary: Repeat pest violation not corrected: about 9 to 14 flies in Elaine's coffee area and 15 to 20 flies in J Parker dish area and both bars. Pest control company did not service the establishment; must eliminate all fly activity. Also: unlabeled bulk foods, missing light shields.

headline: Handwash sinks unusable; no certified manager at first
summary: Handwash sink in men's washroom ran at 161.6°F with cold water not working; maximum is 120°F. Kitchen handwash sink was leaking with water off. No certified food manager on premises at first; one arrived at 12:42 PM, corrected on site.

headline: Expired prepared foods discarded; no thermometer
summary: Prepared TCS foods, such as lentil soup and chicken alfredo, held over 24 hours without proper date labels; discarded, priority violation, citation issued. No metal stem thermometer on site. Packaged foods lacked business name, ingredients and allergen labels; held for inspection.

headline: Dead roaches under wok line; screen door gap
summary: Dead roaches, food debris and excess grease under the wok prep line and throughout the wok area; must clean. New rear screen door has a half-inch gap at the bottom; must add a tight rodent-proof strip. Also: no food handler training proof.

headline: Pizza cooler too warm; about 60 lbs discarded
summary: Cooked meats and cheese in the 4-door pizza prep cooler held at 47.6 to 50.3°F; about 60 lbs discarded (valued $250). Cooler air at 55°F; tagged and cannot be used until re-inspected. Also: no food handler proof, leaking 3-compartment faucet, wiping cloths on coolers.

headline: Large flies in facility; shellfish tag dates missing
summary: About 10 large flies found in the facility; must eliminate and clean affected areas, citation issued. Shellfish tags from April to June 2024 lacked the date the last shellfish was sold or served. Mold-like substance on ice machine shields; must clean.

headline: Damaged floor tiles; chipped paint; sink issues
summary: Missing and damaged floor tiles in rear prep and dish area and hallway; grout needed. Chipped paint on kitchen and sushi walls must be repainted. Third basin of dish sink does not hold water; leaking drain at rear beverage station sink; repairs instructed.

headline: Unlabeled containers; soda near restroom; debris
summary: Food storage containers without common-name labels must be labeled. Soda boxes on hallway shelving outside the toilet room must be moved away from the public. Excess food debris on grill table, walk-in shelving and floors; wet mops need a hanging system.

headline: Floors need detail cleaning; dusty vents
summary: Floors throughout need detail cleaning to remove debris, including along wall bases and under cooking equipment. Heating vents have dust build-up and must be cleaned and maintained.

headline: No handwashing signs; exposed sewage pipes
summary: No handwashing signage at hand sinks in food prep and dishwashing areas. Missing light shield on ceiling fixture in prep area. Repeat violation: exposed sewage pipes beside the three-compartment sink were not encased; citation issued.

headline: Repeat violations; gauges not working
summary: Raw wood under handsink behind the bar must be sealed or painted to be smooth and cleanable. Repeat core violations from 2023 not corrected, including dishwasher gauges for wash and rinse that were not working. Priority violation.

headline: Low water pressure at women's hand sinks
summary: Both hand sinks in the women's toilet room had low water pressure; manager instructed to repair.

headline: Label containers; elevate food; clean racks
summary: Food storage containers not in original packaging, such as squeeze bottles, must be labeled. Food stored on the floor of a kitchen storage closet must be elevated. Debris on dish racks and walk-in shelving must be cleaned.

headline: Missing handwashing signs; leaking sinks
summary: Two front handwashing stations had no handwashing signs; instructed to install. Leaks at the rear handwash sink drain pipe and at the two-compartment sink faucet base and drain; ordered repaired. Prep and storage floors need detail cleaning.

headline: Cold food held too warm; no vomit procedure
summary: About 20 lbs sausage burritos at 50 to 53°F, 3 lbs sliced ham at 52°F and 2 lbs raw bacon at 59°F held above the 41°F limit; discarded (about $42). Another cold unit read 56°F and was tagged. No vomit and diarrhea procedure; citation issued.

headline: Expired allergen training certificate
summary: An expired allergen training certificate was found for a certified food manager; must provide a current certificate for all certified managers.

headline: No certified manager; restroom trash lacks lid
summary: No person in charge with a valid sanitation certificate, and no certified manager on site, citation issued. Hand sinks in prep and dishwashing lacked waste receptacles. Repeat violation: employee washroom garbage can has no lid.

headline: Rat droppings outside; no certified manager present
summary: No person in charge on site until 2:30 PM; no certified manager while chicken and rice were served; citation issued. Over 20 rat droppings outside by the rear exit. Also: no food handler or allergen certificates on site; grease in fryers; no light in walk-in cooler.

headline: No certified manager; unapproved kimchi discarded
summary: No person in charge with a valid city sanitation certificate present; citation issued. 32 lbs of kimchi made on site without an approved variance was voluntarily discarded. Also: no metal stem thermometer, whisk in handwash sink (removed on site), leaking drain.

headline: No health policy or vomit and diarrhea plan
summary: No employee health policy or training on site; priority violation. No procedure or kit for vomit and diarrhea events; priority violation. Facility instructed to develop and maintain both, with verifiable documents on site.

headline: No proof of food handler or allergen training
summary: Blank copies of employee health policy on site; must keep signed copies for all food employees. No proof of food handler training for any food handler. No proof of allergen training for certified food managers; must maintain on site.

headline: No vomit supplies; sink backs up when drained
summary: No supplies on site for vomit and diarrhea cleanup, such as mop, gloves, mask, and norovirus-effective sanitizer; priority, citation issued. Water backs up into sink basins when drained; repair before re-inspection. Missing sink stoppers and handwash sign; unlabeled bulk ingredients.

headline: Wiping cloths not in sanitizer; dirty fryers
summary: Wiping cloths not stored in sanitizing solution when not in use; must meet required strength. Can opener with old food; cutting boards with deep grooves and stains; fryers with thick grease, dirt and food build-up. Must clean, sand or replace.

headline: Pink mold in ice machine; ice discarded
summary: Pink mold-like substance inside ice machine components used for ice; manager told to discard all ice, clean and sanitize the machine; priority, citation issued. Food residue inside cold-hold drawers; food debris on walk-in shelving; grease on hood filters.

headline: Restroom door and minor floor spills
summary: Men's restroom door must have a self-closing device. Minor food spills behind cooking equipment were to be cleaned.

headline: Unlabeled bulk containers and greasy hood filters
summary: Bulk rice and beans containers in dry storage lacked labels and dates. Dishwashing area floor had dirt along walls and corners, and the ventilation hood and filters had grease buildup that must be cleaned.

headline: Heavy sink leaks onto floor
summary: Two-compartment sink in main processing area was leaking heavily from both drains onto the floor. Basement one-compartment sink leaked from its sprayer base during use. Manager was told to repair both.

headline: Small flies in basement; hand sinks unusable
summary: About 20-30 small flies were seen throughout the basement. The basement hand sink was clogged, leaking, and inaccessible, and had no soap or paper towels. Food sat on floors in walk-in cooler and freezer; heavy grease in fryers.

headline: Six live roaches and 12+ flies found
summary: Six live roaches were found on prep tables, walls, and floors, and 12 or more live flies were in front and rear areas. Pest control is required; an ashtray also drew a smoking citation.

headline: Gaps at rear door, floor, and wall
summary: The rear exit door had a small gap at its bottom. Floor openings near the mop sink and a hole in the wall behind it must be sealed to keep pests out.

headline: Missing health policy; unprotected water inlet
summary: No employee health policy was provided, and no inspection summary was posted for the public. The water inlet lacked protection because its lock was broken. Floor holes near the serving window and sink lead outside and must be sealed.

headline: Torn cooler gasket and burnt-out hood lights
summary: Inspector noted a torn gasket inside a prep cooler, a non-working paper towel dispenser in the rear prep area, and two burnt-out light bulbs over the front line. Repairs were ordered.

headline: Rice held at 108°F; citation issued
summary: Cooked rice in a hot-holding unit measured 108°F. Hot food must stay at 135°F or above. The person in charge discarded 2 lbs of rice, and a citation was issued.

headline: Missing thermometers; no self-closing doors
summary: Working thermometers were needed inside all coolers and hot-holding units. Front dining exit door had worn weather stripping. Washroom doors lacked self-closing devices, walk-in cooler floors needed cleaning, and its light wasn't working.

headline: Flies found; cold food and coolers too warm
summary: Large numbers of house flies and fruit flies were in dishwashing and basement areas. Several cold foods measured 46.3–48.3°F, above the 41°F limit, and were discarded. Walk-in cooler (57.8°F) and reach-in cooler (52.8°F) were tagged out.

headline: 65 rodent droppings found; no certified manager
summary: About 65 large rodent droppings were scattered on the basement storage floor, and a citation was issued. No certified food manager was on site while chicken, cole slaw, and fish were prepared. New employees lacked food handler certificates.

headline: Wall opening, rusty tables, missing signage
summary: A large opening in the basement wall behind the ice machine must be sealed. Also needed: handwashing signs, repaired leaking faucet and cracked floor tiles, rust removal, and grease cleaning under cooking equipment. Dust covers vents throughout.

headline: Leaks and debris around outdoor compactor
summary: Water leaked under a hand sink in the meat prep cooler and at a faucet base in the produce prep cooler; repairs are required. Debris and spillage outside the compactor and floor debris in prep areas also need cleaning.

headline: Torn cooler gaskets on cook line
summary: The two-door cooler on the cook line has torn rubber door gaskets that must be replaced.

headline: Missing food handler proof; leaking grease trap
summary: No proof of food handler training was shown for any food handler. A rear grease trap leaked from a broken base and lacked a lid. Milk crates served as shelving, sink stoppers were missing, and floor tiles were damaged.

headline: Trapped German roaches; food on floor; leaks
summary: Pest monitor traps in the basement prep and storage area caught German roaches. Dry rice and bean bags sat on the floor in the rear prep area. Also: unlabeled flour and sugar, and a leaking hand sink.

headline: Door gaps, missing hair restraints, leaky faucets
summary: Gaps of about 1/4 inch under the overhead and entrance doors could let pests in. Food handlers lacked hair restraints. Leaking faucets, damaged floor tiles, missing ceiling tiles, and dust and debris were also noted.

headline: Side door gap; uncovered restroom bins
summary: The side entrance door has a 2-inch gap at the bottom and must be made tight-fitting to keep pests out. Female restrooms need covered receptacles.

headline: No allergen training certificates on site
summary: No allergen training certificates were provided. Each certified food manager must hold one. The result was a pass.

headline: No certified food manager on site
summary: No certified food manager was on site while chicken and fish were prepared and served, and a citation was issued. Water dripped from a pipe below a rear dry-storage hand sink and must be repaired.

headline: Manager lacks allergen training proof
summary: The manager on duty had no proof of allergen training. The inspector required allergen training for all city food service managers.

headline: No food handler certificates on premises
summary: No food handler certificates were provided on the premises. Management was told all food handlers must show proof of training.

headline: Dressings too warm; prep cooler tagged out
summary: Caesar, Greek yogurt, and ranch dressings were held at 53.4–55.8°F, above the 41°F safe limit, and about 5 lbs were discarded. The prep cooler (54.7°F air) was tagged and may not be used until repaired.

headline: Sink water backing up; uncorrected core violations
summary: Water backed up between sink basins when one drained, and a citation was issued. Blender could not be submerged; the operator created a cleaning procedure. Repeat violations include a slow hand sink, greasy floors, and loose wall panels exposing studs.

headline: Untrained food workers; repeat allergen training violation
summary: Two food workers lacked food handler training, and managers still lack allergen training (repeat violation, citation issued). Also black slime inside the ice machine and no thermometer in a cooler.

headline: Rodent droppings found; handwash water too cool
summary: About 30–40 rodent droppings and fur were on the rear basement floor, and a citation was issued. Handwashing sinks in the kitchen and two washrooms measured 75–88°F; they must reach at least 100°F.

headline: Missing handwashing signs and a thermometer
summary: Required handwashing signs were missing, and the tall meat cooler needs a working thermometer. Also: stored items sit on the basement floor, a rusty prep table bottom, peeling paint, wall holes, and dusty light covers.

headline: Unlabeled bulk containers; food spills and debris
summary: Bulk containers in basement storage lacked labels, and an ice machine had residue inside. Food spills and debris were on cooking equipment, prep tables, coolers, and sinks. Missing ceiling tiles also noted.

headline: Over 10 live roaches and rat droppings found
summary: Over 10 live roaches were in the dish area, where rat droppings had been found earlier. Pest control treatment is required, and a citation was issued. Food was also stored on the floor and in grocery bags.

headline: Manager absent at first; cold food too warm
summary: No certified manager was present until 11:44 AM; this was corrected on site. Cold foods containing milk, held at 57.4–63°F, were discarded (about 5 lbs). A two-door display cooler at 66.6°F was tagged out. Drains also need cleaning.

headline: Missing health policy and cleanup procedure
summary: No employee health policy was on site, and management could not show a vomiting and diarrhea cleanup procedure. No citations were issued for these. Also needed: a self-closing restroom door device and allergen training for certified managers.

headline: Dish machine not sanitizing; no valid certificate
summary: Dish machine sanitized at 0 ppm (parts per million) chlorine and was tagged out until repaired. No valid city sanitation certificate was on site, and sanitizer test strips were unavailable. Repeat violations include floor debris and missing allergen training.

headline: Beard restraint needed; broken counter tiles
summary: A food handler lacked a beard restraint and must wear one. Broken tiles on a prep area countertop must be repaired to be smooth and cleanable.

headline: Droppings found; one washroom out of order
summary: Droppings were observed on the floor in areas that need cleaning. One of two washrooms was out of service due to a broken toilet, and the mop sink was clogged. The men's washroom door lacks a self-closing device.

headline: Worn cutting board; moldy cooler rack
summary: A small bar-area cutting board had deep grooves and dark markings and must be replaced. A cooler wire rack had mold-like buildup. The certified manager lacked allergen training.

headline: Dead roaches, dripping freezer, wastewater backup
summary: Dead roaches were found on floors. Freezer condensation dripped on food; the manager discarded 4 lbs of product. Wastewater backed up into sinks and floor drains; it was rerouted and the grease trap cleaned. Floors and walls were dirty.

headline: Missing hair restraints and ashtrays; smoking citation
summary: No pests found, but the rear door screen was damaged. Food handlers lacked hair restraints, and soiled wiping cloths sat on a prep table. Ashtrays with cigarette butts were in seating areas; a smoking citation was issued.

headline: Stained cutting boards; greasy drains and walls
summary: Cutting boards had open seams and dark stains and must be refinished or replaced. Grease and debris were in drains under sinks. Food splatter and dust covered walls, ceiling tiles were stained, and vent fans were dusty.

headline: No certified manager; handwash sink blocked
summary: No certified manager was on site from 10:35 to 11:00 AM during chicken tamale prep. No verifiable employee health policy was on site, and an exposed hand sink was blocked by a container. No paper towels were at that sink.

headline: Cleaning needed in coolers and floors
summary: The reach-in cooler, cutting boards, and walk-in shelving need debris removed. Floors around heavy equipment need cleaning of debris and spills.

headline: Expired food handler certificate; some rust found
summary: One employee's food handler certificate had expired; updated proof was requested. Scoop storage was corrected on site. Also noted: rusty can opener and walk-in shelving, dirty floor drains, unlabeled bulk foods, and personal items in prep areas.

headline: Leaks, rusty racks, and greasy hood
summary: Storage racks in the walk-in cooler were rusty. A pipe under the front hand sink leaked. Floors near the grease trap and a ventilation hood with stains and dirt also need cleaning.

headline: Dish machine not sanitizing; unit held
summary: The low-temperature dish machine sanitized at 0 ppm chlorine and was tagged and held; it may not be used until repaired. Also: unlabeled containers, grease in fryers and refrigeration units, dirty floors, and a manager lacking allergen training.

headline: Soda on floor; basement clutter; food splatter
summary: A large amount of soda sat on the floor near the ice machine, and basement clutter needs to be removed or raised six inches off the floor. Food splatter near the deep fryers must be cleaned.

headline: 80+ mouse droppings and a dead mouse found
summary: Approximately 80 or more mouse droppings were on shelves and floors in several aisles and the men's restroom, and a dead mouse was found. Front doors have gaps, and one outdoor garbage bin is missing its lid. Citations issued.

headline: Black slime in ice machine; citation issued
summary: Black slime was dripping onto ice for consumption from the basement ice machine, and must be cleaned and sanitized. Repeat violations: no light in the mop sink and linen closet, and no allergen training for certificate holders.

headline: Brownish residue in ice machine; cracked tiles
summary: A brownish substance was seen inside the ice machine by the ice slot and must be cleaned and sanitized. The women's restroom waste receptacle lacked a fully enclosed cover, and some floor tiles were cracked.

headline: Ice machine lining and torn cooler gasket
summary: Inspector asked for plastic lining on the ice machine's exterior to be removed so surfaces are smooth and cleanable, and a torn cooler door gasket to be replaced.

headline: No pests found; door seal and floor issues
summary: No pests found, but the rear door seal is broken and gaps near a sink and floor openings could let pests in. Lemongrass bags were on the floor, and the walk-in cooler had dirt buildup.

headline: Hair restraint lapses; missing training documents
summary: Some food handlers did not restrain hair properly. A leak under the rear three-compartment sink must be repaired, and floors had grease and food buildup. The manager lacked allergen training proof; a state food handler approval letter was missing.

headline: About 50 live flying insects found; citation issued
summary: Approximately 50 live small flying insects were seen on walls, stock boxes, in food prep and dish areas, and in customer washrooms. This repeat pest violation led to a citation; more pest control service is needed.

headline: Live mouse and 10 droppings found
summary: Evidence of rodents persisted: 10 droppings were under the front ice cream freezer, and a live mouse was at the front of the facility. Pest control service is required. A rear service sink is blocked by new equipment and must be made accessible.

headline: No certified manager on duty; cooler too warm
summary: No valid certified manager was on duty while chicken and deli meats were prepared. The front prep hand sink had no hot water (61.1°F; 100°F required). The prep cooler was 48.2°F and tagged until it reaches 41°F or below.

headline: No person in charge; cold foods too warm
summary: No person in charge or certified manager was present during food prep; a citation was issued. Guacamole (47.3°F) and cut lettuce (45.6°F) were too warm; 28 lbs were discarded. Packaged food was left thawing on the prep table.

headline: Live flies found; utensils not sanitized
summary: About 15 or more live small flies were around the mop sink and rear prep, and flies crawled on damaged onions. An employee sanitized utensils at 0.0 ppm chlorine, and the 3-compartment sink was in poor repair.

headline: Pork and shrimp too warm; citation issued
summary: Pork (46.5°F) and shrimp (47°F) were held too warm in the prep cooler. About 7 lbs were discarded. Some food was stored on floors and uncovered. Holes, cracked floors, and exposed caulk need repair.

headline: Front door gap; unlocked public freezers
summary: The front revolving door has a 1-inch gap and torn rodent strips that need a tight seal. Ice cream freezers in the hallway were unlocked, allowing public access. Missing baseboard coving and damaged washroom ceiling also need repair.

headline: 15+ live roaches and 30+ mouse droppings found
summary: About 15 or more live roaches were on wheel bases, cabinets, coolers, and floors. About 30 or more mouse droppings were on a steam table and dry storage shelves. No probe thermometer was available for food temperatures. Citation issued.

headline: Front door gap and missing covered bin
summary: A 1/4-inch gap in the middle of the front entrance door must be sealed to keep pests out. The women's employee and public restroom also needs a covered receptacle.

headline: Employee ate food on dish rack; floor holes
summary: An employee ate food on the cook line dish rack and was told to eat only in a designated area. Holes in the bathroom floor and lobby were sealed with duct tape and must get proper floor covering.

headline: Basement dough area needs food prep sink
summary: The basement dough-making station has only a hand sink. A food preparation sink is required there.

headline: Leaking drainpipe; floor debris; soiled cloths
summary: Soiled wiping cloths sat on prep tables and single-use articles were stored on the floor. Food debris and spills were on equipment, coolers, and freezers; a rear hand sink's drainpipe was leaking. Two certified managers lacked allergen training.

headline: Fish and oatmeal too warm; citation issued
summary: Five pounds each of fish and cooked oatmeal were held at 46.2–50°F in the walk-in cooler; 10 lbs were discarded ($100). Cold food must stay at 41°F or below. Some dry storage containers were unlabeled.

headline: Missing thermometers; leaks and worn cutting boards
summary: Reach-in coolers lacked thermometers. Leaks were found at the large ice machine and at hand sinks in fish and meat areas. Also noted: ice machine buildup, worn bakery sponges, and cutting boards needing replacement.

headline: Missing handwashing signs and hair restraints
summary: Several hand sinks lacked handwashing signs, and several food handlers lacked effective hair restraints. Rear screen door had a 2-inch gap at the bottom. Also: no written procedure for oversized pots, rusty prep tables, and dirty floors.

headline: Ground pork too warm; cutting boards worn
summary: Ground pork measured 46.9°F, above the 41°F limit. Manager discarded about 8 lbs ($20), and a citation was issued. Rear prep cutting boards had open seams and dark stains and must be replaced or refinished.

headline: Drinks in prep area; belongings stored with food
summary: An employee was drinking coffee at the front prep area, and personal belongings were on shelves with food in basement dry storage. Plates were not stored inverted, a cooler gasket was torn, and a basement sink faucet leaked.

headline: Person in charge lacks certified manager certificate
summary: The person in charge did not hold a City of Chicago certified food manager (CFM) certificate and was told to obtain one. The rear light also lacked a shield. No citation was issued.

headline: Cracked tiles, peeling paint, and grimy floors
summary: Cracked floor tiles near hot-holding equipment and peeling paint in the women's restroom need repair. Dry storage floor grime around cold-holding units must be cleaned.

headline: Wet mop stored in bucket
summary: A wet mop was stored in a bucket in the hallway to the basement. Inspector instructed the operator to provide mop hooks so mops can dry.

headline: Undercooked food not marked on menu
summary: Animal-based foods served undercooked or cooked to order lacked asterisks, and the menu lacked the required disclosure; no citation was issued. Openings at entrance and exit doors must be sealed, and a utility sink needs a backflow device.

headline: Leaking drain pipe; rusted can opener blade
summary: A drainpipe under the three-compartment sink was leaking and must be repaired. A can opener had a rusted blade to replace. Loose debris and dust were on floors and corners throughout, needing detail cleaning.

headline: Hot-holding cabinet at 110°F; unit tagged
summary: The hot-holding cabinet measured 110°F, below the required 135°F for hot food. The unit was tagged, and no food was in it. No citation was issued.

headline: Cups not air-dried; personal items in food areas
summary: Deli cups were not air-dried after washing; the inspector required air drying for all multi-use utensils. Employee medicine and clothing were stored in food prep and storage areas and must be kept in a designated area.

headline: Taped faucet leaks; repeat cleaning violations
summary: A three-compartment sink faucet in the deli and meat area leaked and was taped; it must be properly repaired. Earlier cleaning violations were not fixed: litter under holding units and greasy hood filters. Freezer floor and deli cabinets need work.

headline: Missing front hand sink; ice machine lacks backflow
summary: A handwashing sink was needed in the front food area and must have soap, towels, and signs. The ice machine lacked a backflow device, and a rear dish-area hand sink drain leaked. No citations were issued.

headline: Dead roaches; no food handler training
summary: Numerous dead roaches were on glue boards in prep and sales areas. No food handler training was available, and the hood over fryers was not working. Also: leaking 3-compartment sink, debris, raw wood surfaces, and damaged floor tiles.

headline: About 50 live cockroaches found; citation issued
summary: About 50 live cockroaches were on walls behind refrigeration units, with more in the wok area and dishwasher. This repeat pest violation led to a citation, and additional pest control service is needed. Also: greasy cooking equipment and cluttered storage.

headline: Rodent droppings found; no certified manager
summary: About 28 small rodent droppings were in the rear prep area under sinks, near the bait box, and under heavy equipment. The rear exit door was not rodent-proof. No certified manager was on site; restroom sink water was 46°F.

headline: Slime dripping onto ice; citation issued
summary: A rear ice machine had thick white and black slime dripping onto ice meant for human consumption. The ice was to be removed, and the machine cleaned and sanitized. A citation was issued. West exit door gap needs a door sweep.

headline: Flies found; no certified manager on site
summary: About 30 small flies were noted, including 15 on a dry storage wall and 15 in rear prep. No original certificate or certified manager was present during food prep. A hand sink was used for storing water.

headline: Dead insects in light covers; mold-like buildup
summary: Dead insects were in light shields above the rear dish and storage area. Walk-in cooler walls had mold-like buildup, and storage racks had dried food and grease. A certified food manager lacked allergen training.

headline: No soap, paper towels, or thermometer on site
summary: The hand sink had no soap or paper towels, and no stem thermometer was on site. No pest control logbook or service proof was shown. A basement hand sink leaked at its trap, and an allergen certificate was needed.

headline: Restroom handwash water too hot; dumpster overflowing
summary: Hot water at restroom hand sinks measured 122.2–125.3°F, above the 100–120°F range required. No paper towels were at a rear hand sink. The outdoor dumpster overflowed with trash, and trash bags sat on the ground.

headline: No hand soap; no food handler certificates
summary: The prep and dishwashing hand sink had no soap, and a citation was issued. No food handler certificates were on site. A food service sanitation manager lacked allergen training.

headline: Dirty counters, shelves, floors, and walls
summary: Counters and shelving in prep and storage areas had food debris, and floors and walls in prep, dish, and storage areas had soil buildup. Manager was told to clean.

headline: Utensil rack near open drain
summary: A clean utensil rack was placed next to an open drain, where splashing could contaminate it. Inspector told staff to add a barrier or move the rack.

headline: Food in grocery bags; greasy hood
summary: Food was stored inside grocery bags in coolers, refrigeration units, and freezers. Unfinished wood shelving was noted, and oversized pots did not fit the dish machine. Heavy dirt and grease covered the exhaust hood and filters.

headline: About 50 mouse droppings found; citation issued
summary: About 50 mouse droppings were on the food prep floor, under a drink cooler, on a pallet, and on heating and cooling unit surfaces. Pest control service is needed. Also noted: grease under the fryer, wall gaps, and hood grease.

headline: Unused broken cooler; two burnt-out bulbs
summary: An unused, nonfunctional two-door cooler sits next to the fryers and must be removed or repaired. Two ceiling bulbs in the rear prep area are burnt out and need replacing.

headline: Torn cooler gaskets, slow sink, greasy floors
summary: Two-door prep cooler at cook line had torn gaskets. A hand sink drained slowly. Spilled food and grease built up under cooking equipment and along kitchen wall bases; a detailed floor cleaning was ordered.

headline: Pest log outdated; summary not posted
summary: The pest control logbook was outdated; its last pest inspection was March 14, 2022, and at least two yearly reports are required. The previous inspection summary was not posted, and a citation was issued. A storage closet bulb is burnt out.

headline: Walk-in freezer floor full of trash
summary: The walk-in freezer floor below the standing shelves was full of trash, loose food debris, and plastic pieces. The manager was told to clean it and keep it free of trash.

headline: Missing handwashing signs; debris in corners
summary: Handwashing signs were missing at bar and west washroom sinks. Debris was along floors, walls, and corners in the basement, bar, and storage areas and must be cleaned.

headline: Food on floors; worn gaskets; missing backflow
summary: Food was stored on walk-in cooler and freezer floors, and knives were stored between walls and pipes. Worn door gaskets and a basement ice machine without a backflow device need repair. Front doors have gaps.

headline: No handwashing signs; dirty coolers and freezers
summary: Handwashing signs were missing at hand sinks. Interiors of coolers, freezers, and exhaust hood vents were not clean and must be cleaned.

headline: No food handler or allergen training provided
summary: No food handler training was provided, and no allergen training for managers. Doors have gaps at the bottom, food is stored on the walk-in floor, and the ice machine lacks a backflow device. A kids' meal drink exceeded 130 calories.

headline: Spillage in cold unit and cooler floor
summary: A cold-hold unit where coffee is stored had spillage buildup, and the walk-in cooler floor under shelving had residue. The person in charge was told to clean both areas.

headline: Greasy floors, dirty oven, clutter
summary: Shelving under basement prep tables had dried stains and food debris, and the oven interior had burnt residue. Floors under cooking equipment had grease, and basement floors had rice and debris. Clutter under stairs and in basement needs removal.

headline: Passed; food on floor and reused metal cans
summary: Passed. Food was on the walk-in cooler and freezer floors and must be raised 6 inches. Metal cans were reused for other foods, and cardboard and foil lined shelves. A toilet room door is not self-closing.

headline: Failed: three live roaches in prep area cooler
summary: Failed. Three live roaches were found inside an unused reach-in cooler in the prep area. The manager must remove all roach activity by reinspection, and pest control service was advised. A rear prep hand sink hot water valve leaks.

headline: Re-inspection passed; no cooler thermometer
summary: Passed re-inspection. The one-door sandwich prep cooler had no working thermometer. The management must provide one.

headline: Failed: menu lacks raw-food consumer advisory
summary: Failed. The menu lacked a consumer advisory reminder about raw or undercooked foods, a priority violation with no citation. A kitchen cooler's shelving has coating chipping off and must be repainted or replaced.

headline: Failed: over 20 flies and warm fried chicken
summary: Failed. Over 20 large flies were found throughout the facility, with no pest control log on site. Fried chicken held at 69.6-78.4°F was discarded and corrected on site. No health policy, metal thermometer, or food handler training proof.

headline: Cold foods held too warm; 40 lb discarded
summary: Complaint, passed with conditions. Eggs, cheese and sausages in the front prep cold-holding unit measured 46.2-48.8°F; the manager discarded 40 lb ($150) and a priority citation was issued. A prep cooler at 51.1°F is tagged out until reinspected.

headline: Passed; dish machine leak and sensor faults
summary: Passed. A minor leak at the bottom of the main dish machine must be repaired. Two hand sinks in an all-gender washroom have non-working automatic sensors and must be repaired.

headline: Failed: about 25 live flying insects in prep areas
summary: Failed. About 25 live small flying insects were on walls and ceilings of the first-floor prep area, bar and lower-level kitchen; further pest control is needed. No written employee health policy was on premises, and a citation was issued.

headline: Soups and beef not date-marked after 24 hours
summary: Complaint, passed with conditions. Soups and beef held over 24 hours in a kitchen cooler were not date marked; a priority citation was issued. Also: food stored on floor, a manager without a hair restraint, and deeply grooved cutting boards.

headline: Passed; screen door and leaking pipes
summary: Passed. The exterior screen door is in poor repair and must be fully sealed. A leaky pipe under the three-compartment sink and a taped leak at the mop sink faucet must be repaired.

headline: Ice stored in melted water; summary not posted
summary: Passed with conditions. Ice for drinks sat in melted water in undrained bins. The inspection summary was not posted, and a priority citation was issued. Several hand sinks leak or are soiled, and restroom doors and trash lids need fixing.

headline: Passed; items stored on floor near restroom
summary: Passed. Items were stored on the floor in the rear area near the restroom and utility closet. Staff must keep all items at least 6 inches off the floor.

headline: No certified manager; manager arrived 9:50 AM
summary: Failed. No city-certified food sanitation manager was on site while pork was prepared and served to the public. The manager arrived at 9:50 AM and a priority citation was issued. Also: raw wood at the utility sink and an employee without a food handler certificate.

headline: Failed: repeat grease and debris violations uncorrected
summary: Failed. Some prep-area bulk containers lacked labels. Previous core violations from March 2025 were not corrected: grease on cooking equipment and walls, food debris and spills on floors, and chipped kitchen wall paint. A priority citation was issued.

headline: Food stored under sewer lines; floor clutter
summary: Passed. Food and storage bins in both basements sat beneath unshielded sewer and wastewater lines; they must be shielded or moved. Bins and cans on basement floors must be raised 6 inches. A walk-in shelf is corroded and flaking.

headline: Passed; cardboard, foil and pallets used as storage
summary: Passed. Cardboard and foil lined shelves and counters, and wooden pallets and milk crates were used in walk-in coolers and freezer. Peeling wallpaper behind a fish-prep hand sink must be removed to prevent insect harborage.

headline: Re-inspection passed; milk crates, broken tile
summary: Passed re-inspection. Milk crates are used to elevate stored items and must stop; floors must stay accessible for cleaning. A broken floor tile under the kitchen hand sink must be replaced.

headline: Passed; unlabeled containers and cardboard matting
summary: Passed. Food bottles and containers must be labeled with common names once removed from original packaging. Plastic bags and cardboard boxes may not be used as food containers in freezers, and cardboard may not be used as floor matting.

headline: Cold prep cooler at 61.6°F tagged; food discarded
summary: Passed with conditions. Foods in a prep cooler measured 46.6-53.4°F, and about 10 lb ($67) was discarded. A front prep cooler at 61.6°F is tagged and cannot be used until reinspected. The hot-holding unit lacks a thermometer.

headline: Missing handwashing signs and thermometer
summary: Passed. Handwashing signage is missing at kitchen and rear bar sinks, and the main bar refrigerator lacks a thermometer. Basement clutter must be removed, and second-basement lighting is inadequate.

headline: Passed; low hot water pressure at dish sink
summary: Passed. Low hot water pressure was noted at the dish area hand sink. The person in charge was instructed to restore adequate pressure.

headline: Cold food held too warm; cooler tagged out
summary: Failed. Coleslaw was cooled improperly and found at 48.5°F. Cold-held coleslaw and sauces at 48.9°F were discarded. A prep cooler at 51°F was tagged out until the Chicago Department of Public Health reinspects it.

headline: No certified manager during food service
summary: Failed. The person in charge lacked a sanitation certificate, and no certified food manager was on site while beef, chicken and goat were served; a priority citation was issued. Prior violations include food on floor, dusty floors, clutter, and allergen training gaps.

headline: Greasy floors under deep fryers; resurfacing needed
summary: Passed. Floors under the deep fryers were greasy and need cleaning. The floor surface there is not smooth or easily cleanable and must be resurfaced.

headline: Failed; no temperature indicator for dish machine
summary: Failed. The high-temperature dish machine lacked a required irreversible temperature indicator; a priority citation was issued. Dust and debris were found on walk-in cooler storage racks.

headline: Passed; ice machine needs cleaning
summary: Passed. The ice machine was not clean, with a slight yellow substance on the top interior surface. Staff must remove ice, clean and sanitize the unit.

headline: Failed: mouse droppings in two areas
summary: Failed. Over 20 mouse droppings were found in each of two areas, a priority citation issued. A hole over 1/4 inch sits beside the rear exit door. Also: food stored on the walk-in floor and no walk-in thermometer.

headline: Passed; mineral build-up in ice machine
summary: Passed. Ice machine compartments had early mineral build-up; the ice is used for drinks. Cutting boards had dark stains and deep cuts, cardboard lined shelving, and no food handler training certificate was on site.

headline: Passed; missing signs, thermometers and labels
summary: Passed. The dishwashing area hand sink lacks handwashing signage. Cold-holding units lack ambient air thermometers, and food containers in dishwashing lack labels. Floors need cleaning, and openings at the cooking equipment wall base must be sealed.

headline: 620 lb of cold food discarded; walk-in too warm
summary: Passed with conditions. Multiple cold-held foods in the walk-in cooler measured 45.6-49.8°F. The manager voluntarily discarded 620 lb ($7,400). The rear walk-in reads 50°F and must not be used until it holds 41°F or below.

headline: Passed re-inspection; ice bin and freezer debris
summary: Passed re-inspection. The ice bin needs cleaning. Food was stored uncovered in the walk-in freezer and prep area, and wet wiping cloths sat on prep surfaces. Reach-in units had excess ice and debris, and greasy floors need detail cleaning.

headline: Passed; floors not clean at produce packaging
summary: Passed. Floors at produce packaging areas were not clean and must be cleaned.

headline: Re-inspection passed; upkeep repairs needed
summary: Passed re-inspection. No pests were noted. Issues: a rear exit door gap of about 1/4 inch, debris on the rear restroom floor, damaged walls, and a non-working restroom vent and light.

headline: Failed: mouse droppings and ice machine residue
summary: Failed re-inspection. About 20-25 mouse droppings were on the floor near dough proofers, a priority citation. Black and pink residue was found in the ice machine, also cited. Other items include unlabeled containers and an unsealed wall opening.

headline: No certified manager; hand sink blocked by utensils
summary: Passed with conditions. No certified food manager was on site while chicken, beef and rice were prepared; a priority citation was issued. The kitchen hand sink was blocked by bowls and spoons. Also: no allergen training, rusty freezer racks, dirty floors.

headline: Passed; ice machine and cabinets need cleaning
summary: Passed. The ice machine interior needs cleaning to remove build-up. Wiping cloths must be kept in sanitizing solution when not in use. Cabinet interiors and floors also need cleaning.

headline: Passed; food spills and debris throughout
summary: Passed. Food spills and debris were found on coolers, freezers, cooking equipment and shelving, and on floors under equipment and along walls. No food handler training was provided; the manager must provide it.

headline: Improper thawing and food stored on floor
summary: Re-inspection passed. Frozen shrimp was thawed improperly from a floor bin, and raw pork was thawed in a mop sink. Food was stored on the walk-in floor, thermometers were missing, and grease was in hood crevices.

headline: Passed; rust, leak, and expired allergen certificate
summary: Passed. Rear walk-in racks are rusty, the reach-in freezer interior is stained, and a P-trap leaks under the front hand sink. A water-stained ceiling tile above the walk-in must be replaced. The certified food manager's allergen certificate expired.

headline: Passed; greasy fryers and dirty hood vents
summary: Passed. Fryers had grease build-up, and the large can opener needs detail cleaning. Floors had food spills, a tile is missing, and the hood and pizza-oven vents need cleaning.

headline: No certified manager; dead roaches found
summary: Complaint, passed with conditions. No valid certified food manager was on site while chicken was served; a priority citation was issued. Several dead roaches were found throughout. A slow hand sink and missing food handler certificates were also noted.

headline: Passed; food on floor and unlabeled containers
summary: Passed. Food buckets were stored on the walk-in cooler floor, and some containers lacked labels. Also noted: no training for new food handlers, cardboard and crates used as shelving, worn cutting boards, and greasy surfaces.

headline: Passed; dust above dish machine cleaned on site
summary: Passed. Light dust on ceiling tiles and light shields above the high-temperature dish machine was removed on site. Vents above cooking equipment in the farmstand area need cleaning.

headline: Failed: over 40 mouse droppings in storage
summary: Failed. Over 40 mouse droppings were along walls and in corners of both storage areas, a priority citation. Also: no raw-food consumer advisory on the menu, a worker without a hair restraint, and ceramic cups needing lead-safety documentation.

headline: Hand sink water too cool; fixed on site
summary: Passed with conditions. The pizza station hand sink delivered 90.5°F water, below the 100°F minimum. It was repaired on site to 107.6°F, and a priority citation was issued. Also: unlabeled flour, no splash guards, and a leaking condenser.

headline: Milk crates as shelving; leaking dish machine
summary: Passed. Milk crates are used as shelving and must be replaced with shelving 6 inches off the floor. The pot-and-pan dish machine leaks heavily. Chipped ceiling paint, with a mold-like substance in a chemical storage dishroom.

headline: Failed: rat droppings; no certified manager
summary: Failed. About 10 rat droppings were near the storage rear exit, and more pest control is needed. No certified manager was on duty while foods that must be kept hot or cold were served. Deli meat lacked date marks and was discarded.

headline: Burgers held above safe cold temperature; discarded
summary: Passed with conditions. Raw burgers were held at 45.7-48.7°F, above the 41°F limit. About 14 lb ($128) was voluntarily discarded, and a priority citation was issued. Also: missing handwashing signs, rusty shelving, leaking faucet base, dirty ice machines.

headline: Failed; black mold-like substance in ice machine
summary: Failed. A panel inside the ice machine that touches ice had a black mold-like substance; ice is used for drinks. A priority citation was issued. Also: a basement ceiling hole to seal and missing wall base under the dish machine.

headline: General upkeep issues; no food-safety problems noted
summary: Passed. Inspector cited only upkeep: greasy fryers and grill, dirty refrigerator interiors, rust under prep tables, an uncovered washroom ventilation fan, and dirty hood vents.

headline: Passed; open dining windows lack screens
summary: Passed. No handwashing signs were in toilet rooms. Customer dining room windows were open without screens; the business must add screens or keep windows closed to keep pests out. No pests were noted.

headline: Re-inspection passed; entrance door gap
summary: Passed re-inspection. A 1/2-inch opening under the revolving entrance door must be closed so the door is rodent-proof. No pests were noted.

headline: High-temp dish machine tagged; sanitizing too cool
summary: Passed with conditions. The high-temperature dish machine sanitized at 128.6°F, so it was tagged and is not to be used until repaired and retested. Missing splash guards, a leaking condenser, and washrooms without some water pressure or ventilation.

headline: Blocked hand sink, no paper towels; dirty floors
summary: Passed with conditions. The front prep hand sink lacked paper towels and was blocked by a trash can; a priority citation was issued. Bulk food was stored on the walk-in floor, cutting boards were scratched, and floors need detail cleaning.

headline: High-temp dish machine malfunctioning; tagged out
summary: Passed with conditions. The high-temperature dish machine was malfunctioning and tagged; it must not be used until repaired. A 1/4-inch gap at the bottom of the rear exit door must be closed to prevent pest entry.

headline: Failed: pink build-up in ice machine
summary: Failed. Slight pink build-up was found in the upper ice machine and must be cleaned. Grease on the ventilation hood must be removed. Previous violations for hair restraints and basement clutter must be corrected by reinspection.

headline: Unlabeled flour; scoops in containers; training gaps
summary: Complaint, passed. Dry flour was kept out of its package in unlabeled containers, and scoops were stored inside containers. Large mixing bowls are too big for the three-compartment sink. Food handlers lacked training proof, and a manager lacked allergen training.

headline: Passed; wet mops stored in buckets
summary: Complaint, passed. Wet mops were stored in buckets in the rear kitchen entrance utility area. Staff must hang mops to dry when not in use.

headline: No valid certified manager during chicken service
summary: Passed with conditions. The person in charge lacked a valid sanitation manager certificate, and no certified manager was on site while chicken and beans were served; a priority citation was issued. A bulk container of dried peppers was unlabeled.

headline: Passed; unlabeled bulk containers; rear door gap
summary: Passed. Bulk containers in the rear lacked labels. A gap at the bottom corner of the rear exit door must be sealed to prevent pests. Stained cutting boards, a loose women's washroom faucet, and dusty ceiling vents also need attention.

headline: Passed; leaking proofer creates slip hazard
summary: Passed. A bread proofer leaked over and standing water collected, creating a slip hazard. The machine must be fixed or replaced. The floor drain at the three-compartment sink and walk-in cooler floor also need detail cleaning.

headline: Re-inspection passed; ice machine debris, rusty racks
summary: Passed re-inspection. Debris was encrusted inside the rear ice machine and must be removed. Chipped paint and rust on walk-in racks, stained cutting boards, broken floor tiles, and a certified food manager without allergen training were also noted.

headline: Passed; items not inverted; no sink waste bins
summary: Passed. Single-service items were not inverted in the front prep area. No waste receptacles were available at hand sinks; the manager must provide them where waste is commonly discarded.

headline: Failed: 100+ mouse droppings and dead mouse
summary: Failed. Over 100 mouse droppings and a dead mouse were found; pest service was recommended and a citation issued. No certified food manager was on duty during food service. Foods held at unsafe temperatures were discarded.

headline: Passed; fly strips hanging in kitchen
summary: Passed. Several fly strips were hanging in the prep area and kitchen and must be removed. Also: greasy fryer interiors, mops stored inside the utility sink, and heavy floor grime behind and under cooking equipment.

headline: Greasy cooking equipment; cutting board needed
summary: Complaint, passed. Cooking equipment, reach-in coolers, hot-holding units, chicken fryer walls and hood vents need detail cleaning. A new cutting board is needed at the pizza station, and the large can opener needs cleaning.

headline: Re-inspection passed; cutting board, gaskets, rust
summary: Passed re-inspection. Noted a stained cutting board on the deli cooler, three torn door gaskets on main prep coolers, and chipped paint and rust on wire racks in the basement walk-in. Repairs were ordered.

headline: Passed; customers can reach cooler storage
summary: Passed. The cooler storage area is accessible to customers, so a lock or barrier is required. Fryer cabinets had food debris and grime, and both restroom door closers were not working.

headline: Bar sinks lacked soap and paper towels
summary: Passed with conditions. Bar hand sinks lacked soap and paper towels, a priority citation. Also: unlabeled bulk food in the basement, an ice scoop stored inside ice, a slimy substance in the soda dispenser, and dirty floors near the dish area.

headline: Re-inspection passed; no food handler training available
summary: Passed re-inspection. No food handler training was available; all food-handling employees must complete it. Also: no handwashing signs, no splash guard between sinks, and no covered trash in unisex washrooms.

headline: Passed; unshielded overhead pipes; dirty floors
summary: Passed. Overhead waste pipes above basement dry storage were not shielded and must be encased. Food debris was on prep table exteriors, and dirt built up under the three-compartment sink and shelving.

headline: Failed: no chemical or temperature test kits
summary: Failed. No chemical test kit was on site for the quat sanitizer in the three-compartment sink, and no test strips were on site for the high-temperature dish machine. Both are priority violations and a citation was issued.

headline: Failed; black slime found in ice machine
summary: Failed. Black slime was on ice-contact surfaces and dripping into ice used for drinks. A priority citation was issued and cleaning ordered. Also: no food handler training proof, basement clutter, and a wall hole to seal.

headline: Passed; grease and grime on equipment and floors
summary: Passed. Cooking and non-cooking equipment had dirt, grease and food debris, which inspector ordered cleaned to prevent possible pest or insect feeding. Front bar floors and drains were grimy, and floors under deep fryers had heavy grease.

headline: Passed; unlabeled food and leaking drain pipes
summary: Passed. Food in coolers and dry storage lacked name labels. Also flagged: leaking drain pipes under hand sinks, greasy floors, missing floor tiles, and dirty cooler interiors and hood filters. Corrections were ordered.

headline: Passed; openings under front double doors
summary: Passed. Both front double doors have openings at the bottom. These must be sealed to prevent pest entry.

headline: Passed; missing handwashing sign
summary: Passed. The rear hand sink lacks a handwashing sign. The manager must provide signs at all employee hand sinks.

headline: Vacuum packaging without variance; items discarded
summary: Passed with conditions. Reduced-oxygen packaging equipment was used without the required city variance. The machine was tagged, and the manager voluntarily discarded vacuum-packed items. A priority citation was issued. Slight black slime was found in the ice machine.

headline: Deli cold-hold unit at 50°F tagged out
summary: Passed with conditions. The deli cold-hold unit held food at 50°F, so it is tagged and held for Chicago Department of Public Health reinspection. Interior of all cold-hold units had spillage and build-up, and hood filters need cleaning.

headline: Passed; food boxes on basement floor
summary: Passed. Boxes of food were stored on the basement floor and must be raised 6 inches. Also: a cooler door that does not always latch, a cracked faucet leaking at the three-compartment sink, and heavy trash under air handling units.

headline: Failed; undated food discarded; hand sinks misused
summary: Failed. About 200 lb of prepared foods lacked date labels and were discarded. Cooked falafel held at 84.9°F was discarded. Two hand sinks were used for dishwashing or storage; a rear door gap and missing hair restraints were also noted.

headline: Passed; moldy caulking at sink
summary: Passed. Dirty, mold-like caulking around the three-compartment sink must be cleaned or replaced.

headline: Mold-like substance in restroom and cooler
summary: Passed. A black mold-like substance was on a basement women's restroom ceiling and on walls inside a cold-holding walk-in cooler. Cardboard lined produce cooler shelving. Basement restrooms lack mechanical ventilation.

headline: Failed; slow drain and repeat cleaning violations
summary: Failed. A hand sink at the main prep line drains slowly and must be repaired. Previous core violations were not corrected: heavy grease on cooking equipment, dirty kitchen and washroom floors, and clutter. A priority citation was issued.

headline: No valid certified manager during food service
summary: Passed with conditions. No valid certified manager was on duty while deli sandwiches and chicken were prepared and served; a priority citation was issued. A leak under the front hand sink needs repair, and a food handler certificate had expired.

headline: Passed; fly strips hanging; uncertified food handlers
summary: Passed. Fly strips hung in the food prep area and must be removed. Several food handlers lacked food handler certificates. Also: a ceiling opening above prep coolers, storage clutter, and dirty floors near cooking equipment.

headline: No employee health policy or vomit cleanup plan
summary: Passed with conditions. No employee health policy was on site, and no procedure existed for cleaning vomit and diarrhea. No citation was issued. A refrigerator door gasket was torn, and certified managers lacked allergen training.

headline: Failed: over 60 mouse droppings in storage
summary: Failed. Over 60 mouse droppings were scattered on shelves and floors in storage room 309. A priority citation was issued, and the manager was told to call an exterminator and clean. Also: no handwashing signs and no covered trash in washrooms.

headline: Passed; gasket cleaning and missing baseboards
summary: Passed. Walk-in cooler gaskets need cleaning, and baseboards are missing in the prep and front counter area. The manager was instructed to replace the baseboards and maintain the area.

headline: Certified manager's allergen training expired
summary: Re-inspection passed. A certified food manager's allergen training certificate had expired. Anyone holding a city food sanitation certificate must complete current allergen training.

headline: No certified manager; some washroom sinks not working
summary: Passed with conditions. No certified food manager was on the premises, a priority citation. Gaps at the base of both entrance doors must be sealed to block pests. Hand sinks in both washrooms were not working, and one trash lid was missing.

headline: Passed; sneeze guard and food handler training required
summary: Passed. The manager must install and maintain a sneeze guard at the front prep and service counter. All food handlers in prep areas must comply with food handler training requirements.

headline: Passed; missing handwashing sign
summary: Passed. The handwashing sink in the dishwashing area lacks handwashing signage. The manager must provide it.

headline: Passed; missing handwashing sign at bar
summary: Passed. The hand sink at the bar and preparation area lacks handwashing signage and must have it.

headline: Passed; no covered trash in women's washroom
summary: Passed. The women's washroom had no covered receptacle and must get one. Loose debris, dirt and dust were on floors in the rear storage, trash compactor and mop sink areas; cleaning frequency should increase.

headline: Bare-hand bun handling; gloves reused without washing
summary: Complaint, passed with conditions. A worker used the same gloves on soiled dishes and then clean dishes without washing hands. Another worker handled hamburger buns barehanded; about 2 lb of buns were discarded. Citations were issued.

headline: Pastries at 63°F discarded; allergen training expired
summary: Passed with conditions. Custard and cream cheese pastries held at 63°F were discarded (8 lb, $50); a priority citation was issued. Floors in prep and dish areas have soil and debris build-up. A certified food manager's allergen training had expired.

headline: Peeling hood caulk; greasy sandwich presses
summary: Caulk or sealant around ventilation hoods in the kitchen is missing or peeling and must be repaired. Sandwich presses have heavy, encrusted grease. Floors under cook line equipment and the 3-compartment sink and walls with dried food and dust must be cleaned.

headline: Door gaps; heavy food debris; wall hole
summary: The front and rear exit doors have 1/4-inch gaps at the bottom that must be sealed to prevent pests. Heavy food debris is between cooking equipment. A hole in the wall and broken floor are under the rear handsink. The hood needs cleaning.

headline: Food handler training proof missing
summary: Dirty wiping cloths were left on prep tables and must be kept in sanitizer when not in use. Food handlers showed no proof of food handler training, and certified managers have no allergen training proof.

headline: Failed: live flies; raw fish held too warm
summary: About 10 large and 5 to 8 small flies were found around prep, dish and toilet areas; pest control service is recommended. Raw tilapia, catfish and perch were held at 45-46.2°F, too warm; about 15 lb (about $95) was discarded. Citation issued.

headline: Food on floor; grocery bags; allergen training
summary: Food containers in the walk-in cooler are on the floor and must be raised six inches. Food is stored in grocery bags and tin cans and must be moved to food-grade containers. Floors and hood filters need deep cleaning, and certified managers lack allergen training.

headline: Missing cooler thermometer; peeling wall paint
summary: A thermometer is missing from the prep cooler; the manager must provide one in its warmest part. Peeling paint on the wall beside the large dough mixer must be removed, and a durable wall covering must be installed.

headline: Salsa and pork held too warm; cooler tagged out
summary: Green salsa at 50.2°F, red salsa at 57.5°F and cooked pork at 50.9°F were too warm; about 30 lb (about $100) was discarded. A front prep cooler reached only 52°F; it was tagged out and must not be used until repaired and re-inspected.

headline: No manager on site; no soap at sink
summary: No person in charge was on site at first; one arrived during the inspection. No certified manager was present while chicken and beef were served; citation issued. No employee health policy, cleanup kit or soap at a prep handsink was on site at first.

headline: Raw chicken, burgers held too warm; $2,160 lost
summary: About 120 lb of raw chicken at 46.9-49.6°F and 36 lb of beef burgers at 47.5°F were held too warm. The manager discarded about $2,160 of product. The walk-in cooler, at 49.3°F, was repaired during the inspection; citation issued.

headline: Unlabeled containers; dirty coolers and floors
summary: Food containers in the rear prep cooler are not labeled with their names and must be labeled. Coolers have accumulated food and spills and need detail cleaning. A bar sink faucet leaks, and floors, corners and vents throughout are dusty.

headline: Cold foods held at 45°F; about $400 discarded
summary: Various cold TCS foods were held at 45°F, above the 41°F limit. The manager discarded about 48 lb of cream cheese, butter, yogurt, sandwiches, wraps and salad, worth about $400; citation issued. The hot dish machine top was dusty.

headline: No food manager certificate posted
summary: The original city food manager certificate was not posted on site; citation issued. Rusted storage racks in the walk-in cooler and above the three-compartment sink must be repainted or replaced. Damaged base coving at the basement walk-in entrance must be repaired.

headline: Chipped paint; damaged dry-storage floor
summary: Chipped paint on the wall at the dish-area handsink must be resurfaced and repainted. Grout is missing and floor tiles are damaged in the dry storage room; both must be repaired to keep the floor smooth and cleanable.

headline: Dish machine tagged out; greasy bakery floors
summary: The bakery's hot-water sanitizer dish machine was not sanitizing properly and remains tagged do-not-use. Grease and grime were found on bakery floors near the fryers and grease trap. A ceiling tile is missing in a staff men's washroom.

headline: Dirty prep tables and floors; door not closing
summary: Prep tables, cabinet shelves and cold-holding unit interiors need detail cleaning. One toilet room door near the prep area is not self-closing. Floors, wall bases and corners in several areas, including behind the ice cream freezer, need cleaning.

headline: Improper thawing and unprotected freezer food
summary: Frozen chicken was thawing in a sink; the manager was told to thaw it under cool running water or in a cooler. Hamburgers and pizza puffs in a freezer were not protected from contamination. Dirty freezers, floors and hood filters also noted.

headline: No food handler certificates; cups in dry ingredients
