summary: No food handler certificates were on site, and the certified manager lacks allergen training; citation issued. Disposable cups were stored inside bulk dry ingredient containers, and the rear exit door is not rodent-proof. A rear handsink pipe was leaking into a bucket.

headline: Failed: about 30 live flies; no hot water
summary: About 30 live flies were on walls and ceilings in the coffee station and rear dishwashing area; more pest control service is needed. No certified manager was present while TCS foods were served. A hand sink had no hot water (61.1°F). Earlier violations remain uncorrected.

headline: Prep cooler door gasket needs repair
summary: On re-inspection, the left door gasket of the two-door prep cooler in the rear prep area on the 5th floor must be repaired so the door closes and seals properly.

headline: No food handler cards; uncorrected garbage violation
summary: No food handler cards were on site, and the pizza cooler has no thermometer. A previous violation was not fixed: the facility uses city garbage pickup but must contract a private waste hauler. Citation issued.

headline: Undated cooked food; rear door gap
summary: Cooked rice and egg roll filling held over 24 hours were not date-marked; citation issued. A 1/4-inch gap under the rear exit door must be sealed against pests. Handwashing signs and splashguards are missing, and the utility room is cluttered.

headline: Food in non-food-grade buckets; leaks
summary: Food was stored in white plastic buckets and smaller containers that were not food-grade. Floor drains in the rear dish area have debris and a slimy dark substance. Leaks were found at a one-compartment sink and a hand sink; several areas need deep cleaning.

headline: Failed: repeat violations; manager lacks allergen training
summary: A toilet room in the kitchen prep area is cluttered with storage items; its wash bowl and toilet water line must be capped and the room cleared. This violation from March 2025 was not corrected. A certified manager lacks allergen training; citation issued.

headline: Walk-in cooler too warm; raw meat discarded
summary: Chicken, ground beef and sausage were held above 41°F in the basement walk-in cooler (49.8°F, 46.2°F, 49.1°F). About 49 lb, worth about $300, was discarded. The cooler was tagged and must be repaired. No vomit cleanup kit was on site.

headline: Unlabeled bulk containers; no allergen training
summary: Bulk food containers holding beans and rice were not labeled and must be labeled. The sanitation manager has no allergen training, and the manager must provide proof.

headline: No manager on duty; produce held too warm
summary: No certified food manager was on duty while hamburgers, chicken and steak were served; citation issued. Tomatoes at 55.6°F and lettuce at 63.2°F in a prep ice bin were too warm; the manager discarded 7 lb (about $20). Sink pipes leak and floors need cleaning.

headline: Dish machine gauge fixed on site; undated shellstock
summary: Shellstock tags from late 2024 and early 2025 lack the date when the last shellstock is sold or served; citation issued. A low-temperature dish machine's wash gauge read 493, not a temperature. It was repaired on site and now reads 125°F.

headline: No certified manager on premises; hair restraint lapses
summary: No city-certified food service manager was on premises; citation issued. Two food handlers preparing food lacked hair restraints. Boxes were stored on soda crates, drains and the pizza oven were greasy, and the employee washroom door lacks a self-closing device.

headline: Failed: packaged paletas lack allergen labels
summary: Many sealed paletas (ice pops) lack proper allergen labels, and many contain nuts or other major allergens without listing ingredients. The manager must label all with allergens and ingredients or remove them from the premises. Citation issued.

headline: No certified manager during food prep
summary: The person in charge lacks a Chicago food sanitation certificate, and no certified manager was present while TCS foods were served; citation issued. Several workers lacked hair restraints. A basement leak, uncovered bathroom trash, and dirty floor drains were noted.

headline: Front door gap; missing splashguards
summary: A gap of about 1/4 inch at the bottom of the front entrance door must be closed to prevent pest entry. Splashguards are needed at the front coffee prep area sinks. Backflow prevention devices must be installed at the ice and espresso machines.

headline: Failed: slimy ice maker; missing raw food warning
summary: A slimy brownish substance was found inside the ice maker and must be cleaned. The menu lacks a consumer advisory for raw or undercooked items such as soft-boiled egg ramen; a priority violation. Unlabeled containers, dirty fryers and a broken urinal were also noted.

headline: No hair restraint; utility sink missing
summary: A food handler prepared food without a proper hair restraint and must wear one at all times. The facility was licensed with a utility sink but none was available; the manager must provide one.

headline: No certificate holder on site during TCS prep
summary: No person with a City sanitation certificate was on premises while chicken and beef were handled; citation issued. The manager showed a 2024 class completion, not a city certificate. Missing prep-area cooler thermometer; greasy fryer; food stored on floor.

headline: Dish machines out of service; manager training
summary: Two low-temperature dish machines on the second floor and two high-temperature machines at the members-only coffee station are out of service and must be repaired or removed. A certified manager lacks proof of allergen training.

headline: Spoiled, moldy meat displayed for sale
summary: Numerous meat packages were spoiled and discolored with black, brown and green patches, and were on display for sale. Green and white mold spots were on sliced bacon. The manager was told to discard them; citation issued. Fly strips hang in the produce prep area.

headline: Failed: five dead cockroaches in sink
summary: Five dead cockroaches were found in the warewashing-area handwashing sink. No other pests were seen; pest control was ordered. The site has no waste removal service or dumpster. A handwashing sign was missing and a ceiling above a sink is damaged.

headline: Food handlers lack certificates; no hair restraints
summary: Food handlers in prep areas must wear hair restraints. Several food handlers had no food handler certificates, and the certified manager has no allergen training certificate. Beverage nozzles need cleaning; prep-area ceiling tiles, vents and light shields need attention.

headline: Dirty floors, drains, vents and grill filters
summary: Floors and floor drains need cleaning to remove spills and debris. Air vents in the prep area are dusty, and filters above the grills have debris. No pests or temperature problems were noted.

headline: Failed: poor handwashing; dish machine not sanitizing
summary: A food handler rinsed hands with water only, and no certified manager was present for the first half of the walkthrough; citation issued. The low-temperature dish machine had zero ppm sanitizer and must not be used until re-inspected. A rice cooker was stored on the floor.

headline: Dirty wiping cloths; cracked cutting boards
summary: Dirty wiping cloths were left on rear prep tables instead of being stored in sanitizer. Cutting boards have open seams and dark stains and must be refinished or replaced. Grease and oil were found on the stove surface.

headline: Excessive leak at sink; greasy hood filters
summary: A leak at the three-compartment sink pipe is excessive and must be repaired. Peeling paint on the ceiling in the front prep area must be repaired. Hood filters have a buildup of grease and must be cleaned.

headline: Grooved cutting board; clutter in basement
summary: A cutting board on the main salad line has deep grooves and dark stains and must be repaired or replaced. Unused equipment and unnecessary items in basement storage must be removed to prevent pest harborage. The fan by the utility sink needs cleaning.

headline: License number missing from door sides
summary: The license number must be displayed on both sides of the doors. The manager was instructed to add and maintain it.

headline: Ice machine build-up; missing hood filter
summary: Slight pink buildup was found in the upper portion of the ice machine and must be cleaned. One ventilation hood filter is missing and must be replaced; the remaining filters must be kept clean.

headline: Broken reach-in handle with sharp edge
summary: The left handle of a two-door reach-in cooler near the three-compartment sink is broken and has a sharp edge; it must be repaired. The employee toilet room in the rear has low lighting and needs brighter lights.

headline: Failed: no certified manager, missing training records
summary: Food handlers prepared TCS foods (foods that must stay hot or cold) with no city-certified food manager on site; citation issued. Vomit and diarrhea cleanup supplies were missing. No training proof was shown for food handlers or allergens; seasonings were unlabeled.

headline: No certified manager present during food prep
summary: The person in charge lacks a city food manager certificate. No certified manager was on premises while sandwiches, fries and shakes were prepared; citation issued. Shake scoops were stored in standing water until the person in charge ran water. Gaskets are torn.

headline: Food splatters inside microwave
summary: Minor food splatters were found inside the microwave. The manager was instructed to clean and maintain it.

headline: Expired food handler certificates on site
summary: On re-inspection, all food handler certificates on site had expired and must be replaced with valid ones. Debris is built up under the flat-top grill; cardboard on the floor in the rear prep area must be removed. The certified manager lacks allergen training.

headline: No certified food manager; no certificate posted
summary: No certified food service manager was on site, and no certificate was posted. The manager was told to obtain one. This is a priority violation under city code 7-38-012.

headline: Food stored on floor; unlabeled containers
summary: Food containers were stored on the floor in the walk-in cooler, prep and storage areas; the manager must raise them at least six inches. Containers lacked food-name labels. The ice bin interior needs cleaning, and floors throughout are dusty.

headline: Eggs and cream cheese held too warm
summary: Eggs at 45°F, cream cheese at 56°F, bean bread and whipped topping at 51°F were held in prep coolers above the 41°F limit; citation issued. A two-door prep cooler reached only 50°F and must be repaired. Several handlers have expired food handler certificates.

headline: No drainboard at sink; damaged ceilings
summary: The three-compartment sink has no drainboard, so washed utensils cannot dry properly; a metal drainboard or drain rack was ordered. Damaged ceiling tiles in the toilet room and a damaged ceiling at the front of the store must be repaired.

headline: No employee health policy; no customer barrier
summary: No employee health policy was on premises; the manager must provide one covering illness reporting. Food prep and dishwashing areas lack a barrier from the sales floor and must be protected from customers. Food handlers who are not managers need training.

headline: No backflow device at utility sink
summary: No backflow device is installed at the utility sink as required; the manager must install one. Exterior surfaces of cooking equipment must be cleaned. All food handlers must obtain required food handler training.

headline: Certified managers lack allergen training
summary: Certified food managers are missing allergen awareness training. All certified managers must complete this training.

headline: Leak under three-compartment sink
summary: A leak was found from the center of the pipe underneath the three-compartment sink. The manager was instructed to repair the leak.

headline: Faulty sanitizer dispenser; unused cooler
summary: The sanitizer dispenser at the three-compartment sink is not working properly and must be repaired or replaced. An unused two-door cooler in the front prep area must either be repaired and maintained or removed from the premises.

headline: Rear door gap; cracked floors; dirty filters
summary: The rear exit door has a 1/4-inch gap at the bottom that must be sealed to keep pests out. Tabletops, prep stations, shelving and a reach-in freezer need cleaning. Floors need detail cleaning, and cracked floors with holes must be repaired.

headline: Failed: over 40 mouse droppings found
summary: More than 40 mouse droppings were scattered on the furnace room floor. The manager was told to call an exterminator and clean all areas; priority citation issued. Food debris, leaking pipes and missing hood filters and food-manager allergen training were also noted.

headline: No handwashing sign; milk crates used as shelves
summary: No handwashing sign was posted at the bar prep sink; the manager must provide one. Milk crates serve as shelving and must be replaced with shelving at least six inches off the floor. Grease, food debris and dirt were found on floors in several areas.

headline: Rear door gap; dirty gaskets; lights out
summary: A gap of at least 1/4 inch under the rear exit door needs a repaired door sweep. Gaskets on two reach-in coolers are damaged and dirty. Several lights are out in the prep area and hallway, and the certified manager lacks allergen training.

headline: Half-inch gap at front doors; no splashguard
summary: A 1/2-inch gap between the double front doors must be closed to rodent-proof the building. A splashguard is needed between a handwashing sink and a three-compartment sink at the rooftop bar. Both employee washroom doors lack self-closing devices.

headline: Failed: no certified manager; repeat violations
summary: No certified manager was on site while pizza was served; citation issued. Repeat violations from May 2025 were not corrected: a torn door seal, food debris inside reach-in coolers, a leaking sink, a missing toilet door closer, and dirty floors and fan vents.

headline: Dish machine not sanitizing; tagged out of use
summary: The high-temperature dish machine could not reach the required 180°F final rinse (it reached 74°F) and is tagged out until repaired and re-inspected. Raw beef stored on the walk-in freezer floor must be raised six inches. Several items were soiled.

headline: Mold-like buildup on cheese cooler shelves
summary: A gap of about 1/4 inch at the front doors must be sealed. Stained cutting boards and rusted, chipped racks need replacing or repainting. The cheese cooler shelves have mold-like buildup. Water-stained ceiling tiles over grocery freezers must be replaced.

headline: Failed: no certified manager; blocked handsinks
summary: No certified manager was on site while TCS foods were prepared; citation issued. Both handwashing sinks were blocked with utensils and supplies. The pest control logbook had no 2026 service reports. Food handler training proof and manager allergen training are missing.

headline: Dirty floor drains; expired allergen certificate
summary: Floor drains and floors in corners, under equipment and around sinks in the prep and dishwashing areas have dirt and debris. Floor drains must be cleaned. The certified food manager's allergen training certificate has expired.

headline: Deli meat held at 86.4°F; no hot water
summary: Several packs of sliced deli meat, turkey and turkey ham were stored at 86.4°F in a reach-in cooler; the manager was told to discard them. Citation issued. Several washroom and utility sinks lack hot water, and one utility sink is not draining.

headline: Food on floor, unlabeled containers, rear door gap
summary: Food was stored on floors in the walk-in cooler, prep and storage areas; it must be raised six inches. Food containers lacked name labels. A 1/4-inch gap under the rear exit door must be sealed to keep pests out.

headline: Frozen food holding inadequate; no thermometer
summary: The facility lacks an adequate holding method for TCS frozen foods, a priority violation. No metal-stem thermometer was available for checking frozen food temperatures. Banners on the bicycle lack the required license number.

headline: No handwashing signs; allergen training missing
summary: Washrooms have no handwashing signs and must have them. The certified food manager has no allergen training certificate; the manager must complete training and keep the certificate on site.

headline: No vomit cleanup kit; dirty shelves and floors
summary: No vomit or diarrhea cleanup kit was on site; the manager was told to obtain and maintain one. No citation was issued. Food shelves need detailed cleaning, the toilet needs a new flush handle, and floors throughout need cleaning.

headline: No vomit cleanup kit; no allergen training
summary: No vomit or diarrhea cleanup kit or written procedures were on site. Handwashing sinks lack signs. A cutting board has open seams and dark stains. The three-compartment sink faucet leaks, and the food prep handsink drains slowly. The city food manager lacks allergen training.

headline: Failed: about 1,000 mouse droppings throughout
summary: Re-inspection found an infestation of about 1,000 or more mouse droppings across the premises, including prep, sales, storage and basement areas. Two dead mice and a decayed one were found. Pest control service is required, and doors have gaps.

headline: No backflow devices at coffee machines
summary: The espresso machine and drip coffee machine have no backflow prevention devices. The manager must provide devices in locations where they can be serviced and maintained.

headline: Cook lacked hair restraint; cracked floors
summary: A male cook had no hair restraint or beard guard at the start of the inspection. The manager supplied both during the inspection. Cracked floor tiles by the fryers and sink hold standing water; repairs and water removal were ordered.

headline: No current food handler certificates on site
summary: On re-inspection, no current food handler certificates were on site. All employees must complete food handler training, and records must be kept on site at all times.

headline: Failed: dish machine lacks temperature gauge
summary: The warewashing machine has no temperature gauge for its wash and sanitizing cycles, so water temperatures cannot be checked. This was a priority violation, and a citation was issued.

headline: Toilet room trash lacks lids
summary: Receptacles in the women's toilet room have no lids. The manager was told to ensure covered receptacles are in the women's toilet room.

headline: Dead flies, spiders and ants on basement floor
summary: Dead flies, spiders and ants had built up across the basement floor; the manager must remove them to prevent pests. Damp wiping cloths were stored on an open glassware cooler at the bar, and knives were left between sinks and cold-holding equipment.

headline: Screen door openings; allergen training missing
summary: Openings in the rear screen door must be repaired to prevent pest entry. A certified food manager was observed without an allergen training certificate; management was told all certified managers must show proof.

headline: Water pipe above packaged food; grease spills
summary: A black water line pipe runs over packaged food and to-go containers in the basement and must be shielded or the food moved. Food splatter is inside microwaves, and grease spills are on the floor under the bar's three-compartment sink.

headline: No certified manager on duty; supplies missing
summary: No certified food manager was on duty while TCS foods were served; the manager arrived at 12:11 p.m. and a citation was issued. Hand sinks lacked soap and paper towels, though both were supplied during the inspection. A ladle was stored inside a pot of beans.

headline: Dirty coolers; ice in freezer; cluttered corners
summary: Pots and pans accumulated in the rear dish area must be cleaned and sanitized. A reach-in cooler door gasket is in poor repair. Ice has built up in a freezer, and rear prep coolers are dirty. Clutter in corners must be removed to prevent harborage.

headline: Eye-wash on handwashing sink; mold on wall
summary: The rear storage handwashing sink has an eye-wash setup on its faucet; the manager must remove it, keeping the sink for handwashing only. Black mold-like material is on the wall above the three-compartment sink and must be cleaned.

headline: Food handler without hair restraint
summary: A food handler prepared food without a hair restraint. The person in charge was told that all food handlers must wear one.

headline: Failed: clutter; uncorrected backflow and allergen issues
summary: Clutter, including old piping, is in the basement and must be cleaned and organized. From an April 2024 inspection, backflow devices at the ice and espresso machines were not installed, and a sanitation manager lacks allergen training; citation issued.

headline: No certified manager on site during chicken prep
summary: No person in charge was on site during the inspection. No certified food manager was present while chicken was prepared and served; citation issued. A manager arrived at the end. Sink stoppers do not work, and paint and wall base are peeling.

headline: No food handler training; unlabeled bulk containers
summary: Employees have no valid food handler training, and bulk containers in prep and storage areas are unlabeled. Food debris and grease are built up on equipment, shelves and floors. Propane tanks and unused items in storage must be removed to prevent pest harborage.

headline: Cardboard in fryers; small water leak
summary: Cardboard was used as a grease catch and to line nonfood-contact surfaces of the deep fryers. The manager must replace it with smooth, cleanable material. A small potable water leak was found at the water filtration system near the mop sink.

headline: Manager handled food with open forearm wounds
summary: A manager handling food and washing dishes had open wounds on his forearm and was restricted until bandaged; bandages were supplied during the inspection. Citation issued. No vomit cleanup procedure or supplies were on site. A cutting board is stained.

headline: Failed: customer handwashing sink intermittently fails
summary: A handwashing sink in one customer toilet room runs only periodically when a hand is waved at the sensor; the manager must ensure steady water flow. Priority citation issued. Heavy rust on deli cooler shelving must be repainted or replaced.

headline: Failed: rat droppings; no training certificates
summary: Ten rat droppings were found on the basement floor under wooden pallets. The manager must remove them by re-inspection and call pest control. No food handler training certificates were on the premises, and a garnish cooler door is loose.

headline: Inspection summary not posted; dish machine dirty
summary: The previous inspection summary was not posted, and an old passing summary was visible instead. A copy of today's summary was given and must be posted publicly; citation issued. The kitchen dish machine and deep fryers need cleaning inside and out.

headline: Open kitchen window; food on floor
summary: A kitchen prep window was open and must be kept closed and tight-fitting to prevent pests. Boxes of frozen pork and raw beef stored on floors must be raised six inches. Torn cooler gaskets and an unworking women's restroom sink were also noted.

headline: Greasy walls; debris and coffee beans on floors
summary: Juice and soda splatter had built up under the cafeteria dispenser and must be cleaned. Grease and splatter are on the wall next to the flat-top, and debris and coffee beans are on floors behind equipment. Floors need cleaning to prevent pests.

headline: Failed: about 15 mouse droppings, flies found
summary: About 10 small flies and 15 mouse droppings were found, mainly in the rear dishwashing area, under the mop sink and in the women's toilet room. Citation issued. A small gap at the front door needs rodent-proofing. One food handler lacked a hair restraint.

headline: Failed: dead rat found; no manager certificate
summary: A large dead rat was found under a cooler behind the cashier. No pest control logbook was available, and no valid city manager certificate was on site; citation issued. No vomit cleanup kit or employee health policy. Several older violations remain uncorrected.
